izzyondroid:com.jingcjie.wifi_direct_cab.name: WD Cable
izzyondroid:com.jingcjie.wifi_direct_cab.summary: Offline file, chat, speed test, and audio transfer over Wi-Fi Direct.
izzyondroid:com.jingcjie.wifi_direct_cab.description:
WD Cable creates a private local link between nearby devices using Wi-Fi Direct. Once connected, the devices share one app session for chat, file transfer, speed testing, and audio.
 No internet, router, hotspot, account, or cloud service is required. The connection stays local between the participating devices.
 Features:
 Direct device-to-device connection over Wi-Fi Direct.
 High-speed local file transfer.
 Real-time chat between connected peers.
 Protocol v2 transport setup with UDP rendezvous and detailed diagnostics.
 Low-latency Audio Link using RTP/RTCP over UDP with libopus.
 Selectable sender audio quality and latency modes.
 Built-in upload and download speed tests.
 The Android app can connect to another Android device running WD Cable. A separate Windows companion client is also available for Android-to-Windows workflows, including using an Android device as a local microphone sender.
 Version 2.0.1 uses Protocol v2 and is not compatible with Protocol v1 builds. Both devices must run WD Cable 2.0.1 or another Protocol v2-compatible build.
 Requires Android 13 or newer. Release APKs support arm64-v8a and x86_64 devices; 32-bit armeabi-v7a devices are not supported.
 WD Cable is designed for offline peer-to-peer experiments, local transfer, quick device-to-device testing, and private nearby sharing.

fdroid:com.grooveforge.grooveforge.name: GrooveForge
fdroid:com.grooveforge.grooveforge.summary: MIDI synth with soundfonts, 92 microtonal scales, and offline band rehearsals
fdroid:com.grooveforge.grooveforge.description:
GrooveForge is a portable MIDI keyboard studio for Android. Plug in a MIDI controller, pick a soundfont, and play.
It began as a practice companion, light enough to carry on a phone or tablet, for rebuilding scales and muscle memory at a keyboard. It grew well beyond that, but it remains a tool for practising and playing, not a DAW.
Rehearsals
A band learning a tune together, without a studio. Everyone records their own part over a shared click, on their own phone, and the parts collect into one arrangement that every device holds a full copy of.
Import a recording to play along to — MP3, FLAC and WAV everywhere, plus M4A, AAC and the sound of a video on Android. Tap the tempo, then drag a marker to the first downbeat so the grid lines up with the music.
Every device delays sound on the way out and on the way in, which would push each take late. GrooveForge measures that delay on your device and shifts your take back by it, so what you played on the beat lands on the beat.
Nothing is uploaded anywhere and no account is needed. Devices sync directly over the local network: scan a code once, then opening the same tune is enough. No internet needed, and without Wi-Fi one phone's hotspot is the whole network.
Instruments
GrooveForge Keyboard — soundfont synth (.sf2) with bank and patch selection and MIDI channel routing. Every slot is independent.
Vocoder — mic-driven voice synthesis.
Stylophone — monophonic metal-strip instrument.
Theremin — touch pad with vertical pitch and horizontal volume.
Drum Generator — beat patterns from bossa nova to metal, with human feel.
Xen: microtonal scales
Hold a note, tap a scale. The note you are holding becomes the tonic, the keyboard locks to the scale built on it, and — for scales that are not equal-tempered — the keys it uses are retuned to sound as the tradition intends. One keyboard, one gesture.
92 scales across eleven families: Western modes; Arabic and Turkish maqamat; Persian dastgah; Indian ragas in just intonation; Chinese, Japanese and Korean modes; Thai seven-equal; Javanese and Balinese gamelan; Ethiopian qenet and Ugandan amadinda; Highland pipe, hardanger fiddle and Byzantine chant; historical temperaments; and equal divisions from 13 to 31 tones, Bohlen-Pierce, and Wendy Carlos's non-octave alpha, beta and gamma.
Retuning uses a full MIDI tuning table rather than pitch bend, so every note of a chord sounds at its own correct pitch. Out-of-scale keys grey out and retuned ones show their offset in cents.
Each scale says where its numbers come from: a temperament is exact, a maqam follows the convention that notates it, a gamelan is tuned by ear and varies between instruments.
Build your own scales too — any number of degrees, an offset per key, and a mute that keeps a degree playable while the scale lock ignores it. Import and export Scala (.scl) files.
Loopers
MIDI Looper — record and loop MIDI patterns with bar sync.
Audio Looper — record and loop live audio with bar sync, overdub and reverse.
Effects
Plate reverb, ping-pong delay, wah (auto or pedal-controlled), 4-band EQ, compressor and chorus/flanger, with BPM sync where it makes sense. Live Input routes a microphone or line-in through any of them.
And the rest
Plugin rack — an ordered, drag-and-drop rack of module slots, reorderable at any time.
Scale lock and highlighting — root, in-scale and out-of-scale keys coloured on the on-screen keyboard.
Jam Mode — one slot leads; the slots after it lock to its harmony.
CC mapping — map hardware knobs, sliders and pads to MIDI effects or application actions.
Projects — save and restore complete rack configurations to a .gf file. The last session is autosaved on every change.
GrooveForge is free software, built by one developer in their spare time. Rough edges are expected, and releases happen when time allows.

fdroid:com.languageapp.laetle.name: La et Le

No ads, no tracking, no proprietary services.

fdroid:com.musheer360.swiftslate.name: SwiftSlate
fdroid:com.musheer360.swiftslate.summary: System-wide AI text assistant — type a trigger, get instant text transformation
fdroid:com.musheer360.swiftslate.description:
SwiftSlate is a system-wide AI text assistant for Android. Type a trigger like "?fix" at the end of any text, in any app, and watch it get replaced instantly.
It works in most apps — WhatsApp, Gmail, Twitter/X, Messages, Notes, and more. No copy-pasting. No app switching. Just type and go.
Features:
• Works system-wide via Android's Accessibility Service
• Also works from the text-selection menu in any app — no accessibility permission required
• Instant inline text replacement — AI response replaces your text directly
• Multi-provider AI: Google Gemini, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including local LLMs like Ollama and LM Studio)
• Text replacer commands run entirely offline with zero latency
• Multi-key rotation with automatic rate-limit handling
• API keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore
• AMOLED dark theme and light theme with Material 3
• Localized in 40 languages — the app follows your device language automatically
• Zero analytics, zero tracking, zero telemetry
• Tiny APK (~1.7 MB) with zero third-party networking dependencies
Built-in commands:
• ?fix — Fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation
• ?improve — Improve clarity and readability
• ?shorten — Shorten while keeping meaning
• ?expand — Expand with more detail
• ?formal — Rewrite in professional tone
• ?casual — Rewrite in friendly tone
• ?emoji — Add relevant emojis
• ?human — Rewrite so it doesn't read as AI-generated
• ?reply — Generate a contextual reply
• ?undo — Restore text from before the last replacement
• ?translate:XX — Translate to any language
• ?copy / ?cut / ?paste / ?replace — Clipboard actions without leaving the keyboard
You can also create your own custom AI commands with any prompt, or text replacer commands for instant offline snippets like signatures, canned responses, and shortcuts.
An API key from Google Gemini (free tier available), Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible provider is needed for AI commands. Text replacer commands work without any API key.

fdroid:com.nyx.custom_uploader.name: Custom Uploader
fdroid:com.nyx.custom_uploader.summary: Upload files to a file host of your choice
fdroid:com.nyx.custom_uploader.description:
Custom Uploader is a user-friendly file uploading tool that makes it easy for you to transfer files to your preferred hosting service. With Custom Uploader, you can upload a variety of different file types, including documents, images, videos, and more. The versatile tool is perfect for anyone who needs a reliable and convenient way to upload files for storage or sharing. Whenever you are a business owner, a student, or a professional, Custom Uploader can help you manage and share your files with ease.
 Features: 
 Easily upload anything to your host of choice (images, videos, documents, etc.) with a simple and easy to use interface.
 Easily create multiple uploaders for different hosts, and switch between them.
 Upload files from your gallery, camera, or any other app that supports sharing.
 Import/Export your uploaders to share them with others, with support for sharex's uploader format.
 Comes with built in uploader presets
 Comes with a powerful url parser that allows you to extract the url of the uploaded file from the response of the host.

fdroid:com.tunerly.name: Tunerly
fdroid:com.tunerly.summary: A minimalistic pitch tuning app for Guitar, Bass and Ukulele.
fdroid:com.tunerly.description:
Tunerly is a minimalistic, multi-language pitch tuning app which can be used for tuning your Guitar, Bass or Ukulele to various different tunings. It also includes a chromatic tuner. * Bass: 4 string, 5 string, 6 string, Drop D, D Standard, Drop C
* Ukulele: C (Standard), D (Traditional), Baritone, Bass

fdroid:de.ferreum.pto.name: PTO - Plaintext Organizer
fdroid:de.ferreum.pto.summary: Stay organized with one plaintext file per day.
fdroid:de.ferreum.pto.description:
To-do list, notes, appointment book, diary, journal, and… alarm clock? All possible with one plaintext file per day. PTO brings a convenient editor and important additional functions.
 Features 
• Powerful text editor with undo/redo, autosave, and more.
• Quickly take notes on the lockscreen, without unlocking your device.
• Reminders for upcoming events (format: @12:34 -15m foobar )
• Fast search through all pages.
• Save and open links to other apps and webpages.
• Uses no network connection. All content is local on the device.
• Optional template for new pages.
• Backup/import pages to/from ZIP file.
• And more, see the help: https://gitlab.com/ferreum/pto/-/blob/master/app/src/main/assets/help.md
 Origin 
This is a (now distant) fork of billthefarmer's Diary: https://github.com/billthefarmer/diary
PTO has a lot of internal and UI changes. It focuses on usage as a general organizer instead of a Diary, though it can still be used as such, if you don't need the removed features. Most notably the markdown view has been removed, so no inline media can be displayed.
See the help file for more differences: https://gitlab.com/ferreum/pto/-/blob/master/app/src/main/assets/help.md#origin

fdroid:io.github.ewoc2026.ewoc.name: Ewoc
fdroid:io.github.ewoc2026.ewoc.summary: Indoor cycling workouts for FTMS smart trainers
fdroid:io.github.ewoc2026.ewoc.description:
Ewoc is a free public-source indoor cycling app for Android.
It helps you ride an FTMS-compatible smart trainer with structured workouts,
live ride telemetry, Bluetooth heart-rate sensor support, local workout files,
and post-session summaries.
You can ride bundled workouts, import workouts from ZWO, legacy XML, or Ewoc
EWO files, use the built-in Android workout editor, or ride without a
structured workout in telemetry-only mode.
Ewoc is local-first. It does not include paid feature gates, Google Play
Billing, AI workout generation, support-bundle uploads, Health Connect data
reads, advertising, analytics, or a backend account.
Trainer-sensitive behavior still depends on the trainer model and firmware.
For best results, use an FTMS-compatible smart trainer or exercise bike and
keep other trainer-control apps disconnected while riding.

fdroid:io.github.tiagoshibata.gpsdclient.name: GPSd Forwarder
fdroid:io.github.tiagoshibata.gpsdclient.summary: Service to forward NMEA messages to a GPSd server
fdroid:io.github.tiagoshibata.gpsdclient.description:
This application forwards NMEA data from your phone's GPS to a specified host.
It's goal is to easily plug and feed data into a GPS server service (e.g. GPSd),
using your cellphone as a GPS device. This way, your cellphone can be used as a
GPS in navigation or robotics applications running in a host computer.
Data is forwarded using UDP. First, make sure the computer's IP is reachable
from your cellphone; this is the case in most default access points, so it
should work if both are connected to the same WiFi network.
On the host machine, execute `gpsd -N udp://:` (e.g. `gpsd -N udp://*:29998`). In
the app, enter your host's IP and port and hit Start. Your host is now
receiving GPS data forwarded from your phone. You can test it with gpsmon or
other GPSd utilities.

fdroid:me.d3sox.pdfwallet.name: PDF Docket
fdroid:me.d3sox.pdfwallet.summary: Keep PDF tickets and passes at hand and show their barcodes in fullscreen
fdroid:me.d3sox.pdfwallet.description:
PDF Docket stores and displays your most important PDFs, such as tickets, passes and certificates. It includes a convenient fullscreen barcode rendering, if a barcode is present in the PDF.
Brief Instruction
- Open "PDF Docket"
- Import PDF
- Done
Alternative Brief Instruction
- Go to your file browser, email, web browser or PDF reader app
- Open/Share the PDF with "PDF Docket"
- Done
Description
A very simple app that does nothing more than conveniently store and display PDF certificates. You can use it for public transport tickets, bills, contracts, certificates and any other PDF file.
The PDF file has to be imported into the app. Following that, the barcode is displayed in fullscreen, as well as the PDF document itself. That's already it.
Currently supported barcode formats are:
- Matrix (2D) codes: QR, Aztec, DataMatrix and PDF417
- Linear (1D) codes: UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, EAN-13, CODE-39, CODE-93, CODE-128, ITF and Codabar
More Features
- Can detect and extract barcodes in PDFs
- Split screen shows the barcode and the PDF at the same time, and the PDF turns to the page of each barcode
- The split screen divider can be dragged, and barcodes can be turned by 90° with a double tap
- PDF pages can be shown whole or fitted to the width
- Turn the screen or pin the app before handing your phone over
- Documents reopen at the barcode and page they were left on
- (Optional) biometric authentication
- PDFs can be sorted by name, file size, import date, or dragged into your own order
- PDFs can be individually named
- Assign tags to documents and filter documents by tags
- Tags can have icons
- Documents can have a note, e.g. a seat or booking number, and are found by it
- Documents can be shown as a grid or a list
- Documents can be archived instead of deleted, right away or automatically on a chosen date, with a reminder the day before
- Reminders on a chosen day, e.g. of an event, with an optional time
- PDFs can be shared from other apps, also several at once
- Documents can be added to the home screen, also as a widget that shows the barcode
- Encrypted backups of all documents and tags
- PDFs can be shared with other apps (indirectly allows printing)
- Dark Mode support (document stays in original color, optionally inverted)
- Also supports password protected PDFs
Privacy
This app values your privacy by working fully offline. No ads, no tracking.

fdroid:nl.bw20.last_launcher.name: Last Launcher
fdroid:nl.bw20.last_launcher.summary: Minimal text-only launcher focused on speed and simplicity
fdroid:nl.bw20.last_launcher.description:
Last Launcher is a minimal, text-only Android launcher built for speed and simplicity. No icons, no widgets, no clutter, just your apps as plain text labels.
Features:

fdroid:sh.fieldsmith.app.name: Fieldsmith
fdroid:sh.fieldsmith.app.summary: Parametric CAD, 3D FEA & RF VNA solver with Haven MCP & remote compute
fdroid:sh.fieldsmith.app.description:
Fieldsmith is a parametric implicit CAD modeller, 3D quadratic (P2) finite-element solver, RF antenna VNA workbench, and TPMS lattice slicer built in Rust.
Mobile CAD Driven by Haven MCP & External Compute:
- Local MCP Co-Pilot Server (127.0.0.1:18789/mcp): The Android app runs an embedded Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol server. Connecting from Haven on the same device (or over SSH/ADB port forwarding) lets an agent build CSG assemblies, place metric fasteners, tune dual-band drone antennas, and run finite-element solves while the 3D WebGL2 viewport updates live on the phone.
- External Compute Offload & LAN Discovery (LAN / Tailscale / WireGuard): Scan the local subnet (UDP :18790 beacon + /api/health sweep) from the UI or via MCP (discover_compute_peers / connect_compute_peer) to auto-connect the highest-thread-count desktop or server running fieldsmith-mcp --serve and offload heavy 3D P2 tetrahedral meshes, level-set topology runs, and multi-parameter sweeps while keeping touch inspection and 3D sectioning on Android.
- On-Device Native arm64 & WebAssembly Solvers: Works offline using the embedded Rust JNI solver and WebAssembly workers, with big.LITTLE thread capping so heavy solves do not lock up mobile UI threads.
Workflow stages:
1. Shape: Construct parts from CSG primitives (box, cylinder, sphere, capsule, torus, extrude, revolve, loft), 2D constraint-solved sketches (Gauss-Newton solver with DOF and conflict tracking), built-in metric fasteners (bolts, screws, washers, hex/nyloc nuts, and snap-fits positioned by surface edge dimensions), and imported STL/OBJ/3MF/STEP meshes with fillet/chamfer blends and per-volume materials.
2. Setup: Assign surface regions, Dirichlet displacement supports, mechanical loads (force, pressure, bolt preload), and thermal boundary conditions (temperature, convection, heat flux). Evaluate fastener tightening torque windows (T_min, T_rec, T_max), Weibull brittle fracture statistics, polymer creep retention, and holdable axial/shear forces across 19 fastener and 24 substrate materials. Simulate dual-band (900 MHz and 2.4 GHz) drone antenna VNA sweeps (S11, S21, VSWR), 50 Ohm Smith chart impedance trajectories, 3D far-field radiation lobes, and carbon-fibre (CFRP) eddy-current loss with L-network matching.
3. Results: Solve 3D P2 linear elasticity, steady Fourier heat conduction, thermo-elastic coupling, and modal vibration. Inspect von Mises stress, safety factor, peel stress, deflection, and temperature fields with section planes and transient playback.
4. Fill: Grade triply periodic minimal surface (Gyroid, Schwarz-P, Diamond, Lidinoid, Neovius, Split-P) and strut lattices from stress fields or evolve boundaries via level-set topology optimization.
5. Make: Check minimum wall thickness and overhang angles, preview build layers, and export manifold STL or 3MF slice stacks.
6. Theory: Inspect the active governing equations, boundary operators, and numerical discretizations for the current model and export a Markdown or HTML math report.

apple-macos:6809705522.description:
Jazz Browser is a web browser for iPhone and iPad, built on Apple's WebKit engine. It blocks trackers, keeps separate sets of logins in named containers, and has a VPN you can switch on from a tab inside the browser. It is completely free: no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no paid tier, no trial, no ads.
BROWSING
- Tabs, a tab grid, private tabs, pinned tabs and a list of recently closed tabs
- Bookmarks, history, shortcuts on the start page, find on page
- Reader mode for long articles
- Page translation that runs on the device with Apple's built-in translator, so the page text never leaves your iPhone or iPad
- Picture in picture, and audio that keeps playing in the background with lock screen controls
- Downloads saved into the Files app, a choice of search engine including custom ones, light and dark themes
CONTAINERS
Named containers such as Work, Personal and Shopping each keep their own cookies and logins, so the same site can be two independent sessions at once. Unlike a private tab, a container remembers the sign-in. It is about separation, not forgetting.
BLOCKING
- Built-in content blocking rules, plus filter list subscriptions in Adblock Plus format (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, Peter Lowe's list) converted to WebKit content rules
- Link cleaning strips tracking parameters such as utm_source and fbclid from the links you follow, so a link you forward no longer carries a marker pointing back to you
- Page report: how many resources the page loaded, which third-party domains it contacted, which of those are known trackers, and whether the page and everything on it arrived over HTTPS
- Leak protection: three WebKit subsystems (DNS prefetch, WebAuthn, WebTransport) can reach the network around the proxy and expose your real address. The browser can shut them down for one site or everywhere.
PER-SITE SETTINGS
JavaScript, images, autoplay, desktop layout and text zoom are kept per domain and survive a restart.
LOCK AND CLEAN-UP
- Lock the browser with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode; it locks as soon as you leave the app
- Clear history, cookies and site data when you exit, with control over what gets cleared
VPN
The VPN is off until you tap connect. It is built on Apple's Network Extension framework, covers the whole device, and keeps working when the browser is closed.
- Pick a server location
- Split tunneling: decide what goes through the tunnel and what goes direct
- Before the VPN can be turned on, a screen explains exactly what data is processed
FREE
Jazz Browser is free. There is nothing to buy inside it, no subscription, no paid tier, no trial, and no advertising.
PRIVACY
We keep no traffic logs. We do not record, analyse or store the contents of your connections, and we do not sell, share or disclose user data to third parties. A VPN changes the address a site sees; it does not make you anonymous to a site you have signed in to.

apple-macos:6447090616.name: Whisper Notes - Speech to Text
apple-macos:6447090616.description:
Whisper Notes turns voice memos, lectures, interviews and meetings into accurate text with speaker labels, 100% offline on your iPhone and iPad. One-time purchase, no subscription. Trusted by 70,000+ journalists, researchers and professionals.
■ Record and import
- Record from the Lock Screen, widgets, Control Center, the Action button, Apple Watch, or "Hey Siri".
- Import from Files, Photos or Voice Memos, several at once, or share from WhatsApp and any other app.
■ Transcribe
- Live transcription: your words appear on screen as you speak, in English and 24 other European languages.
- Speaker labels (speaker diarization) show who said what. Rename each speaker.
- Choose your on-device model: Parakeet, Whisper (OpenAI), SenseVoice, or Apple Speech on iOS 26.
- 99 languages through Whisper, detected automatically, even when speakers mix languages.
- Fast and unlimited: an hour of audio in under a minute with Parakeet, and no cap on how much you record or import.
■ Voice keyboard
- Dictate into any app: switch to the Whisper Notes keyboard, tap and speak, and your words are typed in.
- Works offline, in English and 24 other European languages. Nothing you dictate is saved.
■ Edit and export
- Double-tap any paragraph to fix a word.
- Export TXT, Markdown or SRT subtitles with timestamps and speaker labels. Works for videos too.
- Auto-save every new transcript to Files or iCloud Drive.
■ Private by design
Your recordings and transcripts never leave your device. Turn on airplane mode and Whisper Notes works exactly the same, which matters when the recording is an interview, a client meeting, or anything you wouldn't put on someone else's server.
■ One-time purchase
No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and the Mac App Store version. Not satisfied? Settings → Request Refund.
■ Quick answers
Does Whisper Notes work completely offline?
Yes. It transcribes on your iPhone or iPad, so it works in airplane mode. The built-in Parakeet model covers 25 European languages offline from the first launch; for other languages, download Whisper or SenseVoice once in the app.
Does Whisper Notes support live transcription?
Yes. With the built-in Parakeet model, text appears in real time as you record, in English and 24 other European languages. When you stop, the whole recording is transcribed again for the final note. Other languages are transcribed after you stop.
Is there a voice typing keyboard?
Yes. Add the Whisper Notes keyboard, then tap and speak in any app. It works offline in the same 25 languages.
Can it transcribe WhatsApp voice messages?
Yes. Share a voice message to Whisper Notes and it is transcribed offline.
Does it identify speakers?
Yes. Tap ⋯ on a note → Detect Speakers, and each passage is labeled by speaker, for up to 8 speakers.
Which model is best for Chinese, Japanese or Korean?
SenseVoice, built for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Cantonese.
Is there a time limit?
Each recording can be up to 24 hours long.
Which iPhones are supported?
Whisper Notes needs iPhone 12 or newer.
Your notes live only on your device, so deleting the app deletes them. Export what matters.
Questions? support@whispernotes.app · whispernotes.app

flathub:org.damask_multiphysics.DAMASK_g.name: DAMASK grid
flathub:org.damask_multiphysics.DAMASK_g.description:
DAMASK® is a unified multi-physics crystal plasticity simulation package. The solution of continuum mechanical boundary value problems requires a constitutive response that connects deformation and stress at each material point. This problem is solved in DAMASK on the basis of crystal plasticity using a variety of constitutive models and homogenization approaches. However, treating mechanics in isolation is no longer sufficient to study emergent advanced high-strength materials. In these materials, deformation happens interrelated with displacive phase transformation, significant heating, and potential damage evolution. Therefore, DAMASK is capable of handling multi-physics problems. Following a modular approach, additional field equations are solved in a fully coupled way using a staggered approach.
 The grid solver (damask_grid) operates on structured grids.

The server is similar in some respects to Livingston's 2.0 server. While FreeRADIUS started as a variant of the Cistron RADIUS server, they don't share a lot in common any more. It now has many more features than Cistron or Livingston, and is much more configurable. FreeRADIUS is an Internet authentication daemon, which implements the RADIUS protocol, as defined in RFC 2865 (and others). It allows Network Access Servers (NAS boxes) to perform authentication for dial-up users. There are also RADIUS clients available for Web servers, firewalls, Unix logins, and more. fedora-packages:gap-pkg-browse/gap-pkg-b.description: The motivation for this package was to develop functions for an interactive display of two-dimensional arrays of data, for example character tables. They should be displayed with labeled rows and columns, the display should allow some markup for fonts or colors, it should be possible to search for entries, to sort rows or columns, to hide and unhide information, to bind commands to keys, and so on. To achieve this our package now provides three levels of functionality, where in particular the first level may also be used for completely other types of applications: - A low level interface to ncurses: This may be interesting for all kinds of applications which want to display text with some markup and colors, maybe in several windows, using the available capabilities of a terminal. - A medium level interface to a generic function NCurses.BrowseGeneric: We introduce a new operation Browse which is meant as an interactive version of Display for GAP objects. Then we provide a generic function for browsing two-dimensional arrays of data, handles labels for rows and columns, searching, sorting, binding keys to actions, etc. This is for users who want to implement new methods for browsing two-dimensional data. - Applications of these interfaces: We provide some applications of the ncurses interface and of the function NCurses.BrowseGeneric. These may be interesting for end users, and also as examples for programmers of further applications. This includes a method for browsing character tables, several games, and an interface for demos.

firefox-addons:3027040.name: Odoo Developer Toolkit
firefox-addons:3027040.summary: In-page DevTools for Odoo : inspect fields, OWL components, menus & visibility modifiers, trace RPC bursts & N+1 queries, generate XML/Python inheritance stubs, and diff environments—100% locally in your browser.
firefox-addons:3027040.description:
Odoo Developer Toolkit turns any Odoo backend tab into a fast, zero-setup developer workbench—running 100% locally against your existing browser session with zero external servers or telemetry.
Open the OwnDock in-page panel anytime with Ctrl+Alt+D, click the ⚡ launcher bubble, or press Ctrl+K for the Command Palette.
- Smart Inspector & Visibility Debugger
 Sonic Multi-Surface Hover & Alt+Click Lock: Hover any field, button, notebook page, menu item, or OWL component to see live metadata, then Alt+Click (or click the Sonic badge) to lock it into the inspector with a visual connector line.
Visibility Debugger (v16): Instant verdict answering "Why is this field hidden, read-only, or required?" across 4 layers: live DOM state, evaluated XML modifiers (invisible/readonly/required AST evaluator), Python fields_get attributes, and security groups.
View Health Check: Scans all views of the active model to detect stale field references (upgrade breakers), required fields missing from views, and fields marked invisible everywhere.
Element Provenance & Field Matrix: See which module originally defined a node and every module overriding it via XPath/attributes, plus a cross-view presence matrix (form, list, kanban, search) with one-click XML ID copy.
Translation Lens & Related-Model Deep Dive: Compare field labels/help across all installed languages side-by-side, and inspect related models (many2one/one2many/many2many) with live record counts and sample values.
 OWL Component Inspector
Inspect live OWL components ( owl fibers) directly on the page—view component names, props, useState state, env.services, template names (t-name), and file path hints.
Generate ready-to-use patch(Component.prototype) JS stubs and t-inherit XML templates in one click.
 Call Tracer, N+1 Detector & RPC Console
Interaction Burst Tracer: Groups call_kw traffic by the exact button click that triggered it, highlighting slowest calls and automatically flagging N+1 RPC patterns.
Error History & Click-Through: Captures failed JSON-RPC calls across SPA navigations and lets you jump straight to affected records or copy env['model'].browse([...]) snippets.
RPC Console 2.0: Execute call_kw requests with args/kwargs, browse collapsible JSON trees, save reusable snippets, and replay call history.
Optional Companion Module (odoo_dev_toolkit_server): Connect to local dev instances to unlock backend cProfile Python call trees and SQL EXPLAIN plans per RPC.
 Generators, Graph & Environment Tools
Code & Menu Generators: Generate Python model inheritance stubs, ir.ui.view XPath extensions, a drag-and-drop Visual View Builder, and Menu Lab (add-child, add-sibling, move, hide, delete XML for any menu or breadcrumb).
Interactive Dependency Graph: Click-through model & relation explorer with live record counts, field footprints, search, and breadcrumbs.
Time Travel & Snapshot Diff: Automatically records before/after field values on every web_save, exports model schemas/ACLs/record rules to JSON, and generates auto-fix stubs when comparing environments.
Zero-Reload SPA Model Detection: Tracks Odoo navigation (/odoo/...) instantaneously without requiring page refreshes.
 Privacy First
No external servers, no analytics, and no tracking. Every RPC call runs strictly between your browser tab and your logged-in Odoo instance.

firefox-addons:3007579.name: Wallsflow New Tab: Live Wallpapers & Widgets
firefox-addons:3007579.summary: Transform your New Tab into a calm, personalized space with live wallpapers, widgets, and ambient focus music.
firefox-addons:3007579.description:
You open a new tab dozens of times a day. Why should it be a blank page every time?
With Wallsflow New Tab, every tab opens on a live wallpaper you picked, with the time, the weather and your favourite shortcuts right there. When it is time to work, start a Pomodoro timer, put on some rain or the hum of a coffee shop, and get going. Free, no account, no ads.
Live wallpapers, not boring pictures
Put any video or photo you like on your new tab. Just drag the file onto the page. Got a few? They can change on their own every 5, 15 or 30 minutes, every hour, or with the time of day, with separate wallpapers for day and night. Pin your favourite to keep it on screen. Looking for ideas? The Download More Wallpapers button takes you to the free library on wallsflow.com . Want to save battery? Turn the animation off with one click.
Sounds and music for focus
23 ambient sounds you can mix however you like, from rain and a crackling campfire to the hum of a busy coffee shop. Each one has its own volume, and quick mixes are ready for the days you just need to get through. Prefer your own music? Paste a Spotify, YouTube or SoundCloud link and listen right from the tab. The music keeps playing when you open another tab.
A Pomodoro timer with your task list
Start the timer and your task list opens next to it, with the task you are working on written large, right under the timer. The rest of the screen fades back so nothing pulls you away. When the session ends, Wallsflow asks whether you finished the task and keeps count of today's sessions. You choose the lengths.
Everything you need, nothing you don't
• A 12 or 24 hour clock with the date and a greeting that follows the time of day and the weather
• Weather for your city or any other, in Celsius or Fahrenheit
• Search with your default search engine
• Shortcuts to the sites you use most, arranged the way you want
• Your Firefox bookmarks, with quick search
Turn off any widget you don't need with one click.
Just the way you like it
Blur or dim the wallpaper so text stays easy to read, change the text colour, choose where links open. Save your settings, shortcuts, playlists and tasks to a file and take them to another computer whenever you want.
In your language
The extension starts in your browser's language: English, Romanian, German, French or Spanish. You can change it anytime in Settings.
Your data stays with you
No account, no data collection. Your wallpapers, settings and tasks live in your browser. The extension only goes online for the weather, for city search, for your shortcut icons and for the music you play.
Install Wallsflow New Tab and open a new tab. You will see the difference in the first second.

firefox-addons:802681.name: Website Theme Manager
firefox-addons:802681.summary: Allows you to change any website's look; choose your desired style from userstyles.org
firefox-addons:802681.description:
Website Theme Manager customizes a website(s) appearance; you can choose your desired style from " userstyles.org " website or write your own.
Note #1: "Website Theme Manager" addon is NOT affiliated with " userstyles.org " website at all. But, users can choose desired styles available in " userstyles.org " and use them with this addon.
Some features:
1. Enables you to easily manage (add, edit or remove) styles.
2. Enhances your browsing experience by allowing you to customize the way a website look.
3. By using custom styles (css) you can change colors, fonts, and almost all HTML contents within a page; meaning completely redesigning the entire page.
4. In order to add styles, there are two options available:
a. writing your custom style (css) or
b. adding it from userstyles.org site. Once you install the addon, please visit userstyles.org and find your desired theme, then click on "Add this Theme" (appears only after you install Website Theme Manager). The theme will be automatically added to the extension's options page, where you can easily edit, remove or inactivate it.
5. Toolbar icon can easily enable or disable the extension.
6. An example of how to add a style is available in the options page (top section).
Note #2: in order to report Bugs, please visit add-on's Homepage and fill the bug report form.

Take your learning with you! Ausmed is a simple way to access a wide range of healthcare knowledge and improve the quality of your care. Plus, it gives you everything you need to meet your CPD requirements.
The latest evidence-based content
All our learning activities are developed with healthcare experts and we regularly review them to ensure you're getting recent and accurate information.
Meet your CPD requirement
You can document your learning to keep track of CPD requirements. Use the learning planning tool to save resources for later, so you don't miss out as you explore our learning catalogue.
Fits in your pocket and your schedule
With our app, you can find time for a little learning whenever it suits you – between shifts, on your commute or over a break.
Your kind of healthcare
Ausmed has a wide library of learning resources that cover topics for Nurses, Midwives, Paramedics, Pharmacists and more! That also includes Healthcare Workers in the Disability, Aged Care, and Community and Home Care sectors.
We're here to help
At Ausmed, we're always looking for ways to improve the quality of your learning and help you use your time efficiently. You can use our learning guides to support your positive habit-building and time management.
Stay in control of your progress
You can manage your own learning reports, which means it's really simple to download and verify that you've met your requirements.
Choose the format that suits you
Depending on how much time you have and how you prefer to learn, you can engage with our learning resources as articles, video lectures or courses.
An Ausmed Subscription gives you
Access to unlimited expert-reviewed learning activities
New and up-to-date learning activities added each week
Access to the Mindfulness Corner with Meditations designed specifically for healthcare professionals

“JOIN is a cycling app for real-li
bluejetty:00086337:ios.description:
With over 400 World Tour-level workouts for road cycling, MTB, and gravel, and running integration, JOIN delivers a personalized and dynamic training plan that adjusts to your availability and performance.
“JOIN is a cycling app for real-life riders. The training app built by professional coaches for every-day cyclists” - BikeRadar
“JOIN completely changed my training approach and helped me reach my best fitness level ever.” - JOIN user
“Dynamic programming is what I was missing since I have an irregular and busy life. JOIN gives me exactly that.” - JOIN user
► New: Running with JOIN
Boost your training with Running on JOIN! Add running sessions to your cycling plan, seamlessly switch workouts, and track progress with the new pace calculator. Easily export your runs to Garmin, Apple Watch, and more. Start mixing up your training and achieve your goals with JOIN!
► Train faster and smarter with the Workout Player
The fastest and easiest way to start your training immediately. Whether you are on the indoor trainer (including ERG mode!) or cycling outside, by connecting all sensors such as heart rate monitor, power meter, cadence meter, or indoor trainer, you see all the useful information on one screen.
► Smart and flexible bike training plan
Do you want to increase your FTP or just get fitter? You choose your goal, and JOIN provides you with the most effective and efficient training plan. The algorithm adapts and tells you how to improve. Injured, sick, or short on time? The training plan is dynamic and will automatically update itself.
► Why riders would be lost without JOIN 
A survey revealed that 80% of users would be disappointed if they could no longer use JOIN. Why? Because JOIN provides the structure, flexibility, and motivation that other training apps lack. Cyclists trust JOIN to deliver dynamic, personalized plans that fit into their busy lives.
► Integrations with your favorite cycling platforms
Training with a bike computer or Zwift? With JOIN, you can easily send all your data to your favorite apps or download your training easily as a .fit file. JOIN works with:
• Zwift
• Strava
• TrainingPeaks
• Garmin Connect
• Wahoo
► Train effectively with the Workout Score™
Finished your training and went all-out? Well done! Based on your data, JOIN analyzes the session and provides a detailed assessment and Workout Score™. This way, you know if you can make your training even more effective next time.
► Period Tracker
This new feature helps female athletes better align their training with their menstrual cycle. By tracking your cycle in the app, you receive training suggestions that consider hormonal changes and fatigue, allowing you to perform at your best. This feature is designed to adapt your personal workout schedule even further based on your natural flow.
► The best Tours, Cyclos, and Gran Fondos
There is nothing more fun than training for a challenging goal like a tour, cyclo, or Gran Fondo. Maybe you are training for the Les Trois Ballons, Marmotte Gran Fondo Alpes of Unbound Gravel. If you follow the JOIN Cycling training plan, it will get you to appear at the start of your challenge in the best possible way.
JOIN has the most popular events ready for you. Found your challenge? Select your goal, and JOIN ensures you are always training efficiently with the comprehensive training plan.
► Try JOIN completely free for 7 days
Unlock all features with the JOIN subscription, including:
• Adaptive training plans
• eFTP prediction
• 400+ bike training sessions in the database
• Adapts to your availability
• Integration with Garmin, Strava, Zwift, and more
Terms & Conditions: https://join.cc/terms_conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://join.cc/privacy_policy/
Join JOIN.cc. Improve your ride.

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts

Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the TrustCBT app, you must be enrolled as a Citizens Bank & Trust digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Do you want a fully custom skin, or do you prefer ready-made templates?
We have hundreds of options for every taste! Start crafting characters exactly the way you imagine them with our intuitive editor. Let your imagination run wild and personalize every detail.
~~~ Features ~~~
– AR mode
– Convenient multi-element editing
– Hundreds of ready-made templates
– Advanced drawing and coloring tools
– AI-powered skin generation

~ Augmented Reality ~
Bring your creations into the real world! The AR feature allows your characters to appear right in your environment. Take creative photos and share them with friends. Edit and customize your skins wherever you are.
~ Huge skin collection ~
A large gallery with unique templates organized into categories such as animals, fantasy, games, movies, anime, and more. Choose any base and transform it however you like.

Work with different parts individually, add accessories, adjust colors, or combine various design layers to build your perfect style.
~ Export your creations ~
Save your skins in a standard image format and keep them ready for use on your device. Your creations remain fully yours.
Download the app and start creating the skins of your dreams!

bluejetty:00088044:ios.summary:
Become a Little Doctor in a Fun and Educational Game for Kids!
Ever dreamt of becoming a doctor? Dive into the immersive world of doctor games and treat kids with various ailments, bringing back their precious smiles. Our interactive child
bluejetty:00088044:ios.description:
Become a Little Doctor in a Fun and Educational Game for Kids!
Ever dreamt of becoming a doctor? Dive into the immersive world of doctor games and treat kids with various ailments, bringing back their precious smiles. Our interactive children's hospital is designed to educate and entertain, blending learning with play.
Oh no! Our friendly giraffe has a fever! Quick, grab an ice pack to cool her down. Did a little girl consume too much sugar and now has cavities? Fret not! With our dentist tools like cavity sprays and tooth extractors, you're well-equipped to handle the situation. Oops, the honey-loving panda got stung by bees! But don’t panic; our clinic provides tweezers to safely remove the stingers.
Experience 24 unique ailments in our minigames, each demanding specific tools for diagnosis and treatment. You'll step into the shoes of a brave and wise doctor, using real medical tools to diagnose conditions. From dental care to treat cavities and thermometers to check if you have a fever, to eye exams to treat red eye, our game has it all. Is it a skin rash or an ear infection? You'll master how to tell them apart and apply first aid accordingly.
What's more? Learn about good health practices and correct lifestyles. This game promotes the joy of helping others, fostering a sense of responsibility and compassion among young players. Our learning games give every child the opportunity to be everyone's favorite doctor. So kids, pick up your medical kit and embark on this educative journey that's both fun and informative!
Game Features
• Rich educational medical content.
• 24 distinct ailments and their corresponding tools.
• Ten diverse patients with entertaining animated expressions.
• Play offline – No internet required.
• Absolutely no third-party ads.
About Yateland
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00090709:ios.summary: Experience the thrill of Through the Wall, the puzzle game that adds a twist of yoga to the mix! This game is designed to test your reflexes, strategy, and flexibility as you navigate through increasingly challenging levels. With vibrant gr
bluejetty:00090709:ios.description:
Experience the thrill of Through the Wall, the puzzle game that adds a twist of yoga to the mix! This game is designed to test your reflexes, strategy, and flexibility as you navigate through increasingly challenging levels. With vibrant graphics and addictive gameplay, Through the Wall is a must-play for puzzle lovers and casual gamers.
In Through the Wall, you control a character who must strike the correct yoga poses to pass through walls of various shapes. The game combines quick reflexes with creative problem-solving, offering a unique and engaging experience.
Key features of Through the Wall include:
- Simple relaxing entertainment: Enjoy a game that is easy to learn but difficult to master.
- Variety of yoga poses: Improve your flexibility and learn new poses as you progress.
- IQ and reflex tests: Sharpen your mind and quicken your reflexes with each level.
- Online and offline gameplay: Play wherever you are, without needing an internet connection.
- Many difficult and addictive levels: Keep challenging yourself with levels that increase in difficulty.
- Beautiful graphics and relaxing music: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning and calming game environment.
- Suitable for all ages: Fun for everyone, from kids to adults.
Can you conquer every level and prove yourself as the ultimate puzzle master? Download Through the Wall today and challenge your brain with hundreds of exciting puzzles. It's time to put your skills to the test and see how far you can go in this thrilling and addictive adventure!

• Game Center achievements with rewards!

bluejetty:00044784:ios.name: Kndrd: Make Friends IRL
bluejetty:00044784:ios.summary: If you’re looking for friends to go to pilates with, grab drinks after work, or check out a concert this weekend, look no further. We’re here to get you out of the house and enjoying life with new friends serendipitously; spontaneity is in
bluejetty:00044784:ios.description:
If you’re looking for friends to go to pilates with, grab drinks after work, or check out a concert this weekend, look no further. We’re here to get you out of the house and enjoying life with new friends serendipitously; spontaneity is in our DNA. Stop swiping, stop scrolling, start doing and find your people – make friends through shared experiences. 
HOW IT WORKS:
- MAKE A PLAN
Propose a plan to the community and instantly find people to go with you. When you make a plan, a group chat automatically generates for you and anyone who joins so that you can chat and coordinate. 
- JOIN A PLAN
Discover fun things to do in your city with people who share your interests. When someone makes a plan, the plan is shared with the community for you to join. At Kndrd, we believe life is better with friends and that friendship is born through shared experiences. 
- GET ADVICE, RECS & SUPPORT FROM THE COMMUNITY
Searching for a doctor, looking for a roommate, selling a couch, or need relationship advice? The Kndrd community has your back. Just post on the Forum and the community will help you find the answers you need. 
- REAL PEOPLE, REAL FRIENDSHIPS
Every person on Kndrd is verified by our team. We all show up as our best selves, ready to have the best time. 
Note: we’re only live in New York City as of now, to keep our initial community small and personal. We review every person who joins and review times may vary, so please be patient. We’ll be launching to other cities and beyond soon – this is just the beginning! 
We can’t wait to meet you, IRL!
xx The Kndrd Team

bluejetty:00088547:ios.summary:
Sandbox with demolition simulation

bluejetty:00088547:ios.description:
Sandbox with demolition simulation
Physically realistic simulator of destruction: release your stress, just chill out and destroy it all down!
Main features:
Sandbox part of the game can be very fun if you know what to tweak and tear down stuff more destructively!
• Slow-motion
- You have the full control over the time rate: slow it down, make it faster or just freeze the simulation
• Burning system
- Fire can burn down wooden constructions. Burn it down!
• Gravity
- Took it all from freezing time... Well, play with low / high gravity or just turn it off like you are in space ;)
• Control of gameplay
- Too many debris on the screen and the game lags? Try debris combination and debris freeze options to improve performance reducing CPU/GPU load 
- Not enough debris? Simply increase destruction resolution
• Guns
- 15 different explosives (missiles, dynamites, cascade grenades)
- Destructive Tornadoes
- Lightnings
- Black holes
- Spikes from hell
- Different sized cannon balls
• Maps
- Destroy over 30+ prebuild map from skyscrapers to ancient structures
- Map editor: Build your own map and save it to one of available slots
- Different terrains to demolish objects on
• Simulator
I have created this game for our personal needs - always dreamed of the game that allows you to destroy buildings, but there wasnt any, sooo... had to do one ourselves : )

bluejetty:00041468:ios.description:
COMMAND THE RESISTANCE. SURVIVE THE SWARM.
Xeno Swarm is a hardcore, top-down sci-fi roguelike shooter where strategy, reflexes, and deep meta-progression are your only hopes against an endless alien annihilation.
NOT JUST ANOTHER SURVIVOR GAME
Dive into a gripping, fully voice-acted sci-fi narrative. You aren't just surviving; you are fighting for the future of humanity. Experience a mature storyline that unfolds as you conquer waves and unlock the secrets of the Xeno menace.
DEEP ROGUELIKE ACTION & BULLET HELL

• Intense Boss Fights: Face massive alien monstrosities that will test your bullet-hell dodging skills to the limit.
UNMATCHED META-PROGRESSION
• Upgrade Everything: Enhance your armor, weapons, and base stats permanently between runs.
• Talent Trees: Customize your playstyle with complex RPG talent trees that reward both aggressive and tactical gameplay.
GUILDS, EVENTS & LIVE OPS
• Form a Guild: Join forces with players worldwide. Complete cooperative guild missions and climb the global leaderboards.
• Weekly Events: Participate in rotating live-ops, seasonal challenges, and limited-time game modes for exclusive epic gear.
The universe is on the brink. Will you lead the charge, or be consumed by the Swarm?

bluejetty:00015158:ios.name: Dictionaries
bluejetty:00015158:ios.summary:
“Dictionaries” is an electronic dictionary viewer app made to allow users to efficiently use various dictionaries. Our popular standalone apps have been integrated into a single app where users can search multiple dictionaries at once.
You
bluejetty:00015158:ios.description:
“Dictionaries” is an electronic dictionary viewer app made to allow users to efficiently use various dictionaries. Our popular standalone apps have been integrated into a single app where users can search multiple dictionaries at once.
You can purchase and use a variety of dictionaries, including English, Japanese, French or other language dictionaries, from the “Dictionary Store” which can be accessed from within the app.
Searches
• Batch Search (Consolidated Search) allows users to search multiple dictionaries at once.
• The display order of dictionaries used in the batch search can be customized.
• The keyboard language switches automatically depending on dictionary search groups.
• Handwriting input is possible for Japanese, Old Japanese, Kanji, Chinese, Korean, and Russian dictionaries.
• Using Pattern Search, users can search for words even if a part of the spelling is unknown.
Trace and Jump
• Users can easily jump to not only other words in the same dictionary but other dictionaries as well simply by tracing words in a definition, allowing users to go on a journey of intellectual curiosity through the dictionary as their hearts desire.
Collection
• Purchased dictionaries are shown as icons on the Collection screen.
• By opening a dictionary from the Collection screen, users can also carefully go through a single dictionary. Even in this case, users can use the “Trace and Jump” function to easily jump to another dictionary.
• The display order of dictionary icons on the Collection screen can be changed to the user's preference.
Bookmarks
• Users can bookmark their favorite words. In addition, users can also efficiently categorize these bookmarks using the Bookmark Folder.
• By turning on Quick Bookmark, users can quickly add/remove bookmarks simply by tapping the Bookmark icon.
Search History
• In History, display frequency is automatically recorded so that users can immediately recognize words they search for repeatedly.
iCloud
• Users can synchronize Bookmark and History data among all devices by turning on iCloud.
Multitasking
• Users can display websites, documents, and more alongside their dictionary by using the Multitasking function on the iPad. By turning on Clipboard Search, users simply have to copy the word they wish to look up in order for the app to find that word in multiple dictionaries.
Substantial Lineup
• The Dictionary Store carries a large number of full-scale dictionaries, and we plan to further improve this selection in the future as well.
• The following English dictionaries are available. Check in the Dictionary Store, which can be accessed from within the app, for more information on each of these items.
- Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary 10th edition (OALD)
- Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English
- Oxford Learner’s Thesaurus
- Oxford Collocations Dictionary
- Practical English Usage
- Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner’s Dictionary 10th edition
- Collins COBUILD Advanced American English Dictionary 3rd edition
- Collins COBUILD Intermediate Learner’s Dictionary 4th edition
- Collins English Dictionary with Thesaurus
An internet connection is required to purchase content.Usage fees and terms of use may apply.

bluejetty:00178914:ios.description:
В Genotek Здоровье можно:
• Задать любой вопрос о здоровье взрослых или детей. Например, врачи подскажут, что делать при ожоге или отравлении, как быть, если ребёнок подвернул ногу или перегрелся на солнце, когда можно посидеть дома, а когда стоит записаться на приём к доктору.
• Расшифровать результаты анализов крови и других исследований. Не нужно искать их названия в интернете и ставить себе диагноз.
• Быстро задать вопрос врачу на экспресс-консультации или подробно расспросить специалиста.
• Проконсультироваться один раз или оформить подписку — так консультация врача обойдётся дешевле.
В Genotek Здоровье консультируют специалисты из клиник Москвы и других городов: терапевты, педиатры, гастроэнтерологи, гинекологи, дерматологи, урологи, аллергологи-иммунологи, неврологи, венерологи, психологи и косметологи. Средний стаж врачей 9 лет, все они прошли тестирование, собеседование и обучение.
График работы дежурных специалистов (по московскому времени)
• Педиатр, терапевт, гинеколог, дерматовенеролог — с 8:00 до 23:00.
Типы консультаций и цены
Экспресс-консультация (10 минут, 749 ₽). Для коротких вопросов к педиатрам, терапевтам или для расшифровки анализов.
Обычная консультация (30 минут, от 1143 ₽). Для подробных расспросов, а также для врачей узких специальностей — таких как неврология, дерматология или венерология.
Если вам нужно несколько консультаций, выгоднее купить одну из подписок:
- «Женское здоровье» — вопросы про беременность и планирование семьи.
- «Детское здоровье» — для родителей.
- «Безлимитные консультации» — для тех, кто внимательно следит за здоровьем.
Пользоваться приложением просто: выберите специалиста и тип консультации, привяжите карту и готовьте вопросы к врачу.
Кроме врачей, в Genotek Здоровье консультируют психологи. Онлайн-сеанс продолжается 50 минут и стоит от 4299 ₽.
Genotek Здоровье — один из первых российских сервисов, вышедших на рынок телемедицины с дистанционными медицинскими консультациями.
Консультации, экспресс-консультации и информационные услуги оказывают ООО «Клиника Генотек Здоровье» и её партнёры
Юридический адрес: Россия, 119021, г. Москва, ул. Тимура Фрунзе, д.11, строение 44, комната 1520
Фактический адрес: Россия, 123098, г. Москва, ул. Маршала Новикова д.17

bluejetty:00160203:ios.description:
From a 5-hour stream to a ready-to-post clip, in 60 seconds.
Eklipse AI scans your full stream, detects your best moments across 1,000+ games, and delivers ready-to-post clips while you're still in your next match.
Every stream has moments worth posting. Most streamers post zero. Not because their content isn't good. Because clipping takes time they'd rather spend streaming. Creators who clip weekly grow significantly faster, short clips are among the top discovery drivers on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Eklipse does 90% of the work. You review and approve. That's it.
HOW IT WORKS
Step 1: Connect once, stream like normal
Link your Twitch, YouTube, Facebook, or Kick account once. Eklipse runs in the background!
Step 2: AI detects, clips, and pre-edits your highlights
Game-specific AI watches your VOD, finds your best moments, formats for vertical, and builds multiple pre-edited versions. Ready while you're still playing.
Step 3: Swipe, approve, post in 30 seconds
Open your clip stack. Clips are ready. Pick one, adjust a caption if you want, and publish to TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Done while your lobby loads.
WHAT EKLIPSE DOES
- AI-highlights: game-specific detection across 1,000+ titles. FPS, MOBA, Battle Royale and more: every key moment scored, ranked, and queued automatically.
- Voice command: say "clip it" mid-stream. Eklipse grabs the moment instantly. No alt-tab, no app switch, no interruption.
- Pre-edit and swipe stack: multiple pre-edited versions queued up. Swipe to pick your best take. The editing is already done.
- Auto-captions, meme templates, overlays: your clip is formatted and ready to post in seconds.
- Direct publish: post to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts in one tap.
- Auto-schedule: connect once, pick a cadence, and Eklipse ships your clips while you sleep, queue, or stream.
- 1,000+ games: COD (Warzone, Modern Warfare), Fortnite, Valorant, Apex Legends, Minecraft, League of Legends, GTA V / FiveM, Overwatch 2, Counter-Strike 2, Marvel Rivals, and hundreds more.
- Console and mobile: works for PS5 and Xbox streamers on Twitch and Kick. No capture card needed. Mobile app lets you review and post from anywhere.
Premium: removes watermark, upgrades to 1080p, adds priority processing and expanded game access.
Your clips are ready before your next match starts.

Terms of Use: https://eklipse.gg/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://eklipse.gg/privacy-policy/

Watch MLB, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, NCAA college football, NCAA college basketball, WNBA, NFL, MLS soccer, F1 racing, the 2026 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Champions League, LaLiga, Bundesliga and more, all live. Plus, stream acclaimed TV series, live news and award-winning movies. Enjoy Unlimited Cloud DVR and dedicated sports pages to watch what you want, when you want.
350+ LIVE TV CHANNELS
Fubo has over 350 TV channels and is the only way to get every Nielsen-rated sports channel without cable. Fubo features ABC, CBS, FOX, ESPN, CBS Sports Network, FS1, NFL Network, NFL RedZone, NBA TV, MLB Network, MLB.TV, NHL Network, beIN SPORTS, SEC Network, ACC Network, Big Ten Network, Willow TV, Tennis Channel, regional sports networks for most local markets.
STREAMING LEADER IN BASEBALL 
Fubo has the most MLB you can watch without cable — more than YouTubeTV or any other streaming provider. Stream MLB Network, FOX and ESPN plus local team coverage on Space City Home Network, YES Network, NESN, MASN, all included in your base plan. (Regional restrictions apply.) You can also watch out-of-market games with MLB.TV. 
ESPN UNLIMITED INCLUDED FREE
Most Fubo plans include access to ESPN+/ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost. This means you get unlimited access to every out-of-market hockey game with NHL Power Play, NCAA sports, LaLiga, PGA Tour golf, tennis, Bundesliga soccer and much more. 
FOX ONE INCLUDED FREE
Most Fubo plans include access to FOX One at no extra cost! FOX One brings together all your favorite FOX channels, includingFOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Weather, FS1, FS2, FOX Business, FOX Deportes, Big Ten Network (BTN), local FOX stations, and FOX Network — all in one place.
THE MOST LOCAL SPORTS FOR THE LOWEST PRICE
With YES Network, MSG Network, NESN, MASN, Marquee Sports Network, Chicago Sports Network, Altitude Sports, Space City Home Network and other regional sports networks, Fubo offers access to most live games and dedicated local coverage of MLB, NBA and NHL teams all season long. (Subject to local availability and blackout restrictions.)
EXTENSIVE LIVE SPORTS COVERAGE & MAJOR EVENTS
NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, PGA golf, WNBA, NASCAR, F1… you name it, we got it. That's over 50,000 live pro and college events — regional to international, including NFL games, MLB games, NBA Finals, NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs, FIFA World Cup, U.S. Open, Triple Crown, Olympics, tennis grand slams, ICC Cricket World Cup and more. Stream it all live.
LIVE SOCCER GAMES FROM AROUND THE WORLD
Watch the 2026 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Champions League, Europa League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Liga MX, MLS and more. Catch El Clásico between Real Madrid and Barcelona and other matches from LaLiga on ESPN Deportes. 
TV SHOWS & MOVIES, LIVE & ON DEMAND
Fubo has over 10,000 hours of on-demand TV shows and movies. So you can catch up on acclaimed series and popular movies on ABC, CBS, FOX, Comedy Central, Ion Television, Hallmark Channel, TV Land, MTV, Disney Channel, Nickelodeon, Bravo, Paramount + with SHOWTIME, FX, Paramount Network, and more.
NEVER MISS ANOTHER PLAY
Unlimited Cloud DVR space is included with every account. Record anything, start watching on one device and finish on any other. Forgot to set the record options? No problem. You can replay nearly any game, show or movie that aired in the last 3 days with 72-hour Lookback.
WATCHING LIVE STREAMS
To watch any streaming service, including Fubo, YouTube TV, ESPN+, Sling TV, Peacock, Paramount+, Netflix, HBO Max, Pluto TV or Amazon Prime Video, a high-speed connection is required. This could be through a mobile data plan or internet provider like Comcast Xfinity or Spectrum.

Privacy policy: https://www.fubo.tv/documents/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00182870:ios.name: Hidden Hotel: Miami Mystery
bluejetty:00182870:ios.summary:
Do you enjoy seek-and-find games where you need to solve mysteries, find hidden clues, search and find hidden objects, and spot the difference? Or do you prefer hotel games where you need to build, design, and renovate? 
Hidden Hotel: Miami
bluejetty:00182870:ios.description:
Do you enjoy seek-and-find games where you need to solve mysteries, find hidden clues, search and find hidden objects, and spot the difference? Or do you prefer hotel games where you need to build, design, and renovate? 
Hidden Hotel: Miami Mystery combines search, detective, hotel, and design games in one! Dive into the world of mysterious adventure right now!
Main features of Hidden Hotel: Miami Mystery
+ Find hidden objects and complete various design tasks
+ Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn graphics 
+ Dive into the captivating storyline
+ Play breathtaking mini-games and events: spot the difference, find silhouettes, game of dice, etc
+ Chat with players and send gifts
+ Stand first on the leaderboard
+ Seek and find online or offline without an Internet connection 
+ Explore lots of levels
+ Use hints
Pro tips to solve the mystery
Search and find like Sherlock
Hidden Hotel game is different from other puzzle games such as Match 3! Here, you’ll find hidden objects concealed within a picture. Feel like a detective from the addictive novels. Keep your brain sharp and find mystery clues in the Hidden Hotel: Miami Mystery game. Solve the mystery, search hidden items, uncover secret rooms, and complete exciting quests. Start with finding tiny clues and solve the great mystery! 
Every detail matters
The difficulty level increases as you search hidden objects in mystery game scenes. Tap and open items to find hidden objects behind them. Pull aside the curtains and open the boxes to reveal which hidden objects are concealed there. It's not simple, but you can do this! Get the highest score for every hidden picture scene, no matter how tricky it is! Hidden Hotel is all about mystery adventures and fun!
Take advantage of hints and boosters
Use search tools if you get stuck. Boosters help you to seek and find hidden objects! Lantern highlights hidden objects. The clock gives some extra time. The keys open 3 items on the location. Radar shows every item in the scene for a second. 
Enjoy different search modes 
Hidden Hotel: Miami Mystery includes a wide variety of mysterious hidden object seek and find modes: word search, cobweb, silhouette, reverse words, spot the difference, and coins. To make things even more exciting, we constantly update our content with brand-new mysteries! Pay attention to all the hidden clues, and Hidden Hotel will reveal its secrets to you! 
Reveal your inner designer talent
The artistically decorated interior in the old mansion mesmerizes from first sight! Seek and find hidden objects, earn stars, pick up the design and renovate the Hidden Hotel to your taste. 
Get ready, your mysterious adventure in this hidden object game is about to begin! Harness your seek-and-find skills and immerse yourself in the world of hidden objects adventure!

bluejetty:00178164:ios.description:
Wolffun proudly presents the modern MOBA experience: Thetan Arena. Combining action-packed 5-minute battles and 27 unique heroes, each hero comes equipped with distinctive abilities and skins, empowering you to craft customized strategies for domination.
Thetan Arena isn't just a game; it's your training ground for the expansive Thetan World ecosystem - which includes popular titles like Thetan Rivals, Thetan Creator, Thetan Immortals, and more on the horizon. Thetan World serves as a smooth entry point into the captivating realm of metaverse gaming. It acts as a link between conventional gaming and technology, allowing you to experience the thrilling MOBA battles and absolute competition aspects of Thetan Arena while delving into the possibilities of grinding rewards through gameplay and owning unique digital assets, all without any distractions.
THE GAME OFFERS SEVERAL MODES:
- Duo Royale: Show how 2 people can make an army, grab your buddy and dominate the battlefield.
- Team Deathmatch: Simple as that, your team must eliminate others as many as possible before time runs out.
- Solo Battle Royale: A free-for-all brawl, try your best to survive by looting boxes, hiding, going on a rampage, or using stealthy action. This mode will literally push you to the limit.
- Tower Defense: A hustle add-on for teamwork, your team must be quick to capture the Battery to summon the Siege Robot and protect your Robot at all costs because it's the only way to destroy the enemy Tower.
- Super Star: Are you willing to sacrifice yourself so your team could win? In this mode, only one player can hold the Super Star at one time; the Super Star will then drop ""point"" stars. Protect your VIP, collect stars, and achieve victory together.
If you like to play with friends, you can also team up with 4 players together for the grand great victory. This is one of the most exciting features of Thetan Arena; working together with your friends to plan and execute your strategy is the key to victory.
BEST FEATURES:
- The game features a wide selection of skills that heroes can use in battle, including effect skills, damage skills, support skills, and unique hero ability skills. These skills allow players to create unique and customized strategies that suit their playstyle.
- Thetan Arena is designed to be fast-paced, and players must be quick and decisive to emerge victorious in battles. With stunning graphics, immersive gameplay, and a diverse range of game modes and heroes, Thetan Arena is the ultimate mobile game for fans of MOBA-style battles.
In summary, Thetan Arena is a mobile game that delivers fast-paced action, thrilling gameplay, and the ability to play with friends. Whether you prefer classic MOBA-style battles, team deathmatch, or free-for-all brawls, Thetan Arena has something for everyone. So, grab some friends and join the battle today, and let your skills and abilities shine as you climb your way to the top of the leaderboard.
MANY OTHER FEATURES:
- Free to play with free heroes and skills.
- Periodically special events: campaign, collection, leaderboard competition.
- Get rewards for every achievement and milestone in your progression.
- Ranking system with generous rewards for top tier players.
- Tournament.
- A healthy and active community.
Let's join Thetan's vibrant communities:
- Discord: https://discord.gg/thetanworld
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/thetan_world
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/thetanworld
- Official Website: https://thetanworld.com/
- Telegram: https://t.me/thetanworldofficial
- Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@ThetanArenaOfficial

bluejetty:00130982:ios.description:
ChatGO is your all-in-one AI companion - write, create, translate, and get things done faster and smarter. 
Powered by GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Grok, it turns everyday tasks into effortless wins: smarter writing, stunning visuals, instant translation, web search, and endless ideas, all in one seamless app.
===== KEY FEATURES =====
Professional Writing Assistant
Instantly craft emails, blog posts, reports, essays, and creative writing with ChatGO. Adjust tone, style, and length to fit your needs.
AI Image Generator
Turn your imagination into reality using the AI image generator built into ChatGO: AI Chatbot Assistant, built on the foundation of GPT-5 and Gemini. Create unique AI art in a variety of styles, including Ghibli-inspired, Cartoon, and Anime, plus personalized images, banners, avatars, designs, and high-quality visuals effortlessly.
AI Logo Maker & Signature Generator
Logo Maker: Instantly create logos for your brand identity: shop signs, business cards, packaging, and marketing materials. No design skills required.
Signature Generator: Generate elegant, personalized signatures for executives, artists, and public figures, including artistic and feng-shui–inspired styles. Perfect for contracts, documents, or personal branding.
Web Search
Get accurate, up-to-date answers instantly. ChatGO combines real-time web search with AI reasoning similar to Grok, so you always find reliable, current information without switching apps.
Voice to Text
Skip the typing. Simply speak, and ChatGO: AI Chatbot Assistant converts your voice into accurate text instantly. Perfect for notes, messages, and hands-free productivity.
Instant Translation & Multilingual Support
Break language barriers with ChatGO. Enjoy real-time translation for text, documents, and content across multiple languages - accurate, fast, and easy.
Smart Math Solver
Solve complex problems in seconds. Simply input your equation, and ChatGO provides step-by-step solutions with explanations that make learning easier and faster.
Chat PDF
Upload any PDF and chat directly with it - ask questions, get instant summaries, and extract key insights from articles, documents, and reports in seconds, so you can focus on what truly matters.
===== WHY CHOOSE CHATGO: AI CHATBOT ASSISTANT? =====
Imagine having a smart AI assistant available 24/7, ready to help you:
Write smarter, faster, and more naturally, powered by GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Grok
Create AI art in Ghibli, Cartoon, Anime, and more styles
Design professional logos and personalized signatures in seconds
Search the web for instant, accurate answers
Chat with your PDFs to summarize and extract key insights instantly
Convert speech to text on the go with voice to text
Translate content in real time across languages
With 100+ ready-to-use prompts, a simple interface, and the power of GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Grok, ChatGO helps you work smarter and create without limits - all in one app.
===== SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS =====

Weekly Plan: $6.99/week

Download ChatGO: AI Chatbot Assistant today and unlock the power to write, create, learn, and work smarter than ever before.
One app. Endless possibilities.
EULA Regulation: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
We are ProX AI. This app is not affiliated with ChatGPT nor claims to be.

Make your pictures move and come to life and make amazing digital arts!

Convert a still picture to amazing video by adding direction pointers.

Blend still images with video to get amazing animation effects.
Create your video stories blending overlay video on still image.

bluejetty:00116837:ios.description:
SPF helps you understand UV conditions and plan your time in the sun with a personalized routine built around your skin type.
WHAT YOU GET WITH YOUR SUBSCRIPTION
- Real-time UV index — see current UV levels for your location
- Personalized tanning routine — tailored to your skin type
- Quick Tan timer — time your tanning sessions
- Tan progress tracking — log your sessions
A clear plan instead of guesswork. Built for people who want structure around their time in the sun.
Download SPF and start building your routine.
— — —
SUBSCRIPTION
SPF is a subscription-based app. An active auto-renewable subscription is required to access app features. SPF Premium is $5.99/week with a 3-day free trial. Pricing and subscription length are also shown in the app before purchase.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID Account Settings.
- Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchase of a subscription.
DATA & PRIVACY
SPF processes facial and skin images on your device to estimate skin attributes (such as tone and skin type) used to personalize your tanning routine. No biometric identification data is collected. All image data is stored exclusively on your device and is deleted when you uninstall the app.
HEALTH & SAFETY NOTICE
SPF provides general guidance based on UV index and weather data. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. UV exposure carries inherent risks, including skin damage, premature aging, and skin cancer. Consult a qualified healthcare professional or dermatologist before making decisions about sun exposure, particularly if you have a history of skin conditions, are taking photosensitizing medications, or have other health concerns. Always follow guidance from medical professionals over recommendations in this app.
WEATHER DATA
SPF uses Apple Weather to provide UV index and weather information. Learn more about Apple WeatherKit at: https://weatherkit.apple.com/legal-attribution.html
