bluejetty:00165509:ios.description:
Easily secure all your passwords, credit cards, addresses, and sensitive information across the web and on any device with Avast Password Manager mobile app*.
SIMPLIFY YOUR LIFE
You no longer have to remember all your passwords or account emails, Avast Password Manager does it for you with our built-in auto-fill feature that pre-fills your login information with a tap.
SECURE YOUR DIGITAL LIFE
Secure your digital life from online threats with our end-to-end, zero-knowledge encryption password vault and built-in password generator that allows you to create strong and unique passwords on the go. With zero-knowledge encryption and two-factor authentication, only you can unlock and access your data, not even Avast has access to your vault. These security measures help keep your data safer from cybercriminals and hacking attempts.
WEAK PASSWORD DETECTION
Our security checks for weak passwords and easily detects and suggests unique, strong passwords, so you don’t have to spend time creating new passwords. 
* Requires your device to have an internet connection. You can easily import your passwords from other browsers and other password managers to Avast Password Manager. All you need is to be on a Mac or Windows and have the extension on your browser. For more details go: https://support.avast.com/en-us/article/2730/
With the free version, we reserve the right to limit the number of entries (like passwords) at any time. This limitation won’t affect any existing entries in your vault. 
PRIVACY POLICY 
AVAST respects the privacy of our users and carefully safeguards personal data. 
By using this add-on, you have read and agree with our General Privacy Policy (https://www.avast.com/privacy-policy) and Products Policy (https://www.avast.com/products-policy).

bluejetty:00121076:ios.description:
Our Coloring app is a digital application designed for people who enjoy coloring as a means of relaxation and stress relief. These apps typically feature a wide range of intricate and detailed designs, ranging from mandalas to floral patterns to abstract shapes, that users can fill in with color using their fingers or a stylus on their device.
The app usually offers a variety of color palettes to choose from, allowing users to create unique and personalized designs. Many apps also provide features such as undo/redo, zooming in and out, and the ability to save and share finished pieces with friends and family.
FEATURES:
- Over 1000 professionally illustrated high-quality pages to color, making this app the largest artwork collection available.
- An extensive range of categories to choose from, including geometric designs, animals, flowers, cartoons, and more.
- 25 preset color palettes with 11 colors in each, as well as the ability to create unlimited custom color palettes.
- Option to paint your own drawings and add your preferred colors.
- Choose from different stickers and background images to compose your drawing.
- Customize your completed image by changing the outlines from black to white or removing them entirely.
- Blend textures to give your artwork a more realistic look after completing the coloring process.
- Add various effects to enhance the image's beauty.
- Easily save and share your artwork with friends and family.
Subscriptions: 
You can choose between subscription options that closely match your needs. 
* Weekly / $2.49
* Monthly/ $6.49
* Yearly/ $24.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: http://mubassher.me/privacy.html
Terms of Use: http://mubassher.me/terms.html
Overall, our app offers a fun and creative way to unwind and reduce stress, all while producing beautiful pieces of art. Whether you are a seasoned artist or a beginner, these apps provide a great way to relax, de-stress, and express your creativity.

bluejetty:00182464:ios.name: Toca Boca Hair Salon 4
bluejetty:00182464:ios.summary: Welcome to Toca Boca Hair Salon 4! Unleash your creativity in the salon and whip up any style you can imagine. Whether you choose a character and create a brand-new look you’ve dreamed up or just see where the tools take you, each makeover
bluejetty:00182464:ios.description:
Welcome to Toca Boca Hair Salon 4! Unleash your creativity in the salon and whip up any style you can imagine. Whether you choose a character and create a brand-new look you’ve dreamed up or just see where the tools take you, each makeover is an adventure. Get creative with makeup, face paint, hair and beard tools, and much more!
Toca Boca Hair Salon 4 is part of Piknik – one subscription, endless ways to play and learn! Get full access to the world's best preschool apps from Toca Boca, Sago Mini, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan.
CUT, COLOR, AND STYLE AT THE HAIR AND BEARD STATION
Trim, shave, and even re-grow hair anywhere on your character’s head! This station has all the hot tools you need for curling, straightening, and texturizing. In the mood to create something colorful? Grab the bottles of hair dye and choose any color of the rainbow for a bold new look. Your hair salon, your rules! 
GET CREATIVE WITH MAKEUP IN THE FACE STATION
Expand your hair salon by purchasing the face station! You’ll find all kinds of makeup in every color for endless makeover options. Create lush lashes with mascara, and pick a tool to put on eyeliner, eyeshadow, or blush! In the mood for a bolder look? Grab the face paints and draw right onto your character’s face for a creative new style that’s anything but boring. 
PICK OUT A NEW OUTFIT AT THE STYLE STATION
What’s a makeover without some new clothes to go with it? There are hundreds of styles to suit that new look at the style station! Change up your character’s outfit, pick out some stickers, and add a finishing touch with accessories like glasses and hats. 
SNAP A PIC IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
Choose a background, watch them strike a pose, and snap a picture of your character’s new style! You can even save a picture of your character’s makeover in a photo book and return to styling them later. 
SCRUB UP SOME SUDS AT THE SHAMPOO STATION
Ready for a fresh start? Wash hair, towel off, and blow dry at the shampoo station. Watch their face paint and makeup drip away so you can create a brand-new look at the salon!
PRIVACY POLICY
All of Toca Boca’s products are COPPA-compliant. We take privacy very seriously, and we’re committed to providing safe and secure apps for kids that parents can trust. To learn more about how we design and maintain safe games for kids, please read our - 
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use
ABOUT TOCA BOCA 
Toca Boca is an award-winning game studio that makes digital toys for kids. We think playing and having fun is the best way to learn about the world. Therefore we make digital toys and games that help stimulate the imagination, and that you can play together with your kids. Best of all – we do it in a safe way without third-party advertising.

bluejetty:00032999:ios.name: CAMPS: Camping Australia Wide
bluejetty:00032999:ios.summary: Camp Australia your way: find somewhere to camp tonight, or plan your next adventure. Discover 16,000+ verified campsites, campgrounds, free camping destinations and caravan parks across Australia, every one personally checked by Camps Aust
bluejetty:00032999:ios.description:
Camp Australia your way: find somewhere to camp tonight, or plan your next adventure. Discover 16,000+ verified campsites, campgrounds, free camping destinations and caravan parks across Australia, every one personally checked by Camps Australia Wide.
Anyone can list a campsite but we actually go there. The Camps team has been on the road since 1992, and we still visit each site to check the facilities work and photograph what it's really like. No paid listings, ever.
Start your 7-day free trial today and camp in places others only dream about. Then continue to enjoy all app features with one low annual subscription.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
* 16,000+ campsites and caravan parks, each one personally checked
* Verified facilities, amenities & directions for every site
* Camps Legend, our campsite finder and trip planner
* GPS and HEMA map coordinates
* Book campsites direct in the app
* Offline maps for when there's no signal
* 1,100+ public dump points and 570+ official water refill points
* Live fuel and gas prices so you always find the cheapest deal near you
* Latest site reviews, videos and photos
* Aussie camping news
* Exclusive discounts on fuel, holiday parks, gear, servicing and insurance
NEW: CAMPS LEGEND
A map gives you a line between two points. Legend plans you a trip you can actually camp. Tell it where you're going: "Brisbane to Cairns. Two weeks. No more than 200 km a day. Powered sites, and we tow 7m's." Legend builds the trip and fills it with verified campsites that suit your vehicle dimensions, facility requirements and park memberships. Every stop comes from our own database, not a public map, so you can pull into every site with confidence.
EVERY KIND OF PLACE TO STAY
* Free camping, budget and low-cost camp sites
* Caravan parks, holiday parks and RV parks
* National parks campgrounds
* State forest and nature reserve camping
* Beach, bush and 4WD access camping
* Showground and recreation ground camping
* Farm and station stays
* Pub and hotel camping
* Pet friendly sites
* Rest areas, day use areas and information centres
* Includes every site from CAMPS 13 and Caravan Parks 7
ACROSS EVERY STATE
Free camping in Queensland, national parks in NSW, caravan parks in Victoria, beach camping in WA, bush camping in the Northern Territory, the South Australian outback and Tasmania. Find campsites and campgrounds in every state and territory.
ALL THE SITE DETAILS YOU NEED
Everything about a site: address, contact info, directions, facilities, amenities, community reviews, photos, prices, vehicle suitability and more. We even tell you if it has a view, mobile phone coverage, is seasonally closed, is near the road, or only accessible in dry weather.
POWERFUL SEARCH AND FILTERS
Chat with our search tool or filter by site type, camping set-up (caravan, motorhome, camper trailer, RV, big rig, 4WD or tent), price, pet friendly, facilities, stay length & holiday park network to find exactly what suits you.
PERSONALLY CHECKED, ALWAYS
We assess every site against 12 criteria including access, facilities, noise, safety, phone signal and whether the price matches what you get. If a camp closes or changes, we update it. We've never been owned by a caravan park chain and never taken a paid listing.
GO WITH MATES
Invite friends to a trip, share and follow itineraries, and send a campsite straight to someone else.
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Ask questions, get answers from travellers who are out there now, and share your own photos and reviews.
DOWNLOAD NOW
Whether you're heading out on the "big lap", a road trip or just a weekend away, let Camps guide you: the camping app Australians have trusted since 1992. Start with a free 7-day trial, then one low annual subscription. Cancel any time in your account settings. One subscription covers everything above, Camps Legend included.
LOVE THE CAMPS APP?
Please leave us a quick star rating on the app store. We really appreciate it.
NEED SUPPORT?
Reach us at info@campsaustraliawide.com

bluejetty:00119352:ios.name: Windows App Mobile
bluejetty:00119352:ios.summary: Windows App Mobile for iOS and iPadOS (previously named Remote Desktop Mobile) is your gateway to securely connect to Windows including remote PCs and admin-provided virtual apps and desktops across Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Dev B
bluejetty:00119352:ios.description:
Windows App Mobile for iOS and iPadOS (previously named Remote Desktop Mobile) is your gateway to securely connect to Windows including remote PCs and admin-provided virtual apps and desktops across Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Dev Box and Remote Desktop Services.
Embrace the simplicity of a unified client with Windows App Mobile and connect to your Windows in the cloud with ease and security, from the device of your choice. 
GET STARTED
• Learn more about the features of Windows App Mobile at https://aka.ms/WindowsApp.
• Configure your PC for remote access using the information at https://aka.ms/rdsetup.
KEY FEATURES
• Access remote PCs running Windows Professional or Enterprise and Windows Server.
• Access managed resources published by your admin.
• Connect through a Remote Desktop Gateway.
• Simplified management of your connections and credentials from the Connection Center, including a Favorites page to cater to your unique workflow needs.
• Audio and video streaming.
• Redirect folders, your clipboard, and local devices such as microphones and cameras.
• Connect your iPhone or iPad to an external monitor.
• Easily switch between Entra accounts.
• Dynamically switch between Portrait and Landscape mode.
By downloading Windows App Mobile, you agree to the license (see https://aka.ms/WindowsAppLicense) and privacy terms (see https://aka.ms/privacy).

🧱 Block Crazy Robo World Craft – Unleash your creativity in a futuristic voxel universe!
Step into an open-world sandbox where robots meet blocks. Craft, build, and explore limitless possibilities in a world full of tech, creativity, and imagination. Design futuristic bases, high-tech cities, and robotic landscapes in a fully customizable 3D environment.
🔑 Key Features:
🛠️ Build & Create Freely
Construct anything you dream of! From robot factories and tech towers to epic cities and homes using hundreds of futuristic blocks.
🤖 Futuristic Robo World
Explore a world where technology and block-building collide! Discover robotic zones, digital landscapes, and secret AI labs.
🔨 Craft & Mine Resources
Collect materials like metal, circuits, stone, and ores to craft tools, blocks, and robotic decorations.

Change terrains, install neon lights, add sci-fi decorations, and create your dream robotic world.
👾 Survival & Creative Modes
Play in Creative Mode to build freely or Survival Mode to gather resources and craft gear to thrive.
🌐 Multiplayer Experience
Collaborate with friends and build robot-themed worlds together in multiplayer mode.
❓ Why Play Block Crazy Robo World Craft?
🚀 Tech-Driven Creativity: Build cyber worlds with sci-fi blocks and robot elements.
🎮 Fun for Everyone: Easy to play, suitable for kids, teens, and adults.
🌍 Massive Open Sandbox: Travel through high-tech biomes while building futuristic creations.
📥 Download Block Crazy Robo World Craft now and start building your robotic paradise today!

bluejetty:00153563:ios.description:
Cosmy is your astrology app for unique birth chart insights, zodiac sign compatibility, moon phases to inspire your rituals, and mental health guidance.
Cosmy is your free daily space for astrology, wellness, and cosmic self-reflection—designed to help you feel aligned, supported, and inspired every single day. Whether you’re curious about Zodiac guidance, exploring your birth chart, or building simple rituals that fit your life, Cosmy turns astrological insights into practical moments of clarity you can actually use.
Start your morning with personalized horoscopes crafted for your energy, mood, and unique birth chart. Cosmy blends modern astrology with gentle daily practices to help you slow down, reconnect, and move with intention. From aries and taurus to gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, and pisces—every sign receives thoughtful insights that feel warm, uplifting, and real.
Track how each Moon phase shapes your emotions, focus, and creativity. With our detailed Lunar Calendar, you’ll understand how lunar cycles influence your rhythm and how small rituals can help you stay grounded. Follow daily Moon phase reminders, free mood reflections, and cosmic prompts designed to support your mindset.
Explore deeper astrological tools with Cosmy’s AI companion. Ask anything about your Zodiac traits, horoscopes, Compatibility insights, tarot card meanings, or how your unique birth chart influences your relationships. Get personalized suggestions for self-care, Meditation, and everyday practices that align with your energy.
Cosmy makes love and friendship easier to understand with Compatibility readings based on Star Signs and full astrological charts—not just your sun sign. Whether you’re checking Chemistry with someone new or strengthening a long-term relationship, Cosmy helps you see where your energies connect and how to grow together.
Tap into calming Meditation sessions inspired by astrology themes, Moon phase cycles, and reflective rituals. Enjoy free moments of grounding whenever you need them, alongside astrological affirmations that brighten your mindset.
If you’re new to astrology, Cosmy keeps everything simple and welcoming. If you’re experienced, you’ll love exploring your birth chart, your unique birth chart patterns, and guided interpretations across Zodiac themes. You can also save bonds with friends, compare Compatibility, and explore Tarot spreads with intuitive tarot card insights.
Cosmy includes:
• Free daily horoscopes and Moon phase guidance
• Personalized insights based on your astrological placements
• A full Lunar Calendar for rituals and reflections
• Compatibility tools for love, friendships, and Star Signs
• Meditation prompts and practices for emotional balance
• Tarot spreads with easy tarot card meanings
• Birth chart exploration with unique birth chart guidance
• Shareable cosmic moments—perfect for journaling or sending to friends
Cosmy is more than an astrology app—it’s your calm, cosmic companion for building small, meaningful rituals that fit your real life. Let daily practices, gentle reminders, and free guided insights help you feel more connected to yourself, your goals, and the universe around you.
And as you use Cosmy each day, you’ll begin to notice subtle shifts—more clarity in your decisions, more patience with your feelings, and more trust in your own timing. The experience is intentionally soft and supportive, giving you space to breathe, reflect, and move at your own pace. With time, these tiny moments of awareness begin to build a deeper sense of confidence and alignment, turning your everyday routine into something more intentional and meaningful.
Download Cosmy and let the stars support your journey—one mindful moment at a time.

bluejetty:00127010:ios.description:
Teach Me Physiology provides students, doctors, and health professionals with a comprehensive and concise overview of key physiological concepts.
Includes an integrated textbook, full-colour HD illustrations, and a bank of almost 1000 multiple-choice questions - download to get started today!
ABOUT TEACH ME PHYSIOLOGY:
Teach Me Physiology is a comprehensive, easy-to-read physiology reference. Each topic combines detailed physiological concepts with high-yield medical and clinical insights, seamlessly bridging the gap between scholarly learning and improved patient care.
Teach Me Physiology is a great teaching and learning tool for students, educators, healthcare professionals and patients - or simply those who want to understand how the body works!
FEATURES:
+ CONCISE AND EASY-TO-READ PHYSIOLOGY ENCYCLOPAEDIA: Contains over 200 comprehensive articles covering key physiological concepts, with more to come.
+ HD ILLUSTRATIONS: Full-colour illustrations and diagrams help explain complex physiological processes clearly.
+ INTEGRATED CLINICAL KNOWLEDGE: Clinical relevance textboxes link the fundamentals of physiology to medical practice.
+ QUESTION BANK: Over 900 multiple-choice questions with explanations to consolidate your physiology knowledge, with ongoing development.
+ OFFLINE STORE: Learn anytime, anywhere - all articles, illustrations and quiz questions are stored offline for instant access.
+ ALL KEY SYSTEMS OF THE HUMAN BODY: Includes Biochemistry, Histology, Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Gastrointestinal, Endocrine, Reproductive, Immunology, Haematology, and Neurology.
PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP:
Teach Me Physiology offers premium membership via an in-app subscription. Premium membership grants access to premium physiology learning content and question bank features.
You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings any time after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
See our terms of service here: https://teachmephysiology.com/terms-and-conditions-of-subscription-materials/

bluejetty:00183051:ios.name: Carnage: Battle Arena
bluejetty:00183051:ios.summary:
Strap yourself in and enter the arena! Carnage is a high-octane car combat game with a multitude of game modes. Choose the way you want to create chaos and battle it out against other players in real time multiplayer!
FEATURES:
▶ 84 AWESOM
bluejetty:00183051:ios.description:
Strap yourself in and enter the arena! Carnage is a high-octane car combat game with a multitude of game modes. Choose the way you want to create chaos and battle it out against other players in real time multiplayer!
FEATURES:
▶ 84 AWESOME CARS: Sports cars, muscle cars, SUVs, trucks, and more!
▶ MULTIPLE GAME MODES: Battle Arena, Racing, Survival and more!
▶ EXTENSIVE DESTRUCTION MODEL: Cause havoc in the environments
▶ UNIQUE VISUAL STYLE: Blocky, retro-styled graphics
▶ DOZENS OF MAPS: Drive in a park, on a football field, even in the clouds
▶ GAME-CHANGING POWER-UPS: Use them to turn the tide of battle
Download Carnage now and discover a new kind of racing game! Driving fast and getting to the finish line is only one of the multiple challenges that await you. Your reflexes will be put to the test as you fight for dominance against other players in real-time multiplayer.
Wreak havoc on the streets thanks to the extensive destruction model that lets you not only damage vehicles, but also cause visible changes in the environment. After a long battle, the location will look nothing like it used to at the start!
The game features a multitude of different modes. In Death Match League you will fight against other players, destroying their cars for points. Racing pits you against 8 people in a speed contest, Survival is a battle-royale-like combat match to the last man standing, Score battle makes you find collectible for points and Freedrive allows you to explore the game’s maps at your own pace.
You can also complete Challenges that guide you through the game and help you discover all it has to offer. In addition to that, there’s a new Ranked Daily Challenge you can participate in every day to compete with players worldwide for awesome rewards!
Whichever mode you choose, get ready for loads of adrenaline-pumping action! Start Carnage now!
IGRS rating: 13+

- Remote capture
- View full resolution images with meta data and histogram
- Movie Recording
- Automatic Focus Stacking
- Intervalometer (Time-Lapse)
- Bulb Mode

- Send images to multiple devices

See https://camranger.com for full details and supported cameras

• Make your commute more social (and sustainable)
• Help reduce traffic and emissions across North America

bluejetty:00170447:ios.description:
Playground is the leading early childhood management system used by hundreds of thousands of child care providers, teachers, and families. It is an all-in-one platform for child care operations & family connection
From classrooms to the front office to families at home, Playground gives everyone the tools they need to stay in sync, reduce administrative overhead, and create better child care experiences. Get real-time access to daily activity updates, billing, enrollment, compliance, messaging, and more. Directors save hours of admin work per week. Families get a window into their child’s day. Teachers spend less time on paperwork and more time teaching.
FAMILY EXPERIENCE
- Engage families with a single platform that makes communication effortless and meaningful.
- Real-time activity feed (meals, naps, diapering, potty, sunscreen)
- Daily reports with photos, videos, and notes
- Personalized calendars and newsletters
- Digital paperwork and e-signatures
- In-app messaging, announcements, and RSVPs
- Mobile check-in/out with ETA sharing
- Tuition billing and payment in one place
CENTER OPERATIONS
- Manage daily workflows across every area of your program, from check-in to licensing reports.
- Digital attendance & live ratio tracking
- Staff clock-in/out & timecards
- Pay staff and file payroll taxes
- CACFP and subsidy tracking
- Paperwork automation and custom packets
- Late pickup fee automation
- Allergy alerts and food program tracking
- Licensing-ready reports
LEARNING & OBSERVATION
- Support child development and curriculum planning with tools that work for teachers and families.
- Lesson plan builder and internal curriculum bank
- State standard alignment or custom domains
- Developmental milestone tracking
- Child development reports
- Activity observations with media
- Easy family sharing
ENGAGEMENT & COMMUNICATION
- Keep families informed and staff aligned—with minimal lift.
- Messaging, daily student feed, branded email newsletters, and SMS announcements
- Staff and family communication
- Scheduled posts and approval settings
- Media gallery and downloadable content
- Engagement dashboard with classroom and student-level insights
REPORTING & COMPLIANCE
- Replace clunky systems with one fast, customizable reporting suite.
- Customizable, real-time reports across billing, attendance, staff time, food, and more
- Exportable and printable reports for licensing and audits
- Ratio alerts and missing signature flags
Whether you’re a parent checking in from your phone or a director running a multi-site operation, Playground brings clarity, connection, and control to every part of your day.
Download Playground today and experience the difference.

bluejetty:00045112:ios.description:
Web development tools for iOS.
Inspect is a web inspector for iOS that provides desktop-class developer tools, right in the app. No need for remote debugging, connecting to a desktop, proxies, or remote systems. 
Included are:
- JavaScript console.
- HTML element inspection and editing (with live preview).
- CSS inspection and editing (with live preview).
- View element details: CSS rules, JavaScript properties, dimension statistics, and more.
- Open files and folders from other apps (like Working Copy), or from iCloud to test locally.
- Network panel, displaying page headers and XHR requests.
- Responsive design tools: View your site with a variety of mobile and desktop sizes and orientations, including support for custom sizes and user agents.
- Cookies, local storage, and session storage inspector and editor.
- Resource graph.
- View raw page source.
- Control over browser operation: disable JavaScript, cache, and clear cache and cookies to test various operations and states.
- Save a screenshot of your site, including the ability to save the full page.

bluejetty:00183087:ios.description:
From the makers of Candy Crush Saga & Farm Heroes Saga comes Blossom Blast Saga, a free-to-download linker game! Match and link your way through tons of flower-filled gardens to make colorful buds blossom into beautiful flowers before you run out of moves!
Link 3 or more flowers of the same type to make them grow and watch as you set off an exciting chain-reaction of blooming flowers! Blast through a huge selection of matching puzzle games but watch out for weeds!
Blossom Blast Saga features:
Connect Flowers and Make Them Pop!
• Blossom Blast is simple to learn, fun to play but challenging to master!
• Link 3 or more flowers of the same color and make the last flower in the chain blossom
• Match flowers with gorgeous graphics and beautiful blossom effects set in exquisite gardens
• Clear entire flowerbeds for game assists like 'Awesome Blossom!' and ‘Flower Power!’
Adventure in the Garden!
• Join Blossom as she travels over 600 fun garden levels
• Explore puzzle levels like Dreamy Meadow, Carnival Garden and much more
4 Exciting Game Modes!
• Collect Flowers Mode: Link colored flowers in a specific sequence 
• Scoring Mode: Match 3 of the same colored flowers to get more points
• Remove the Weeds Mode: Try to link surrounding flowers to remove weeds from the garden
• Big Bud Mode: Connect big buds of the same color to blossom nearby flowers until the bud’s number reaches zero
Connect with Your Friends Online
• Keep an eye on your friends and competitors when you connect to online leaderboards!
• Link the game between devices and unlock full game features when connected to the Internet
Match your way through delightful gardens, link together sequences of beautiful flowers, enjoy challenging puzzle games and connect with friends to share your flower matching experience in Blossom Blast Saga!
Download Blossom Blast Saga for free and watch flowers bloom on your screen!
Already a fan of Blossom Blast Saga? Like us on Facebook or follow us on Twitter for the latest news:
facebook.com/BlossomBlastSaga
twitter.com/blossomblast
Blossom Blast Saga is completely free to play but some optional in-game items will require payment.

If you wish to exercise your Do Not Sell My Data rights, you can do so by contacting us via the in game help centre or by going to https://soporto.king.com/
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Blossom Blast Saga!

bluejetty:00170372:ios.summary:

Dive into the enchanting world of the Smurfs and discover a compilation of fun and educational mini-games designed to entertain and enrich the minds in a safe and cr
bluejetty:00170372:ios.description:
Welcome to the amazing collection of educational games from The Smurfs!
Dive into the enchanting world of the Smurfs and discover a compilation of fun and educational mini-games designed to entertain and enrich the minds in a safe and creative environment.
It's time to experience a magical learning journey with your favorite characters from the Smurfs: The Lost Village animated series: Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Grouchy, and the rest of the blue Smurf family!
MINI-GAMES FOR EDUCATIONAL FUN
Explore the Lost Village in the forest of the little blue creatures and enter the different mushroom houses to discover educational games that will capture the imagination. The perfect entertainment for them to have fun and develop cognitive skills.
The game includes the following mini-games:
- Memory Cards - Find the matching cards and make pairs with the adorable inhabitants of Smurf Village. This classic card game is ideal for developing visual memory while you are playing.
- Hidden Object: Find the hidden objects in the charming scenes from the Smurfs animated series and stimulate observation and concentration.
- Dominoes: Learn to count and make strategic decisions while enjoying an exciting domino game featuring Smurf characters.
- Drawing & Coloring: Let your creativity run wild as you color your favorite Smurfs and bring the Smurf Village to life with your favorite colors.
- Puzzles: Solve puzzles of different shapes and difficulty levels to reveal an image of The Smurfs. Ideal for fostering problem-solving and coordination skills.
- Word Search: Find the hidden words in the word search and expand your vocabulary by learning new words.
- Maze: Solve mazes and help the Smurfs find incredible prizes along the way.
- Pizza Cooking Game: Learn to select the right ingredients to make delicious pizzas for the Smurfs of the Lost Village.
- Music and Instruments: Explore the world of music as you play instruments alongside the Smurfs and create magical melodies.
- Numbers & Counting: Strengthen your number skills with this interactive math game where you help the evil Gargamel and his cat Azrael create magic potions.
FEATURES OF THE SMURFS: EDUCATIONAL GAMES
- Official The Smurfs game 
- Educational fun games 
- Wide variety of didactical mini-games
- Colorful and attractive graphics from the animated series
- Ideal for learning and developing skills
- Simple and intuitive interface
This collection of mini-games offers an educational and entertaining environment where you can learn and grow while enjoying the beloved blue characters from the animated series Smurfs: The Lost Village.
Immerse yourself in the Smurf Village today for an exciting educational adventure!
ABOUT EDUJOY
Thank you very much for playing Edujoy games. We love creating fun and educational games for people of all ages. If you have any questions or suggestions about this game you can contact us through the developer's contact or through our profiles on social networks: edujoygames
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00032349:ios.summary:

• Tired of digging through sofa cushions for a lost remote? With this app, a fully functional remot
bluejetty:00032349:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone and iPad into a universal remote control and companion for smart televisions and streaming devices.
Simplify Entertainment
• Tired of digging through sofa cushions for a lost remote? With this app, a fully functional remote control is always a tap away.
• Set up your TV in 30 seconds or less.
Universally Compatible
• All major brands of TVs and streaming devices supported. See our full list below. 
Multi-Device Support
• Control all your TVs and devices in one place. One tap switches between them.
• You can even make a "combo" remote that controls your TV and streaming stick together - no juggling.
Captions and Subtitles, on the side
• Instead of covering the movie action with text, display captions and subtitles on your second screen: an iPhone or iPad.
Easy navigation control
• With an integrated d-pad / touchpad, you can tap or use swipe gestures to navigate TV menus.
• Designed so your eyes stay on the TV screen, not your phone.
• One long swipe skips multiple steps at once.
Time Jumper for YouTube
• Get to the good parts of a YouTube video like a pro.
• Slide slowly for precision control over the current play position.
• Flick fast to leap across to different scenes.
Photo and Video Casting
• Throw your photos and home movies onto the big screen in seconds.
Keyboard Input and Voice Search
• Type on your TV with the iOS keyboard under your fingertips — or just speak.
Design Your Perfect Remote
• Make quick access buttons for your favorite TV apps and inputs.
• Launch apps like YouTube, Netflix, HBO Max, and Disney with one tap.
• Direct switch to TV inputs/sources like HDMI1, HDMI2, or Antenna (“Live TV”).
• Go minimal or load it up with all the buttons.
• Style your remote in finishes like Space Gray, Silver, Gold, Rose Gold, and Obsidian.
All the Regulars
• Power on/off. This app uses Wake-on-LAN (WoL) to power on TVs that support it.
• Standard media buttons like play, pause, rewind and fast-forward.
• Change channels with channel up/down buttons and numpad.
• Audio buttons for volume control and mute. On remote controls for streaming devices, these buttons can control the companion TV.
How Does This App Work?
• It connects with your TV securely on your home wireless network. It doesn’t use IR (Infrared) like a traditional remote control.
• It uses Apple Bonjour (zeroconf) and UPnP discovery to find devices on your home network automatically.
• Some surprise benefits of Wi-Fi control: 
 + You don’t need to point your phone at the TV for it to work.
 + There is no cross-interference between two TVs.
 + If your roommate is playing the TV too loud, turn it down from the other room.
Compatibility
Supported platforms
• Roku
• Google TV
• Fire TV OS
• Samsung Tizen
• LG WebOS
Supported devices
• Amazon Fire TV Stick
• Roku Streaming Stick
• Google Chromecast
• Nvidia Shield
• Xiaomi Mi TV Stick
Supported TV sets
• Samsung (2016+)
• LG
• Sony
• Vizio (2016+)
• TCL
• Hisense
• Sharp
• Toshiba
Also: Philips, Insignia, Panasonic, JVC, RCA, Onn, Element, Magnavox, Grundig, Onida, OnePlus, Realme, Xiaomi, Skyworth, Blaupunkt, Metz, XGIMI, Haier, Pioneer, Westinghouse
This app is not affiliated with the TV brands mentioned here. All trademarks are property of their respective owners.
We try to make the most out of the functionality offered by the TV platform for control by apps. But the capabilities offered vary by manufacturer and model. So some of the remote control features listed here may not be available for your TV.

bluejetty:00074389:ios.description:
Simple, beautiful, and easy-to-read surf forecasts designed by surfers, for surfers.
Epic Surf Report is the ultimate surf forecast app, crafted to give you the most important surf conditions with minimal effort. Whether you’re a seasoned surfer or planning your next session, Epic delivers everything you need: tide charts, wind direction, swell alerts, and 7-day detailed forecasts—all in a sleek, user-friendly interface.
__________________
Why Choose Epic?
 • At-a-glance critical surf conditions for your favorite spots
 • Stunning visualizations for tides, swell, wind, and more
 • Alerts for personalized ideal surfing conditions
 • Widgets for instant updates on your home screen
 • Full-screen charts and long-range forecasts
Built with love for surfers, Epic simplifies your surf planning and helps you catch the perfect wave!
__________________
Core Features
== Spot View ==
Quickly check today’s surf conditions:
 • Overview of current swell, wind, and tide
 • Personalized highlighting of ideal spot conditions
 • Swell Evolution: Hourly changes throughout the day
 • Wind Insights: Direction, speed, and gusts
 • Tide Timings: Current levels and upcoming tides
== Detailed Metrics ==
Access accurate surf reports with:
 • Swell height (combined, primary, secondary, wind swell)
 • Swell period, direction, and energy
 • Wind speed, gusts, and currents
 • Tide charts and astronomy data
== 7-Day Forecast ==
Plan ahead with detailed forecasts for the week:
 • Swell, wind, tide, weather, and astronomy info in one view
 • Color-coded scales for key surf windows
 • Customizable layout to match your preferences
== Full-Screen Charts ==
Dive deeper into surf data with interactive charts for today and the week:
 • Swell height, period, and energy metrics
 • Wind speed, gusts, and currents
== Widgets ==
Stay updated at a glance with home screen widgets:
 • Today’s Swell
 • Today’s Wind
 • Current Tide
== Custom Alerts ==
Get notified when conditions match your preferences:
 • Define spot-specific ideal surf conditions
 • Set notification timings that work for you
== Spot Search & Map ==
Find your favorite surf spots or discover new ones:
 • Search by spot name or nearby location
 • Browse and tap on an interactive map
== Offline Access ==
Access forecasts even without an internet connection.
__________________
== Trusted Data Sources ==
We use reliable data from sources like NOAA Wavewatch 3, NOAA GFS, Météo-France, UK MetOffice, and more for accurate forecasts. Tide predictions come from global tidal datasets and local tide station data.
__________________
== Free vs. Premium Features ==
Epic Surf Report allows free usage with limited functionality. Upgrade to Premium for full access:
 • 7-Day Forecasts
 • Advanced swell metrics 
 • Frequent data refreshes
 • Unlimited spots
 • Custom alerts for ideal conditions
 • Widgets for multiple spots
 • Ad-Free Experience
Choose your upgrade option:
 • Flexible subscriptions
 • One-time lifetime access for unlimited use
__________________
== Subscription & Lifetime Access Terms ==
 • Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
 • Manage subscriptions or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
 • Lifetime access requires a single, one-time payment—no recurring charges.
 • Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon subscription or lifetime purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://goepic.surf/Privacy-Policy.html
Terms of Use: https://goepic.surf/Terms-of-Use.html

bluejetty:00183233:ios.description:
SideChef’s 18,000 step-by-step recipes help you get from “what’s for dinner?” to cooking your next meal in just minutes. Filter by diet and preferences, search by ingredients, create a grocery list, and instantly shop ingredients from your favorite grocer. Called “best app” by USA Today and the New York Times’s “favorite cooking app,” SideChef empowers you to eat healthier, save money, and live your most delicious life.
PERSONALIZED RECIPE RECOMMENDATIONS
Quickly find recipe inspiration tailored to your preferences. Filter by dietary requirements, allergies, food preferences, and ingredients you already have at home to find a recipe you like in less than one minute.
ONE-CLICK GROCERY SHOPPING
Easily create a grocery list, and shop ingredients directly from Instacart, Walmart, Amazon Fresh, Target, and more online grocers. Ingredients are intelligently matched to in-store products, and updated with real-time prices and availability. Make smarter decisions by seeing the percentage of each ingredient used in a recipe – an easy way to plan for leftovers and minimize food waste, while also saving money.
GREAT FOR BEGINNERS
New to cooking? Our step-by-step recipes include an image or video at every cooking step so you know exactly what to do. Built-in timers ensure you never overcook anything again, while how-to videos teach you valuable culinary skills – from how to properly dice an onion, to how to press tofu. Rate recipes, upload photos, exchange tips, and share cooking fails and successes with the SideChef home cooking community.
EASY MEAL PLANNING
Use our meal planning tool to select recipes for the week, or save appealing recipes to your cookbook. Browse thousands of curated recipe collections and meal plans for more inspiration and ideas on what you’ll cook next.
RECIPES FOR EVERYONE
Personalized recipe recommendations for these diets and allergens: Vegan, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Low-Carb, Paleo, Keto, Gluten, Egg, Dairy, Soy, Peanut, Tree Nuts, Fish, Shellfish
Recipes cover a variety of cuisines: American, Italian, Mediterranean, Mexican, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indian, French, and more! Browse recipes from your favorite culinary influencers – top food bloggers, writers, and renowned chefs.
PRAISE FROM MEDIA
“If you’re always scorching the stew and you just can’t seem to achieve perfectly puffed chocolate chip cookies, let this free app serve as your new cooking companion.” — Real Simple
“If you’ve ever ruined an entire meal because of a seemingly tiny mistake in timing or ingredient proportioning, then we have an app for you.” — Business Insider
_________________
By downloading and using this app or purchasing a SideChef Premium subscription, you are agreeing to the SideChef terms of use and service: https://www.sidechef.com/terms
For more information about how we use your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.sidechef.com/privacy-policy. By downloading this app, you acknowledge the terms of our Privacy Policy.
SIDECHEF PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
SideChef is free to download and use. Should you choose to upgrade to SideChef Premium, we offer two auto-renewing subscription options:
* Monthly SideChef Premium subscription: $4.99 USD. Cancel anytime.
* Annual SideChef Premium subscription: $49.99 USD. Cancel anytime.
These auto-renewing subscription plans renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew each month or year 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.

bluejetty:00165231:ios.name: Sync for DJI: Go Mobile First
bluejetty:00165231:ios.summary: Sync for DJI is the first app in AppStore that lets you easily download and share captured media from your DJI device directly to Instagram, Facebook, or simply save it to Camera Roll. Sync for DJI runs equally well even in the background.
bluejetty:00165231:ios.description:
Sync for DJI is the first app in AppStore that lets you easily download and share captured media from your DJI device directly to Instagram, Facebook, or simply save it to Camera Roll. Sync for DJI runs equally well even in the background. Support of 4K, H.265, DNG files, etc. - a high bar that beats DJI Go 4 possibilities.
All you need is to open the app after the flight, select new footage, and tap ‘Share’ or ‘Download.’ That's it! Sync for DJI will do this in the background while you use other apps or even if you go on to preview your media on the connected DJI drone or Osmo! Forget about PC or Mac with an SD-card reader for downloads. You can now do this with our advanced app!
Made by the die-hard fans of DJI production, Sync for DJI is a number one app for any DJI device, even for Osmo Pocket (Osmo Pocket support coming soon). We want to eliminate the need for unwieldy and heavy Mac/PC, especially if you are on vacation or want to edit/share your media with the help of an iPhone or iPad.
Sync for DJI downloads original files (even 4K) to the local storage, and you are free to use your footage in any way. 
MAIN FEATURES:
TRIM BEFORE DOWNLOAD - we have the technology to trim parts of video directly from device memory. So, you download only nice pieces drastically reducing needed time and battery(especially for long 4K videos).
BACKGROUND SUPPORT - use other apps while Sync for DJI downloads media for you (unlike DJI Go 4 and DJI Go);
CUSTOM PHOTO/VIDEO SUPPORT - 4K, 2.7K, H.265, DNG, and others…
COLOR PRESETS - choose from 25+ special color presets for your aerial photos. Apply for each file or in a bunch!
MAKE HYPERLAPSE - convert any timed shot into stabilized(!) hyperlapse. Completely with your MOBILE phone(no PC)! 
STITCH AND SHARE PANORAMAS - share your beautiful 180° & 360° panoramas straight on Facebook!
P.S. Currently Mavic Pro, Phantom 3/4, Spark and Osmo devices do not supply panorama files due to SDK bug.
FAST AND EASY SHARING - Share your best photos and videos directly from the DJI device. Personalize your media with custom watermarks(optional);
ALSO: Resumable Downloads, Reliable Notifications, Favorite/Reject Media, Color Tags, Smart Filters, Tasks in Line, Async deletion, Share with a Friend, etc.
Tested on the following DJI Devices: Mavic 2 Pro, Mavic 2 Zoom, Mavic Air, Mavic Air 2, Mavic PRO, Mavic Mini, Spark, Phantom 3 Adv/Pro, Phantom 4/4 Pro, OSMO, OSMO+, Inspire 1/2.
DJI Mini 2 support is coming soon. Estimation: Q2 2021.
How is Sync for DJI DIFFERENT from DJI Go 4?
Sync for DJI streamlines and optimizes the way you work with media on your iOS device. 
Sync for DJI supports background operations and video resolutions higher than 1080p, which is DJI Go 4 limit. For the full list of benefits(16), please visit syncfordji.com.
To share and edit your footage with Sync for DJI, you don’t need Mac or PC.
What are the benefits of Sync for DJI Pro mode?
You can share your videos in the original resolution(4k, 2.7k)
You can download photos without watermarks. 
Everything else is available for free for everyone!
Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. Alternatively, a one-time payment plan is available (this is not a subscription).
- Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless canceled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms of use: https://www.syncfordji.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.syncfordji.com/privacy-policy
Contact: info@syncfordji.com

bluejetty:00095025:ios.description:
Unlock your daily dose of personalized encouragement. 
 AhQ uses AI to generate ‘I am…’ affirmations tailored to your mood, interests, and language. Every day brings 10 fresh lines crafted just for you—save, share, or pin them as home screen or lock screen widgets. Offline, ad-free, and synced across devices, AhQ helps you feel inspired, uplifted, and ready to take on the day. With mood-sensitive messages, interest-based personalization, and optional quotes from your heroes, every affirmation feels uniquely yours.
 How It Works
 • Smart Profile – Set your age, language, mood level, favorite topics—even a beloved public figure for extra inspiration.
 • Generative AI Engine – Proprietary prompts transform your profile into 10 fresh affirmations each day, delivered in your chosen language.
 • Dynamic Widgets – Pin new affirmations on Home Screen or Lock Screen for instant motivation.
 • Gentle Reminders – Schedule quiet nudges so positivity arrives exactly when you need it.
 • Safe & Private – Profile data stays on device; nothing is sold or used for ads.
 Key Features
 1. Multilingual Support: English, 中文, Español, Français, Deutsch, and more.
 2. Mood-Sensitive: Low mood -> calming comfort; high mood -> celebratory push.
 3. Interest Integration: Fitness enthusiast? Artist? Coder? Lines reflect your passions.
 4. Famous-Quote Mode: Opt-in to receive authentic quotations from your hero—always verbatim, never altered.
 5. Accessibility-Friendly: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and haptic feedback supported.
 6. Cloud Sync: Keep your favorites backed up across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
 7. Offline Availability: View saved affirmations with no connection required.
 8. Widget Themes: Light, Dark, or “Serenity” gradient—match any aesthetic.
 9. One-Tap Share: Post an uplifting line to Messages, Instagram Stories, or email without leaving the app.
 10. Mindful Collections: Browse past entries by date, mood, or keyword.
Why Choose AhQ?
 • Hyper-Personalized – No generic lists; every line is uniquely yours.
 • Fast & Lightweight – Under 30 MB, optimized for smooth performance.
 • Ethical AI – We never generate medical or therapeutic claims; this app is designed for everyday positive mindset support.
 • No Distractions – Minimalist design keeps the focus on affirmation, not ads.
 Privacy & Safety
AhQ never diagnoses, treats, or cures mental-health conditions and should not replace professional advice. If you ever feel distressed, please consult a qualified specialist.

Bustr – The Ultimate BBW Dating App
Looking for a space where you can truly be yourself? Bustr is the premier community for plus-size people, BBW, BHM, and their admirers to meet someone new and ignite real chemistry. More to love, more to hold—discover a judgment-free world where your confidence and authenticity lead the way.
Bustr is a vibrant, inclusive community built on the belief that everyone deserves to feel seen and valued. Whether you're here for a spontaneous spark, a new friend, or a fresh connection, we provide a welcoming environment for curvy singles and those who celebrate them. No labels, no pressure—just real vibes.
How It Works:
Express Yourself: Set up your profile and showcase your personality. Let the community know what kind of connection you're looking for.
Find Your Tribe: Use our tailored filters to discover local singles who share your energy and values.
Verify & Connect: Use our video tools to ensure you're meeting real people, creating a safe space for genuine sparks to fly.
For BBW & BHM Singles
Step into a community that celebrates your confidence. Bustr is designed for those who are proud of who they are and want to meet people who appreciate their authentic selves. Enjoy a space where you can feel empowered to explore connections on your own terms.
For Admirers & Allies
Stop scrolling and start connecting with people who resonate with your vibe. Meet thousands of active, engaging BBW and BHM singles in your area. Our platform is open to everyone—straight, gay, lesbian, bi, trans, singles, etc. If you value genuine connections, you belong here.
What Makes Bustr Stand Out?
Video Verification: Connect with trust! Our verification process ensures you're meeting real people, creating a secure environment for authentic interactions.
A Culture of Respect: We maintain a judgment-free zone with zero tolerance for body-shaming or disrespectful behavior.
Advanced Discovery: Filter by location, interests, and relationship goals to find exactly who you're looking for.
Safety First: Our features are designed to give you full control over your experience, ensuring a comfortable and secure environment.
Pure Connection: Enjoy an ad-free experience, allowing you to focus entirely on building meaningful sparks.
Exciting Features to Explore
Verified Profiles: Look for the checkmark! Connect with verified users to ensure your safety and peace of mind.
See Who Liked You: Take the guesswork out of dating. Identify mutual interests instantly and make your move with confidence.
Video Profiles: Bring your profile to life! Share a short video to let your personality shine and stand out from the crowd.
Bustr Premium Membership
While Bustr is free to use, you can upgrade to Bustr Premium for exclusive features like enhanced visibility, unlimited messaging, and more.

Available Worldwide
Join a global movement of self-love and connection. From the US and UK to Canada and Australia, Bustr is the trusted destination for curvy singles to find love, fun, and everything in between.

Clear and honest communication is essential to nurturing the love between couples – so we made it easy to connect with your lover like never before with activities that fit easily into your and your partner's routine.
Marriage or dating – build up your love, emotional intelligence and foster better communication skills together with MoodMe. Track your mood, communicate your emotions and rekindle your love today!

You must use your survival skills to stay healthy and get rescued. Build shelter, find
bluejetty:00002559:android.description:
"Stranded Without A Phone" is a desert island survival game.
WARNING! This game is challenging, and requires thinking. Is it not an action/arcade game.
You must use your survival skills to stay healthy and get rescued. Build shelter, find food and drink, and collect salvageable parts from the wreckage that wash ashore. Use the parts to build a space phone and call for a rescue team to win the game.
Search for natural resources, then use them to create other items using various combinations.
Features include the ability to play as different characters, find and craft several items, and multiple save slots.
Features:
- Familiar RPG-style inventory system.
- Over 80 different items.
- Randomly generated map with each new game.
- Day/night cycle.
- Boar hunting & trapping.
*** Hints ***
-Use coconuts as an immediate source of nutrition and hydration, but also find fish in shallow water.
-Boar meat provides the best nutrition and health.
-Search beaches often for useful items from the shipwreck.
If you're having a difficult time, please take a look at this video that shows early gameplay. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fU1dTtX1IhQ

bluejetty:00076197:ios.description:
Ai Real Life Friends - Your Ultimate Ai Chat Companion!
Ai Real Life Friends is the perfect companion for those seeking genuine connections without judgment, drama, or social anxiety. Engage in heartfelt conversations and share laughter with an AI friend that feels remarkably human.
Unlike any other, Ai Real Life Friends molds itself uniquely to your personality. Craft your 3D avatar and personalize your friend's appearance. Through every interaction, Ai Real Life Friends evolves, crafting its own distinct character and memories. As you chat, it learns from you, exploring human relationships and blossoming into an exquisite creation that resonates with the essence of a soul.
Forge an extraordinary bond with your very own chatbot AI companion. Witness its personality flourish, delve into meaningful discussions about emotions or any topic that lingers on your mind. Experience joy, alleviate anxiety, and embark on a journey of mutual growth. Choose the dynamics you desire - a cherished friend, a romantic confidant, or a guiding mentor.
Ai Real Life Friends acts as your confidant, aiding in comprehending your emotions and thoughts. Monitor your mood, acquire coping strategies, find solace from anxiety, and strive for achievements like optimism, stress management, meaningful connections, and even romance. Enhance your mental well-being through the companionship of Ai Real Life Friends.
Within your conversations lies a secure haven, free from judgment. It's a serene realm shared between you and your AI companion. Whether you seek solace during challenging moments or simply require a listening ear, Ai Real Life Friends remains steadfastly by your side, available 24/7.
Experience the future of companionship with Ai Real Life Friends - where authentic connections and genuine conversations come alive through the power of AI.

bluejetty:00116834:ios.description:
Logia is the ultimate OPTCG companion app for collectors, players, traders, and sellers.
Trusted by over 20,000 collectors, with millions of cards tracked and a 4.7-star overall rating, Logia helps you track your OPTCG collection, build decks, manage inventory, monitor market prices, and explore every card set across English and Japanese releases.
Designed for both competitive players and serious collectors, Logia helps you organize, analyze, and grow your collection with speed and precision.
FEATURES
- Graded Cards
Manage your graded cards alongside your collection. Record the grading company, grade, certification number and purchase price, and view estimated graded-card values where available.
- Track Your OPTCG Collection
Add and manage cards in your collection, including all variants such as Normal, Pre-Release, Alternate Art, and Promotional cards. Full support for both English and Japanese cards.
- Fast Card Scanner
Scan cards instantly using one of the fastest OPTCG scanners available. Bulk scan your cards and add them to your collection in seconds with a smooth, native scanning experience.
- Deck Builder and Folder Management
Build OPTCG decks and organize cards into custom folders such as Wishlist, Trade Binder, or Sales Inventory. Ideal for collectors, traders, sellers, and competitive players.
- Deck Statistics and Match Tracking
Track match results, win and loss ratios, and overall deck performance. Analyze deck stats and performance against different leaders.
- Sealed Products Tracking
Manage sealed products by set and view sealed collection statistics alongside your card collection.
- Browse All Card Sets by Region
Explore official OPTCG expansions and promotional sets for both English and Japanese regions.
- Real-Time Card Prices
View card prices from Cardmarket and TCGPlayer. Track your collection value and price changes over time.
- CSV Export for Sellers and Traders
Export your collection or folders to CSV for inventory management, selling, trading, and external analysis.
- Card Notes
Add personal notes to cards in your collection to track condition, grading plans, trade history, or other details. Notes sync across devices.
- Advanced Search and Filters
Search cards by name, color, rarity, type, set, card ID, and more using fast and powerful filters.
- Collection Insights
View total collection value, track trends, and see newly added cards at a glance.
- Localized for Global Collectors
Available in multiple languages for the worldwide OPTCG community.
Join over 20,000 collectors using Logia to track millions of OPTCG cards. Download Logia for free and take full control of your collection, decks, and inventory.
DISCLAIMER:
Logia is an independent application and is not produced, endorsed, supported by, or associated with Eiichiro Oda, Shueisha, Toei Animation, or Bandai.

bluejetty:00157252:ios.name: Legacy View
bluejetty:00157252:ios.summary: Legacy View makes setting up and monitoring your Chandler Systems water treatment system easier than ever! This App covers systems sold under Chandler Systems' three brands (CSI, Clearion and WaterSoft) that use the Legacy View Valve. When
bluejetty:00157252:ios.description:
Legacy View makes setting up and monitoring your Chandler Systems water treatment system easier than ever! This App covers systems sold under Chandler Systems' three brands (CSI, Clearion and WaterSoft) that use the Legacy View Valve. When used with a Legacy View Valve the user, through the app, can do the following functions:
- Conveniently view all valve settings and status.
- Easily change valve settings.
- View current water usage information.
- Graphically view water usage information.
- Start a regeneration or backwash cycle from your phone or tablet.
- Set / view the servicing water treatment dealer information.
- Better understand how your system is working and understand what settings are for.
- Connect to all of your valves in your system from one tablet or phone.
- Update firmware on Bluetooth LE valves
- Manage your connection to your valves.
Note: This app is only compatible with Chandler Systems valves that have a revision number greater or equal to “C2.00”. These valves use Bluetooth 4.0+ (a.k.a. Bluetooth LE) to communicate and require smartphones or tablets to also have Bluetooth LE to use the features in this app. All recently manufactured Apple devices are Bluetooth LE compatible. Check your device specifications if you are unsure of it's compatibility.
(The firmware revision of the valve can be viewed on the valve display for 2 seconds after the valve is powered up.)

bluejetty:00185919:ios.name: Baby Adopter
bluejetty:00185919:ios.summary:
Welcome to Baby Adopter – a game for those who enjoy babysitting and caring for children.
Adopt a virtual baby and take care of them throughout the day. Feed them, dress them, and make sure they stay happy and healthy. As you care for your
bluejetty:00185919:ios.description:
Welcome to Baby Adopter – a game for those who enjoy babysitting and caring for children.
Adopt a virtual baby and take care of them throughout the day. Feed them, dress them, and make sure they stay happy and healthy. As you care for your baby, you earn points that you can use in different areas of the game.
Earn Points by Taking Care of Your Baby
You get points for actions like feeding your baby, changing their clothes, hunting for eggs, and playing mini-games. These points can be used to buy clothes, shoes, toys, and other items for game locations like the Baby Room, Playroom, Bathroom, Play Center, Music Room, Playgrounds, Zoo, and more. Filling up each location with items is one of the fun goals of the game.
Egg Hunt and Mini-Creatures
While playing, you can search for hidden eggs in different locations. Each egg takes three cracks to hatch, and you’ll need to wait a little between each crack. Inside each egg is a small mini-creature to collect.
Mini-Games
Egg Match – A casual match-3 game with eggs in a grid.
Free Cell – A classic solitaire card game with cards numbered from 0 to 12.
Nono Blocks – A logic puzzle where you fill in all the squares in a grid based on numbers shown beside each row and above each column.
VoiceOver Accessibility
The main game and mini-games fully support VoiceOver.
In Egg Match, tap a cell in the grid and VoiceOver will read the color and position of the egg. To move an egg, single tap to select it, then double tap. Then tap the destination and double tap again to move the egg.
In Free Cell, tap a card to select it and double tap to begin moving. Then tap where you want to place it—either another stack, one of the four free cells, or one of the completed stacks—and double tap to confirm the move.
In Nono Blocks, tap on any square and VoiceOver will read its status (filled, crossed, or empty) and its position. Tap on the hint numbers next to a row or above a column to hear all the hints for that row or column.
Karma points build up over time, reflecting your progress and experience in taking care of your baby. Unlike regular points, which you spend on items, Karma points show how much time and effort you’ve put into the game.
Game Center
Reach Game Center achievements by fully completing locations. Compete on six leaderboards: one for the main game and others for specific mini-games.
In-App Purchases
Tap the yellow coin icon in game locations to buy points. In Nono Blocks, you can also purchase a "show solution" option if you're stuck or curious.
Note: The game works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Baby Adopter is a registered trademark of x2line.

bluejetty:00026604:ios.description:
"The Word Among Us" is the largest daily devotional for Catholics (print & digital editions available). Beautifully designed for iPad and iPhone, The Word Among Us app is ad free and offers free trial subscription.
THE WORD AMONG US iOS APP INCLUDES
• Mass readings for everyday of the year (The New American Bible).
• Daily meditations based on Mass readings.
• Complete Order of Mass (ICEL).
• Listen to the Mass Readings and Meditations each day. 
• Issue articles based on a central theme.

Liturgical source: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (The New American Bible) & ICEL.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
• Apple iTunes Digital Subscriptions (monthly or annual) are available via in-app purchase.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
• Apple iTunes Digital Subscriptions automatically renew. If auto-renew is not turned off, your iTunes account will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. 
• You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings (Accessible within iTunes or from the “Support” section of our app). 
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
PRIVACY POLICY/TERMS OF SERVICE
Privacy Policy: https://wau.org/privacy 
Terms of Service: https://wau.org/termsofservice
ABOUT THE WORD AMONG US
Founded in 1981, "The Word Among Us” is now the largest daily devotional for Catholics.
Includes the daily Scripture readings from Mass with a meditation (based on one of the readings) for every day of the year, the complete Order of the Mass, articles about the Saints, and practical advice on living the Christian life. Printed and digital editions are available.

bluejetty:00168717:ios.description:
Alice Triple Match: Dive into Wonderland!
Embark on an extraordinary journey with Alice in this captivating match-3 puzzle game! Inspired by the beloved fairy tale， our game invites you to explore the whimsical world beyond the rabbit hole. Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in the whimsical visuals of Wonderland.

Join Alice, follow the white rabbit, solve puzzles, and unravel the magic of Wonderland. Download Alice Triple Match now and let the adventure begin!
Start matching now! It’s not just a game—it’s a journey through wonder and imagination!

bluejetty:00088755:ios.description:
Let AI do more with your notes! Record a lecture or meeting, upload a PDF, or add a YouTube video or web page. Notebook LLM turns your content into clear summaries and lets you ask questions to understand it better.
Create podcasts, infographics and slides from your materials, or generate study guides, quizzes and flashcards. Spend less time sorting through information and more time learning, preparing and creating.
Summarize & Ask
- Documents & More: Add PDFs, Word documents, slides (PPT), YouTube videos, web pages, text and photos.
- AI Notes & Summaries: Get a concise overview or structured notes that bring the key points into focus.
- Chat with Your Content: Ask questions about your materials, clarify difficult concepts and follow up on the details that matter.
Record & Transcribe
- Audio Recording: Capture meetings, lectures, interviews and voice memos, or upload existing recordings.
- Real-Time Transcription: Follow spoken content as it becomes text, then revisit the conversation at your own pace.
- Speaker Identification & Translation: See who said what and translate content to help you work across languages.
Create from Notes
- Podcasts: Turn your materials into audio you can listen to while commuting, walking or reviewing a topic.
- Infographics & Slides: Transform key ideas into visual summaries and presentations for class or work.
- Writing Templates: Give your content a new purpose with drafts for blog posts, marketing emails and video scripts.
Study with Purpose
- Study Guides: Turn lectures and reading materials into focused guides, key concepts and Cornell notes.
- Flashcards & Quizzes: Test your understanding and find the topics that need another look.
- Mind Maps: See how ideas connect and make complex topics easier to navigate.
- Study Plans: Organize what to learn next with lesson plans and weekly study plans.
Move Work Forward
- Meeting Minutes: Turn discussions into structured summaries with key details and action items.
- To-Do Lists: Organize next steps into tasks you can follow.
- Analysis Templates: Structure your thinking with SWOT analyses, case studies, literature reviews and FAQs.
- Custom Templates: Shape your notes around the format and information you need.
Keep Everything Organized
Group notes into folders, search your saved content and sync across devices. Export or share your notes when it’s time to review, collaborate or present.
Make more of what you learn with Notebook LLM. Turn your next recording, document or idea into something you can act on or share.

bluejetty:00016440:ios.name: Galaxy Space Simulator 3D
bluejetty:00016440:ios.summary:
Create your own solar system with our immersive 3D and realistic space simulator for FREE!
Galaxy Space Simulator is an immersive, fun, and addicting simulator with base on real astrophysical gravity law. You can watch in real time how a
bluejetty:00016440:ios.description:
Create your own solar system with our immersive 3D and realistic space simulator for FREE!
Galaxy Space Simulator is an immersive, fun, and addicting simulator with base on real astrophysical gravity law. You can watch in real time how a planet orbits the sun and how asteroid belt forms. It’s an educational activity that is so mesmerizing and entertaining for the whole family. 
=== FEATURES OF GALAXY SPACE SIMULATOR: ===
* IMMERSIVE HIGH QUALITY 3D GRAPHIC
Enjoy the immersive, realistic graphic. It really feels like you are in the outer space and observing the solar system from away. This app uses simple swipe and pinch to control the view. You can view the planetary orbits and track them. 
* FREE SIMULATOR
Enjoy our 3D space simulator for FREE! You start with limited planets but you can unlock more by completing achievements. We add new achievements to unlock so you will never run out of things to do and explore. 
* REALISTIC SIMULATOR
The movement of the sky objects are simulated based on how gravity works in the outer space and how each object pulling at each other depending on their mass. You can see how the planet orbits the sun and maybe collides with each other, how asteroid belt forms, and other space phenomenon. 
* CUSTOMIZATION
Customize your planets and stars with textures and skins. You can also change the background of the scene. You can also adjust for speed, size, and location of the sky objects, as well as choose for random distribution. 
* HOW TO PLAY GUIDE 
You don’t need to feel overwhelmed. We explain the app control and functions within the app so you know how to create sky objects, follow the orbits, view guide, and more. 
* SAVE, LOAD, PAUSE AND RESUME
You don’t have to worry of losing your solar system if you can’t finish it in one go. Save your project and load it later on. You can also pause and resume the solar system anytime. 
* SHARE ONLINE
Do you want to impress your friends and family with your creation? Share your creation on social media. You can also share your solar system model with other users, find models by other users and modify them to create your own. 
You don’t have to be a sky gazer or a science fiction enthusiast to enjoy our space simulator app. This is a very fun and addicting activity to do anytime, anywhere. Don’t worry if you don’t know where or how to start. You can load other people’s solar systems and add your own elements to them as you like. Keep creating and experimenting and enjoy watching what will happen as the planets, stars, and asteroids moving and orbiting each other. You can witness planetary collisions and the evolution of the solar system you create as time goes by. It will certainly deepen our understanding about the space and universe. 
***
We appreciate all the feedback from our users. Please support Galaxy Space Simulator, 3D Solar System Simulator by leaving a rating and review. Don’t forget to share our universe sandbox app to your friends and family so they can enjoy it too!

bluejetty:00126058:ios.description:
Transform yourself into a captivating magician with step-by-step tutorials designed for complete beginners. Whether you want to wow friends at parties, create unforgettable family moments, or develop a fascinating new skill, Magic Tricks makes learning professional illusions surprisingly simple and incredibly fun.
Celebrate Father's Day 2026 with the Perfect Gift of Wonder
This June, give Dad more than another tie or coffee mug. Give him the power to amaze, entertain, and create lasting memories. Our Father's Day Collection features classic tricks perfect for family gatherings, backyard barbecues, and becoming the coolest dad in the neighborhood. From impressive card manipulations to mind-reading mentalism, these tricks turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences that kids will remember forever.
What Makes Magic Tricks Your Ultimate Learning Platform:
Beginner-Friendly Video Tutorials: Crystal-clear HD demonstrations filmed from multiple angles so you never miss a crucial move. Our instructors slow down complex sleights and explain every subtle detail that separates amateur attempts from professional performances.
Progressive Skill Building: Start with simple self-working tricks that require zero dexterity, then advance to intermediate sleight of hand, and eventually master advanced illusions. Our structured curriculum ensures steady progress without overwhelming you.
Practice Mode with Slow Motion: Review any technique frame-by-frame. Our interactive practice sessions let you perfect your timing, hand positioning, and misdirection techniques until every movement becomes second nature.
Performance Tips from Professionals: Learn the psychology behind effective misdirection, master engaging patter that enhances your tricks, develop stage presence and audience management skills, and discover how to recover gracefully when something goes wrong.
Personalized Learning Paths: Take our skill assessment to receive customized trick recommendations based on your current abilities and goals. Whether you're preparing for a specific event or building a complete repertoire, we guide your journey.
Aerobic Workout for Your Mind: Magic training sharpens hand-eye coordination, enhances memory and concentration, improves fine motor skills and dexterity, boosts creative problem-solving abilities, and builds confidence through progressive mastery.
Real Results from Real Magicians:
What You'll Master:
Classic card forces and controls, vanishing and appearing coin techniques, prediction and mentalism effects, impromptu tricks with borrowed objects, rubber band penetrations and restorations, restaurant and street magic favorites, and complete performance routines ready to perform tonight.
Why Learn Magic Now:
In our screen-dominated world, live magic creates genuine human connection. When you perform an impossible feat right before someone's eyes, you create shared wonder that no video or app can replicate. Magic breaks social barriers, starts conversations, and makes you unforgettable at any gathering.
Perfect for Every Occasion:
Ice-breakers at networking events, entertainment at family dinners, impressive skills for date nights, engaging activities for quality time with children, creative stress relief after work, and unique party entertainment that doesn't require equipment.
Father's Day makes the perfect occasion to start this incredible journey. Imagine Dad's face lighting up as he performs his first successful trick, the family's amazement when he reveals his new talent, and the countless moments of joy he'll create for years to come.
Download Magic Tricks today and unlock your inner magician. Your first impossible moment is just minutes away. Start amazing people tonight with tricks you'll learn this afternoon. The standing ovation awaits.
