bluejetty:00100070:ios.summary: Dive into "Enchanted Stories: PAWisoned Kingdom", a thrilling free-to-play journey blending hidden object games and epic adventure games. Step into a feline realm where betrayal lurks in royal shadows. As the King’s loyal blade and a daring
bluejetty:00100070:ios.description:
Dive into "Enchanted Stories: PAWisoned Kingdom", a thrilling free-to-play journey blending hidden object games and epic adventure games. Step into a feline realm where betrayal lurks in royal shadows. As the King’s loyal blade and a daring rogue join forces, you’ll find hidden objects, uncover dark secrets, and navigate through regal conspiracies. Master the art of search and find games, solve mysteries, and restore balance between cats and humans. A captivating tale for fans of finding object games and heroic quests awaits in this magical kingdom of intrigue!
The great feline kingdom of Castelia stands on the brink of disaster. Its beloved monarch, King Leonard III, lies mysteriously ill. The palace whispers treason. The royal healer evades questions. Someone in the court wants the king dead. When duty no longer offers answers, Felicia - the king's fiercest protector and master swordswoman - must seek help from the shadows. Here comes Diego, the infamous and roguish truthseeker with a sharp tongue and an even sharper blade. To uncover the truth, this unlikely duo must trade their titles for disguises and sneak through both back alleys and pompous hallways. But as they scratch beneath the surface, a deeper plot emerges - one that threatens not just the King, but the delicate balance between cats and humans across the realm. Will they save Leonard before his final breath? Or will Castelia fall to the claws of conspiracy?
· Explore the Kingdom!
Journey through enchanted castles, misty streets, and moonlit rooftops in our adventure games. Each scene is packed with detail and challenges for finding object games lovers. Perfect for those who enjoy rich storytelling and hidden object games filled with royal mystery.
· Secrets in Every Shadow!
Train your eye and intuition with engaging search and find games! Sneak through lavish halls and gritty alleys, piecing together clues to unravel royal secrets. If you love find hidden objects and finding object games, this story will captivate you.
· Solve Puzzles & Mini-Games!
Join Felicia and Diego in our unforgettable adventure games. Collect items, solve puzzles, and conquer challenges across the land. Fans of hidden object games and finding object games will discover a richly woven plot full of danger and magic.
· Achieve & Triumph
Prove your skill in search and find games by earning achievements and rewards. Every solved mystery and uncovered truth strengthens your legend in the realm of hidden object games. Fans of item search games will love conquering quests and mastering every royal secret.
Embark on a free-to-play quest where courage meets curiosity — the blend of hidden object games, adventure games, and search and find games awaits you. The fate of Castelia lies in your hands!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00094902:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of running a car dealership, making big deals and driving amazing cars as a car seller? Now's your chance!
In this exciting car game, you'll step into the role of a car dealer, searching for the best cars for sale, fixing them up and selling them for a profit. But that's not all. Test your car driving skills with parking challenges, earn your driving license and even race high-performance cars!
Whether you love trading, driving or customizing vehicles, this game gives you everything you need to build your own car business empire!
BUY AND SELL CARS
Start small and search for cars for sale that need a little work. Buy the right cars at the right price, prepare them for customers and sell them for a profit. Make smart deals and grow your dealership business.
REPAIR AND CUSTOMIZE CARS
Repair, repaint and customize vehicles to improve their condition and increase their value. Turn ordinary used cars into valuable vehicles ready for sale.
BUILD YOUR CAR DEALERSHIP
Earn money from successful car sales, expand your dealership and unlock new cars as your business grows. Work your way up and become a successful car dealer.
TEST DRIVE YOUR CARS
Before selling, take your cars for a test drive! Explore the city, experience different vehicles and improve your driving skills.
MASTER PARKING AND DRIVING
Complete parking challenges and driving tests to prove your skills. Handle tricky parking spots, different road conditions and city traffic while working toward your driving license.
RACE HIGH-PERFORMANCE CARS
Your journey isn't only about running a dealership. Get behind the wheel, compete in exciting races and unlock powerful cars as you progress.
GAME FEATURES:
- Buy and sell used cars for profit
- Run and grow your own car dealership
- Search for valuable car deals
- Repair and restore vehicles
- Repaint and customize cars
- Test drive different vehicles
- Master parking and driving challenges
- Earn your driving license
- Race high-performance cars
- Unlock new vehicles
- Expand your car business
If you love running a car dealership, searching for the best cars for sale, making profitable deals and driving amazing vehicles, this is the game for you.
Start buying, repairing, customizing and selling cars today and become the top car dealer in town!
Privacy Policy:
https://gamifystudio.io/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00095764:ios.description:
Status Saver - Download Status is your all-in-one utility app designed to simplify your social life and maximize productivity. Whether you're looking to save social media statuses, manage multiple accounts, chat directly, or keep private notes secure, this app brings powerful tools into one clean, easy-to-use interface.

Run and manage two accounts of the same social app on one device. Perfect for switching between personal and work profiles without logging out. Keep your conversations separate and organized effortlessly.
● Direct Chat (No Save Needed)
Start a conversation with any number without saving it in your contacts. Useful for one-time chats, temporary interactions, or sending messages quickly without cluttering your address book.

Create and save personal notes, ideas, reminders, or even confidential information in a safe and discreet space. Your thoughts are encrypted and only accessible by you.

Unleash your creativity! Use our built-in emoji art and face art templates to send fun, unique, and expressive messages. Share your personality with friends in a way that words alone can’t express.
Whether you're looking to manage multiple accounts, save time chatting, or keep your personal life private and expressive, Status Saver - Download Status is the smart companion for the modern user.
Download now and explore all-in-one efficiency with a touch of creativity and privacy!

bluejetty:00036251:ios.description:
Health Guru: Planner & Tracker is your all-in-one solution for tracking and maintaining your health. Whether you want to monitor your heart, check your blood pressure, or simply stay on top of your fitness goals, this app provides everything you need. With advanced measurement tools and seamless integration with your device, tracking your vital signs has never been easier.
Measure Heart Rate & More
Stay informed about your heart health with precise heart rate monitor features. The app allows you to track your heart rate in real-time and view detailed data. You can also check your blood pressure and monitor your bpm easily, helping you keep an eye on your cardiovascular health.
Detailed Health Reports
Generate comprehensive reports with this health tracker that provides detailed insights into your blood oxygen, hrv, and other key metrics. With the heart monitor and bpm counter, you can detect patterns and make data-driven decisions for a healthier lifestyle.
Track Fitness Goals
Not just for monitoring your heart, the health app is also designed to help you reach your fitness targets. It acts as a pulse tracker and keeps track of your activities, offering motivation and daily reminders to meet your goals. The app functions as a perfect partner for both casual users and fitness enthusiasts.
User-Friendly Interface
The heart rate app features an intuitive design that makes it easy to use. With clear instructions and easy-to-read data, even beginners can start using the heart rate tracker right away. You can quickly measure your blood oxygen levels, monitor your bpm, and track changes over time using the app’s visually engaging charts and reports.
Reminders & Health Tips
Set up personalized reminders to regularly check your heart rate, blood pressure, and more. These daily reminders keep you on track, while integrated health tips ensure that you stay informed about ways to improve your well-being.
Key Features:
- BMI calculator to help you assess your weight health.
- Track heart rate, bpm, and HRV with advanced measuring tools.
- Record blood pressure, blood oxygen, and overall heart health.
- Stay on top of your goals with daily reminders and motivational tips.
- Simple, clean interface designed for all users.
Disclaimer:
- Health Guru: Planner & Tracker is not intended to be used as a medical device for diagnosing heart conditions or any other health issues.
- This app should not be relied upon in medical emergencies. Always consult your healthcare provider for any concerns or if you require medical assistance.
- Health Guru: Planner & Tracker is intended for general wellness and fitness purposes only, and is NOT FOR MEDICAL USE.
- The app provides general health information and should not be used for medical diagnosis or treatment.
- Prolonged use of the app’s heart rate monitor feature may cause the LED flash to become hot.
**Upgrade to Premium to remove ads and unlock all features. We offer you a weekly subscription with a 3-day free trial period.
– Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase (After a free trial period if offered).
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00119512:ios.name: Resco Mobile CRM
bluejetty:00119512:ios.summary:
Resco Mobile CRM application allows you to access your CRM data on the go. Connect directly to Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and Salesforce offline/online, or use it to access other CRM and ERP systems.
This app boosts the productivity of sales
bluejetty:00119512:ios.description:
Resco Mobile CRM application allows you to access your CRM data on the go. Connect directly to Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and Salesforce offline/online, or use it to access other CRM and ERP systems.
This app boosts the productivity of sales representatives, field service technicians, field agents, managers – all who need mobility while working.
Resco Mobile CRM works in online and offline mode, which means you will be able to view/create/delete/modify data whenever you need to, even without an Internet connection. Fully integrated with your phone or tablet, it offers perks like, photo & signature capturing, phone call tracking, route planning, and barcode scanning.
Features
• Fully offline & online capable 
• Work with your data in Salesforce offline
• Interactive maps that display accounts, contacts, activities and other types of records
• Multimedia support (pictures, documents, Iframes, and signatures)
• Calendar for scheduling appointments and creating tasks
• Adjustable filters and sorting 
• Route planner
• Option to Run Reports
• Multi-language options
• Photo & audio capturing
• Phone call & email tracking
• Barcode & QR code scanner
• SharePoint & Dropbox support
• MS Exchange & Gmail integration
• Encrypted database
• Fully customisable via Resco’s configurator
• MDM (Mobile Device Management)
Already 65,000+ users utilize the professional version of this solution, ranging from small to midsize companies to large international enterprise corporations with thousands of mobile users. Join them, and see how easy it is to find information about your clients, create orders, track phone calls, and more.
IMPORTANT: With Resco Mobile CRM, simply log into your MS Dynamics CRM (On-Premise or Online), or Salesforce. You can also connect the app to the Resco CRM server that serves as a Standalone CRM Solution or as middleware between the mobile client and even more CRM and ERP systems. Without the access to your CRM organization, you will be only able to work with the demo database.

With California Road Report you can view CHP incidents, CalTrans road conditions, chain control, road closures, highway cameras, CalFire incidents, and rest stops in California on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch on the go! 
- View CHP Incidents in areas nearby or from a list of selected areas in either list mode or map mode 
Each CHP incident reported contains the time of occurrence, location, and details of the incident.
- Hands-Free Mode - With hands-free mode, CHP incidents can now be spoken to you while you drive so you can keep your eyes on the road and still receive CHP reports. (note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.)
- Search for CalTrans road conditions on any given highway in California
Ideal for checking chain requirements prior to driving in snowy conditions, knowing if there will be road work, or finding out if a particular stretch of the highway has been closed. 
- Find out where chain control is being enforced during snow storms
While in map view you can pan around the state of California to see where chain control is being enforced or scroll through a list of all chain control areas in California. 
- Find nearby rest stops
Need to take a break while on a long drive down the 5? Check out nearby rest stops and see their available amenities.
- See highway cameras
See pictures from over 500 highway cameras (with some including live video) in the state of California and also share them on Facebook, X, eMail, and SMS. 
- Road Closures
Avoid traffic by knowing which roads are closed or have lane closures.
- CalFire Incidents 
See nearby CalFire incidents and check percent contained and number of acres burned. 
- CarPlay Support
See CHP Incidents, road closures, and rest stops while using CarPlay. 
*** Camera widgets ***
Now you can add highway cameras to the home screen on your phone or CarPlay.

bluejetty:00024814:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00024814:ios.description:
Take a break now and enjoy a game of Golf Solitaire packed with fun, excitement and challenge.
Golf Solitaire is a skill based game. All the cards are visible and you need to strategize early in order to win. Why is it called Golf Solitaire? As it is in golf, the goal of this game is to earn the lowest number of points over the course of nine deals, also called holes.
Collect the cards from the tableau by picking cards that rank one higher or one lower than the top card of the foundation. We made sure that all deals are solvable, however the difficulty will vary and some deals will be trickier than others. The lower the score, the better. At the end of the game you should strive to clear the tableau and use as few cards as possible from the drawable pile. 
Get this game now and start playing! We hope you'll enjoy playing this game as much as we've enjoyed building it.
GAME MODES
- Classic, 9 Holes & the classic and beloved Golf Solitaire layout
- Special, 9 Holes & 290+ custom layouts to experience Golf Solitaire in a totally novel way
- Level Mode with 100,000 solvable levels that get more challenging as you play
- Daily Challenges
FEATURES
- Tap or drag & drop cards
- Works in both Portrait and Landscape Orientation - Just flip your device
- Big cards that are easy to see
- Responsive and efficient design
- Beautiful dazzling animations 
- 17 crisp and easy to read card designs
- 26 beautiful card backs
- 43 mesmerizing backgrounds for your every mood
- Unlimited Undos
- Unlimited Hints
- Cloud Save, so you can always pick up where you left off. Your data will be synchronized across your multiple devices
- Local Statistics & Global Leaderboards for each Game Mode
- Local & Global Achievements
- You can compete with people around the world. Check the online leaderboards after each game to see your global standing.
HOW TO PLAY
- Tap the cards on the board to match them with the card on the waste pile and collect them.
- You can match a card with a card which number is smaller or bigger by one.
- You can match a 7 with a 6 or an 8.
- You can match a King with a Queen or on Ace.
- You can match a Queen with a Jack or a King.
- If you can’t make any more matches, press “Draw” or tap on the stock pile to make a draw.
- Scoring: If the draw stack has run out, you score one point for each remaining card on the tableau. If you clear the tableau, you score a negative point for every card left in the draw stack.

bluejetty:00177357:ios.summary: Travel back to ancient times in Pyramid of Mahjong, an amazing pair matching puzzle game! A settlement on the Nile Delta needs your help to be brought back to its former glory in the times of the Egyptian Empire. Play thousands of tile matc
bluejetty:00177357:ios.description:
Travel back to ancient times in Pyramid of Mahjong, an amazing pair matching puzzle game! A settlement on the Nile Delta needs your help to be brought back to its former glory in the times of the Egyptian Empire. Play thousands of tile matching levels, meet charismatic characters, follow the suspenseful storyline and rebuild this ravaged but once-beautiful area into the treasure of the New Kingdom while tackling matching games!
This new mahjong solitaire game is a unique and epic blend of city building and classic tile pairing, tied together with a storyline full of court intrigues, cunning plans and historical events worthy of Nefertiti, all set in the colorful and vibrant atmosphere of Ancient Egypt. You’re an ambitious third-generation architect who is searching for your sister after her mysterious disappearance. Help the determined citizens revive their community after devastating attacks by the power-mad Irsu and his wily retinue. Then establish a link between your family and magical antiquities to enthrone the right person. Makeover a fertile ground, find your missing sister and keep a powerful artifact away from evil forces to ensure that fortune favors your settlers once again! On your way to prosperity, collect achievements and get special tools, such as the Dice booster (which gets you out of a difficult situation), the Brazier booster (which blows up multiple pairs of tiles) and many other innovative features that can enhance your gameplay experience!
● PLAY through a unique combination of tile matching and city building in one game
● GO on an adventure filled with the history, tales and myths of Ancient Egypt
● MEET the Pharaoh and his nobles, priests, soldiers, scribes, merchants and farmers on your way to prosperity
● MASTER thousands of free immersive marjong, majong, majhong, mah-jongg, mah jongg or mahjongg levels – these are the popular ways to misspell “mahjong”
● WIELD incredible boosters and power-up combos designed for mahjong solitaire games
● UNLOCK a variety of beautiful buildings and landmarks to rebuild and upgrade
● FOLLOW your friends’ progress with the innovative built-in social network
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.

bluejetty:00083987:ios.name: Heisting
bluejetty:00083987:ios.summary: What could be more exciting than the thrill of a perfectly executed heist? In Heisting you are set into the role of a masterful thief who embarks on a stealing spree across the world's most luxurious museums, galleries, banks and many more.
bluejetty:00083987:ios.description:
What could be more exciting than the thrill of a perfectly executed heist? In Heisting you are set into the role of a masterful thief who embarks on a stealing spree across the world's most luxurious museums, galleries, banks and many more. Gather your crew of robbers and hash out the perfect plan as you progress through increasingly difficult levels.
If things go wrong, and believe me they will go wrong, it will be up to your skills to shoot your way out to safety. Choose your upgrades carefully as they could be a difference between a big pay day and a messy failure.
As you progress, you will need to convince more and more robbers to join your gang and help you with your heists. In order for the heist to be completed you will need to steal everything in your sight.
Sometimes the enemy guards will be so tough you will have to sacrifice some of your robbers in a big shootout. But the pay day at the end of it will be much worth it. You will encounter different enemies that will try to prevent you from taking your loot, and you'll need to adapt a unique strategy to get around each of them.
Enjoy the road to becoming a fantastically rich millionaire who has more money than he knows what to do with. But you will also have to invest in your heisting gear and gang of robbers to ensure you are successful in bringing home the money.
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to steal valuable items or rob banks to grow your criminal empire and become ridiculously rich? Then this game is perfect for you. Immerse yourself in a world where everything is yours for the taking. How much money can you get? The sky's the limit!
If you’re really good, this game allows you to make so much money that you will literally be richer than any millionaire. In fact, with the amount of money you can make, millionaires will feel like beggars compared to you! And if that wasn’t enough, think of the power you’ll feel as you lead a massive army of robbers to demolish the opposition and claim extraordinarily valuable treasures for yourself.
Featuring:
- Unique hand crafted heisting levels.
- A colorful gang of robbers to help you
- Progressive upgrade system
- Bonus stealth levels
- Big pay days for you and your crew
- Rapidly increasing wealth system
So what are you waiting for?
Go out there and claim what is rightfully yours!

bluejetty:00185897:ios.description:
Command great battles with large numbers of soldiers, jeeps, tanks, artillery, helicopters, aircrafts, drones, warships and other units.
Several types of soldiers: assault rifle, bazooka, sniper, machine gun.
You can control all units from above or control individually the unit that you select.
Defend your industrial areas and conquer the factories of the other side to produce more military units.
Complete mission editor where you can design your own battles, selecting the number of soldiers, jeeps, tanks, helicopters, aircrafts, drones, factories, type of terrain and much more. And now you can edit the terrain to further customize your battles!
You can also add units in the middle of battle, in missions created with the mission editor.
Tactical nuclear weapon, with great destructive power. Use it against large concentrations of tanks or against the main industrial zone of the other side.
Transport of soldiers by helicopter. You can order the transport helicopters to land, and the soldiers will walk towards the helicopter.
Then send the helicopter where you want, press the land button and the soldiers will go down.
It is very useful to conquer the adversary's factories in their rear, you can also use it in the mission editor to create your own exciting missions.
You can also transport soldiers by land, in trucks, or by sea, in boats.
Transport vehicles and troops with the cargo plane, which can also drop soldiers by parachute.
We have recently added the naval campaign and world map campaign, with missions with warships, aircraft carriers and unit landing ships, in huge scenarios, don't miss it!
In addition to the campaign and mission editor, there is also multiplayer! Play battles against other opponents in real time, show who is the best strategist!
Collect victories to move up a grade. If you defeat a player with many victories, you add more points.
Battle 3D is a very addictive game, you can not stop playing, moving your tanks conquering factories or surrounding the armies of the other side.
Enjoy now the great battles of Battle 3D!

bluejetty:00014988:ios.name: Toddler games & toddler puzzle
bluejetty:00014988:ios.summary: Learn and play with the farm and jungle animals in this fun puzzle game. A combination of puzzle along with cute mini games will make your learning journey easy and enjoyable. This game is appropriate for kindergarten kids. It will help the
bluejetty:00014988:ios.description:
Learn and play with the farm and jungle animals in this fun puzzle game. A combination of puzzle along with cute mini games will make your learning journey easy and enjoyable. This game is appropriate for kindergarten kids. It will help them to improve their skills - problem solving, fine motor skills, memory, concentration, etc.
Puzzle:
Animals puzzle for Kids – use your finger to assemble the animal and see them animate and make sounds. This puzzle game will make learning of animals names and sounds simple and easy for little children.
Mini Games:
1. Blow air in the silly animal balloon, watch them go up into the sky and bounce. Have fun by dragging the balloons around, but be careful of the flying bird as it can burst your balloon.
2. Play with the different cartoon animals and fishes swimming in the water. Touch them to blow air into them and watch them make silly faces and fly around as the air comes out of them.
3. Learn what animals eat by choosing the right food from the table. Does the mouse eat cheese or watermelon? Does the gorilla eat banana or cake? 
4. We all love surprise eggs. Tap the eggs and see the baby animal hatch, you will love the cute animal babies and the sounds that they make.
5. The animals have had so much food that their stomach is full with gas and as you will touch them, they will fart.
6. Play a little hide and seek game with the animals. They are hiding behind the bushes and will peek for a moment and you need to touch them to collect points as fast as you can.
7. Trampoline jumping fun. Animals jump on the trampoline and collect the stars in the sky. You need to help them jump in all directions to collect all the stars.
8. Learn how to take care of animals, they need their daily hygiene as we do. Wash the dirty animals with some soap bubbles and then shower them to make them clean and shiny.
Features:
Simple and intuitive child friendly interface - making it easy for small children.
Colorful HD graphics designed for little kids and awesome animations to add that wow factor.
30 different languages and pronunciations - English, Afrikaans, Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese.
Sweet background music and care

As featured in Runner’s World, Competitor Magazine, Triathlete Magazine, Strava, Men’s Health, 60 Minute Sports, Outside Magazine, Ragnar Relay Series, and Active. 
APP FEATURES & BENEFITS:
- NEW Daily Run workouts featuring a 10 min audio run and a video warmup and cool down to build strength and range of motion.
- MONTHLY training challenges on strength, form, nutrition, and speed. Earn prizes & badges!
- WEEKLY Training Videos with full workouts, racing tips, and training advice.
- Stay healthy & get back to running faster with the Injured Runner Program.
- Easily search workouts based on time, fitness goal, and equipment needed.
- Interactive programs for Beginner, 5k, Half Marathon, and Marathon.
- Indoor workouts and exercises to build your fitness at home.
- GPS tracker for all your runs.
- Talk directly to coaches and connect with runners in our community.
- Integrates with Apple Health to keep track of your progress.
NEW DAILY AUDIO RUNS
New daily audio runs alternate between form, breathing, speed, mystery, and motivation. Each day is new and different, keeping it fun while making you a better, fitter runner. Or choose the alternate strength and yoga workouts for the days you don’t want to or cannot run.
TRAIN FOR ANY RACE OR GOAL
If you have a goal or race in mind, we have structured progressive programs for you to follow. All programs include specific run workouts and directions, strength exercises and warmups, and access to coaching to keep you on track! Or join one of our live training challenges in The Daily Run, earn prizes, and become part of our community!
STAY HEALTHY WITH STRENGTH & INJURY PREVENTION TRAINING
90% of overuse injuries that runners experience are preventable and self-treatable by building a stronger body with improved range of motion and mechanics. The Injured Runner Program walks you through the exact self-care routine you should follow for your injury or pain point.
At The Run Experience, we’re dedicated to bringing you the best training available, and we have helped hundreds of thousands of runners all over the world. Now you can finally get all that training in your pocket.
A premium subscription or a free trial is required in order to access the content of this app.
——————

bluejetty:00018140:ios.description:
Want to save on your mortgage? Start using this all-in-one mortgage toolkit to make smarter home buying decisions.
Mortgage Pal has 7 powerful tools in 1 app:
• Mortgage Payment Calculator
• Mortgage Affordability Calculator
• Mortgage Refinance Calculator
• HELOC Calculator
• Rent vs Buy Calculator
• Closing Costs Calculator
• Mortgage Rate Trends Visualizer
Calculate mortgage payments including PMI, property taxes, insurance, and HOA fees. Plan your payments, save on interest, and make confident home buying decisions.
MORTGAGE PAYMENT CALCULATOR
• Calculate payments with monthly, weekly, bi-weekly, quarterly, and yearly plans
• Account for PMI, taxes, insurance, and HOA fees
• Detailed schedules showing interest vs principal breakdown
• See how extra payments save you thousands in interest
MORTGAGE AFFORDABILITY CALCULATOR
• Determine how much home you can afford based on your income
• Adjustable debt-to-income ratio with your expenses and debts
• Instantly see your maximum purchase price and monthly payment
REFINANCE CALCULATOR
• Compare current vs new mortgage side by side
• See monthly savings and break-even point
• Toggle closing costs to roll into loan or pay upfront
HELOC CALCULATOR
• Estimate your available home equity line of credit
• Calculate payments based on home value and existing mortgage
RENT VS BUY CALCULATOR
• Compare the true cost of renting vs buying over time
• Factors in appreciation, rent increases, investment returns, and tax benefits
CLOSING COSTS CALCULATOR
• State-specific estimates including title insurance, taxes, and fees
• See exactly how much cash you need at closing
MORTGAGE RATE TRENDS
• Track 30-year fixed, 15-year fixed, and FHA rates
• Visualize history over 30 days, 1 year, or 5 years
— FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS —
Q: What is the best free mortgage calculator app for iPhone?
A: Mortgage Pal is a top-rated free mortgage calculator for iPhone with multiple tools in one app — including payment, affordability, refinance, HELOC, rent vs buy, and closing costs calculators. No subscriptions, no paywalls, no account required.
Q: How is Mortgage Pal different from other mortgage calculator apps?
A: Most mortgage apps only offer a basic payment calculator. Mortgage Pal includes 6 calculators covering every stage of homeownership — from affordability and closing costs to refinancing and HELOC — all free with no ads locked behind a paywall.
Q: Do I need an account or subscription to use Mortgage Pal?
A: No. Mortgage Pal is 100% free with no account signup, no subscription, and no premium tier. Every calculator and feature is available immediately.
Q: Does Mortgage Pal work offline?
A: Yes. All calculators work without internet. Rate trends require a connection, but every calculator runs entirely on-device — perfect for meetings with lenders or open houses.
Q: Can realtors and mortgage brokers use Mortgage Pal with clients?
A: Yes. Thousands of realtors, mortgage brokers, and financial planners use Mortgage Pal to run calculations with clients. Results can be exported to email instantly and multiple scenarios can be saved and compared.
Q: What mortgage calculators does Mortgage Pal include?
A: Payment calculator with PMI and tax support, affordability calculator with DTI ratios, refinance calculator with break-even analysis, HELOC calculator, rent vs buy comparison tool, closing costs estimator by state, and a mortgage rate trends visualizer with historical data.
Q: Is Mortgage Pal accurate for real mortgage calculations?
A: Yes. Mortgage Pal uses industry-standard amortization formulas, real-time rate data from the Federal Reserve (FRED), and state-specific closing cost data. Results match what lenders and financial professionals use.
See why thousands of realtors, brokers, and homeowners trust Mortgage Pal. Download Mortgage Pal today and experience for your self.

bluejetty:00188025:ios.name: AWS Console
bluejetty:00188025:ios.summary:
The AWS Console Mobile Application, provided by Amazon Web Services, lets you view and manage a select set of resources and receive push notifications to stay informed and connected with your AWS resources while on-the-go.
The Console Mobi
bluejetty:00188025:ios.description:
The AWS Console Mobile Application, provided by Amazon Web Services, lets you view and manage a select set of resources and receive push notifications to stay informed and connected with your AWS resources while on-the-go.
The Console Mobile Application allows you to configure and receive push notifications for AWS services, monitor resources through a dedicated dashboard, and view configuration details, metrics, and alarms for select AWS services. The Dashboard provides permitted users with an overview of the account status, with real-time data on Amazon CloudWatch, AWS Health Dashboard, AWS Billing and Cost Management, and Recently Visited Services. You can view ongoing issues and follow through to the relevant CloudWatch alarm screen for a detailed view with graphs and configuration options. In addition,you can check on the status of specific AWS services, view detailed resource screens, and perform select actions.
The Console Mobile Application requires an existing AWS account. Upon initial setup, the Console Mobile Application lets you stay signed in to multiple identities at once. Login process leverages biometric authentication (on supported devices), making access to AWS resources simple and quick.
The Console Mobile Application supports Amazon API Gateway, AWS Artifact, AWS Backup, AWS Health Dashboard, AWS Organizations, Billing and Cost Management, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CloudShell, AWS CloudTrail, Amazon CloudWatch, CodeBuild, Code Commit, Code Deploy, Code Pipeline, Cognito, Control Tower, Amazon DynamoDB, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), EMR, Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), Elastic Kubernetes Service, AWS Identity and Access Management, IAM Identity Center, IoT Core, AWS Lambda, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS), Amazon Route 53, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Secrets Manager, Security Hub, Amazon Simple Queue Service(SQS), Step Functions, Systems Manager, Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC). 
The Console Mobile Application supports US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (N. California), US West (Oregon), Africa (Cape Town), Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), Asia Pacific (Jakarta), Asia Pacific (Melbourne), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), Asia Pacific (Osaka), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Canada (Central), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (Ireland), Europe (London), Europe (Milan), Europe (Paris), Europe (Spain), Europe (Stockholm), Europe (Zurich), Middle East (Bahrain), Middle East (UAE), and South America (São Paulo).
We regularly release updates with new features. Tell us what features you need and how you would use them with the Feedback link in the Console Mobile Application's menu. We're listening!

bluejetty:00141422:ios.summary: FPV War Kamikaze Drone is an exhilarating game that combines action and simulation genres. Take control of advanced combat drones and complete challenging missions by destroying enemy vehicles and infantry. Experience intense battles, dynam
bluejetty:00141422:ios.description:
FPV War Kamikaze Drone is an exhilarating game that combines action and simulation genres. Take control of advanced combat drones and complete challenging missions by destroying enemy vehicles and infantry. Experience intense battles, dynamic gameplay, and realistic first-person view (FPV) controls.
GAME FEATURES
1. A Variety of Maps FPV War Kamikaze Drone offers five unique locations:
- Training Center – A perfect place to hone your piloting and combat skills. An ideal starting point for beginners.
- Mountain Road – Twisting routes through rocky landscapes where enemies hide behind cover.
- Military Base – A large strategic site packed with targets and high enemy concentrations.
- Convoy – An enemy convoy traveling through challenging terrain, ideal for quick strikes.
- Factory – An industrial zone teeming with enemy activity and equipment.
Each map is unique, making every mission exciting and unpredictable.
2. Destruction of Enemy Targets Face various enemy vehicles, each requiring a unique approach:
- Buggy – Light and agile vehicles. - Off-Roader – Fast but vulnerable to attacks.
- AFV (Armored Fighting Vehicle) – A more protected target requiring powerful explosives.
- Truck – A supply carrier whose destruction weakens the enemy.
- Medium Tank – A versatile unit with moderate armor.
- Heavy Tank – A formidable opponent with strong defenses.
- SAM (Surface-to-Air Missile System) – A threat to your drones that must be neutralized quickly.
- MLRS (Multiple Launch Rocket System) – A target capable of causing mass destruction. 
Your drones are key to mission success!
3. Diverse Drones Choose from two combat drones, each with unique capabilities:
- Kamikaze – Perfect for suicide attacks, equipped with explosive charges.
- Striker – A high-precision drone with enhanced maneuverability, ideal for complex tasks.
4. Customizable Payloads
Before each mission, customize your drone's loadout:
- PG-7VS – A powerful charge for destroying armored vehicles.
- OG-7V – Effective against infantry and light vehicles.
- VOG-17M – A versatile payload for area damage.
- RGD-5 – A hand grenade for eliminating infantry.
Choosing the right weapon is key to mission success.
5. FPV Mode (First Person View) The first-person perspective immerses you in the experience of piloting a real FPV drone. It adds realism and depth, making each attack thrilling. Drone control feels not only exciting but also remarkably authentic.
6. Stunning Explosions and Ragdoll Physics
Enjoy visually impressive explosions and dynamic Ragdoll physics, making every hit on infantry visually spectacular.
7. Observation Mode
If your drone is destroyed or you complete an attack, you can switch to a scout drone. This feature allows you to observe the results of your attack and assess the damage from a different perspective.
WHY PLAY FPV WAR KAMIKAZE DRONE?
- Immerse yourself in the world of FPV drones. Feel like a real combat machine pilot.
- Explore diverse locations and objectives. Each map presents unique challenges, and the wide variety of enemies requires a tactical approach.
- Experiment with a variety of weapons. Customize your drones for each mission to discover new strategies.
- Enjoy realistic and dynamic gameplay. FPV cameras, Ragdoll physics, and stunning explosions make the game truly engaging. 
WHO IS THIS GAME FOR? 
FPV War Kamikaze Drone is designed for those who:
- Love action and thrilling gameplay.
- Are interested in piloting FPV drones.
- Appreciate realistic physics and high-quality graphics.
- Seek a game that blends strategy and adrenaline.
CONCLUSION
FPV War Kamikaze Drone is not just a game but a unique experience. Feel the tension of aerial combat, control your drones, and defeat your enemies. Download the game now and become a master of combat drones!

bluejetty:00074069:ios.description:
"Just astonishingly fun." — John Gruber
A BETTER EVERYDAY TIMER
I dreamt of a timer I could use every day that would simplify time and make the most of every moment it counted.
Inspired by the simple egg timer, Timer more honestly represents time as a single dimension. No hours or seconds—just minutes. There's nowhere to get lost. Scroll to set. Tap to start. Get back to life.
STOPWATCH & OVERSHOOT
When time expires, it doesn't stop at 0. Timer flips and begins to count up. This turns out to be pretty useful if you missed the alarm and don't know how much time has elapsed or if you cook and just need another minute without the hassle of setting another timer. Or scroll down to 0, tap, and it becomes a stopwatch ready to measure any length of time.
PLAYS LIKE A GAME, WORKS LIKE AN APP
Next generation user interface designed and built in 3D with animation and sounds inspired by video games. 
BIG & READABLE
Time you can read from across the room. Optional setting to keep your screen on during countdowns.
SKINS
Skins change the whole look and feel of the app. New skins and collaborations every season so you can keep it fresh.
WIDGETS
Drop a custom timer on your home screen for fast, one tap access to daily timers for coffee brewing, workouts, and other daily routines.
SUPER!BORING
Become a Super!Boring member and get all 5 Not Boring apps + skins + extras. We are 100% member-supported. No ads, no data gathering, no tracking. Just beautiful apps that make everyday life a little less boring.
Plans: https://andy.works/plans
Support: https://andy.works/support

bluejetty:00133952:ios.description:
Multi Stop Route Planner and Optimizer
Routin is a route planning app. It is quite useful for drivers who should visit many addresses daily. By using Routin, you can sort your stops/jobs optimally according to the chosen locations and finish your jobs in a shorter time.
JUST CREATE A ROUTE, ADD STOPS AND CLICK OPTIMIZE!
ROUTIN PLANS YOUR ROUTE FOR YOU!!
Select the starting and ending stops or let Routin select the ending stop for you. Optimized order of stops can be seen in a list or on map. You can follow along your optimized route via selected navigation app and enjoy your ride!
Key Features
- You can add 300 stops per route and optimize them for free. If your credits are not enough, you can continue using the app by watching video ads, purchasing credits, or subscribing.
- By optimizing your route, you can increase your daily deliveries and save time and fuel
- Fast and reliable optimization algorithm. Don't wait for optimization. Optimize 100 stops under 5 seconds
- In your own language, you can use the voice input feature to add stops or notes
- You can use Google Maps, Yandex Maps, Waze, Here WeGo or any other GPS navigation apps
- Using notifications, you can confirm the delivery and start navigating to your next stop without leaving the navigation app
- You can add extra information to stops such as phone number, email address, group, note, photo etc.
- You can define a default note or message template. So you can send a message quickly
- You can start the optimization from your current location or from any stop on your route
- You can quickly create your routes by holding down on the map or searching for addresses
- When adding addresses, you can quickly add them just by searching by street name and number
- You can add stops by postcode in supporting countries (such as Great Britain, Singapore)
Address Book
Routin helps you to manage your contacts, customers, delivery or visit addresses using Address Book
Store names, phone numbers, photos, locations (latitude, longitude) and addresses of your stops.
Import multiple stops data using a file (CSV, KML, GPX, XLS).
Filter your stops according to name, address or phone number.
Visit Records
Take notes and photos of your visit to a stop on a route. Share visit details and display past visit data.
Share your route details, display summary report about your routes and planned distances for a selected period.
The application is used extensively for the following sectors and jobs
- Cargo services: Package delivery or package picking
- Health services: Patient examination or care visits
- Aid services: Municipalities or associations delivering aid packages or meals
- Sales / Marketing services: Customer visits, product distribution
- Personnel / Student transportation: Planning the shuttle routes
- Tourism: Planning tourist services, creating a travel route
- Planning of supply chain routes
- Food delivery: Food delivery by motor courier
- On-site installation, maintenance and repair services: Repair, maintenance and installation services for air conditioning, white goods, electronic equipment
- Daily milk, fresh fruits and vegetables, carboy water sales and delivery
- Dry cleaning, carpet and seat washing services
- Private courier services
- Optimizing routes for reading electricity, water and natural gas meters
- Optimizing garbage collection routes

Routin is a route planning app. It is quite useful for drivers who should visit many addresses daily. By using Routin, you can sort your stops/jobs optimally according to the chosen locations and finish your jobs in a shorter time.

JUST CREATE A ROUTE, ADD STOPS AND CLICK OPTIMIZE!
ROUTIN PLANS YOUR ROUTE FOR YOU!!

Select the starting and ending stops or let Routin select the ending stop for you. Optimized order of stops can be seen in a list or on map. You can follow along your optimized route via selected navigation app and enjoy your ride!

Key Features

- You can add 300 stops per route and optimize them for free. If your credits are not enough, you can continue using the app by watching video ads, purchasing credits, or subscribing.
- By optimizing your route, you can increase your daily deliveries and save time and fuel
- Fast and reliable optimization algorithm. Don't wait for optimization. Optimize 100 stops under 5 seconds
- In your own language, you can use the voice input feature to add stops or notes
- You can use Google Maps, Yandex Maps, Waze, Here WeGo or any other GPS navigation apps
- Using notifications, you can confirm the delivery and start navigating to your next stop without leaving the navigation app
- You can add extra information to stops such as phone number, email address, group, note, photo etc.
- You can define a default note or message template. So you can send a message quickly
- You can start the optimization from your current location or from any stop on your route
- You can quickly create your routes by holding down on the map or searching for addresses
- When adding addresses, you can quickly add them just by searching by street name and number
- You can add stops by postcode in supporting countries (such as Great Britain, Singapore)

Address Book

Routin helps you to manage your contacts, customers, delivery or visit addresses using Address Book
Store names, phone numbers, photos, locations (latitude, longitude) and addresses of your stops.
Import multiple stops data using a file (CSV, KML, GPX, XLS).
Filter your stops according to name, address or phone number.

Visit Records

Take notes and photos of your visit to a stop on a route. Share visit details and display past visit data.
Share your route details, display summary report about your routes and planned distances for a selected period.

The application is used extensively for the following sectors and jobs

- Cargo services: Package delivery or package picking
- Health services: Patient examination or care visits
- Aid services: Municipalities or associations delivering aid packages or meals

- Personnel / Student transportation: Planning the shuttle routes
- Tourism: Planning tourist services, creating a travel route
- Planning of supply chain routes
- Food delivery: Food delivery by motor courier
- On-site installation, maintenance and repair services: Repair, maintenance and installation services for air conditioning, white goods, electronic equipment
- Daily milk, fresh fruits and vegetables, carboy water sales and delivery
- Dry cleaning, carpet and seat washing services
- Private courier services
- Optimizing routes for reading electricity, water and natural gas meters
- Optimizing garbage collection routes
- Planning meetings at multiple locations

ЭЦҚ-ны 4 таңбалы PIN-код пен құрылғ
bluejetty:00090347:ios.description:
«eGov Mobile» мобильді қосымшасы – халыққа мемлекеттік қызметтер мен сервистерді ұсынуға арналған жаңартылған eGov.kz экожүйесі.
eGov Mobile қосымшасы ЭЦҚ-ны барынша ыңғайлы пайдалануға мүмкіндік береді:
ЭЦҚ-ны 4 таңбалы PIN-код пен құрылғыңыздың биометриясына (Face ID, Touch ID) байлап қоюға болады. ЭЦҚ-ны бір рет байлап, әр жолы қайтадан ЭЦҚ таңдап, пароль енгізудің қажеті жоқ – авторизация мен қызметтерді алу бұрынғыдан оңай және жылдам.
Қызметтерді eGov Mobile арқылы алу ыңғайлырақ болды. Біз тек қызметтерді жаңа қосымшаға көшірумен шектелмей, олардың логикасын қайта қарап, қолданушы үшін барынша жеңілдеттік. Қызметтерді алу кезінде жеке деректерді қайта енгізудің қажеті жоқ – мәліметтер автоматты түрде жеке кабинеттен толтырылады.
Мобильное приложение электронного правительства «eGov Mobile» - обновленная экосистема eGov.kz для предоставления государственных услуг и сервисов населению.
Приложение eGov Mobile позволяет использовать ЭЦП максимально удобно:
eGov Mobile дает возможность привязать имеющийся ЭЦП к 4-х значному PIN коду и встроенной биометрии вашего устройства (Face ID, Touch ID). Один раз привязав ЭЦП к PIN коду и биометрии вы можете не отвлекаться на выбор ЭЦП и ввод пароля каждый раз при авторизации и получении услуг. 
Получение услуг через eGov Mobile стало удобнее. Мы не просто переносим новые услуги в новое приложение, а полностью переосмысливаем сами услуги. Вам не придется вводить ваши же данные при получении услуг, данные будут автоматически заполняться из личного кабинета eGov. 
“eGov Mobile” is an updated ecosystem of eGov.kz for providing government services and tools to the population.
The eGov Mobile app allows you to use your digital signature (EDS) in the most convenient way: You can link your existing EDS to a 4-digit PIN code and your device’s built-in biometrics (Face ID, Touch ID). Once linked, there’s no need to select your EDS or enter a password every time you log in or request a service — it works seamlessly.
Accessing services via eGov Mobile is now more user-friendly. We don’t just transfer services to the new app — we completely rethink the user experience. Your personal data will be automatically filled in from your eGov profile, so there’s no need to enter the same information repeatedly.

bluejetty:00017958:ios.description:
Glass Cap Federal Credit Union
Glass Cap FCU Mobile
Glass Cap FCU's free mobile banking application allows you to manage your money anytime, anywhere from your mobile device. You can check your balances, view account activity, make transfers between accounts, schedule payments, print statements, pay your bills, contact your bank and more! Main location in Connellsville, PA. 
Available features include:
Accounts:
- Check your latest account balance
Transfers:
- Easily transfer cash between your accounts.
Quick Balance:
- Quickly and easily view account balances without having to log in to your mobile app.
Touch ID:
- Touch ID allows you to use a secure and more efficient sign-on experience using your fingerprint.
Bill Pay:
- Pay bills on the go
Mobile Deposit
-Deposit checks using your device camera
Secure Messages
-Send messages safe and securely to your bank 
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features Face ID that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Glass Cap FCU Mobile App, you must be enrolled as an Glass Cap Federal Credit Union Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00156828:ios.name: Ecobot Collector
bluejetty:00156828:ios.summary: Ecobot Collector is the mobile app for field data collection within the Ecobot platform. Capture accurate field data, map features, organize photos, and complete required forms with workflows designed specifically for wetlands, streams, and
bluejetty:00156828:ios.description:
Ecobot Collector is the mobile app for field data collection within the Ecobot platform. Capture accurate field data, map features, organize photos, and complete required forms with workflows designed specifically for wetlands, streams, and natural resources assessments. Collector helps you eliminate repetitive data entry so you can stay focused on the scientific insight your clients rely on.
Collector pairs with Ecobot Manager, the web-based part of the platform, to create a connected field-to-office workflow. Together, they keep your data consistent, organized, and ready for reporting.
WHY ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTISTS USE ECOBOT
Accurate field data
Standardized data entry, photo organization, calculations, and references support clear and defensible documentation.
Built for real field conditions
Work online or offline. Collector saves entries locally and syncs when you are back online. Unsynced data alerts keep you confident that nothing is left behind.
More time for science
Fast entry, smart defaults, and automated calculations reduce time spent on paperwork and rework.
Consistent data across your team
Unified mobile and web workflows reduce variation and help teams deliver reliable results. Project Merge and Project Transfer let you simplify large projects and reassign ownership easily.
Connected to Ecobot Manager
Review, manage, QA, and export data from the web with enhanced photo editing, favorites, rotation, and multi-image tools. Two-factor authentication and role-based permissions support better team controls.
KEY FEATURES
Field data collection for wetlands, streams, and natural resources
Capture vegetation, soils, hydrology indicators, OHWM observations, and more. Record photos with mapped metadata and build automated project photo logs. Work entirely offline when needed.
Standardized forms and automated calculations
Use USACE Regional Wetland Determination Data Sheets, USACE Rapid OHWM, and NC DWQ Stream Identification forms. Collector automates indicators, dominance ratios, prevalence indices, and other required calculations.
Integrated mapping
Drop points, lines, and polygons. Navigate to features. View geolocated photos. Use mobile GPS or compatible GNSS receivers in the field. Jump directly to features and photos from the home screen.
Advanced photo tools
Capture, organize, and sort photos instantly. Tag favorites, rotate incorrectly oriented images, and use incremental loading for faster viewing. Use Ecobot Manager to review and QA photos efficiently.
Survey and workflow enhancements
Enjoy distraction-free survey views, color-coded status indicators, new manage-survey modal, and direct navigation between points, features, and photos.
Team and security features
Project Merge and Project Transfer simplify large-scale workflows and team reorganization. Unsynced data alerts and device naming support field-office alignment. Two-factor authentication and role-based permissions bring enterprise-grade controls.
Secure data storage
Ecobot uses AWS-backed infrastructure so your project data is safely stored, backed up, and accessible.
Ecobot is built by environmental consultants and trusted by leading AEC firms. With connected mobile and web workflows, Ecobot helps teams collect accurate data, reduce rework, and deliver consistent, defensible results.
ECOBOT® is a trademark of Ecobot, Inc. Patent pending.

bluejetty:00175668:ios.description:
Explore, imagine, create & play in Bluey's house. There's so much to do!
Wackadoo! Come join Bluey, her friends & family! For real life.
Fun, easy & calm kids learning game for boys and girls of all ages. Preschool children and toddlers will enjoy this app. Parents and other family members can play along too!
EXPLORE
Discover and play all over the Heeler family home, just like in the TV show! Hunt for longdogs, play a game of Pop up Croc, listen to your favorite Bluey tunes, and so much more! Can you find all the hidden surprises?
IMAGINE
Every room allows for deep, imaginative play. Just like Bluey, anything is possible if you use your imagination! Make up your own stories as you go, or re-create your favorite Bluey moments. Bingo, Bandit, Chili, and all of Bluey’s friends and family are here and ready to join the fun.
CREATE
Bluey's house is your virtual playset and the fun is at your fingertips! Tap, drag and interact with everything. Cook up some favorite recipes in the kitchen, help build a pizza oven in the backyard or throw a tea party - there’s no end to what you can create! 
PLAY
Have a game of keepy-uppy, bounce on the trampoline, splash in a tub full of bubbles or swing in the backyard - the possibilities are endless! 
COLORING

bluejetty:00173110:ios.summary:
Sort, knit, and repeat! Solve this color puzzle, and you’ll be tickled pink!
Looking for a fun way to spend your time or chill out? We’ve got you covered with this top-notch puzzle-solving game! Our sort puzzle took the intuitive mechanics
bluejetty:00173110:ios.description:
Sort, knit, and repeat! Solve this color puzzle, and you’ll be tickled pink!
Looking for a fun way to spend your time or chill out? We’ve got you covered with this top-notch puzzle-solving game! Our sort puzzle took the intuitive mechanics from water-sort and ball-sort genres, managed to thread it with colorful graphics, and knitted it all together to create one of the most engaging free puzzle games for you to enjoy!
Color match yarn and tread through the levels of our sort-color game to crack every puzzle. Move threads between clothing items to get the correct coloring match and materials for your knitting missions. Yep, in our fun puzzle game, you can even create clothes. Get your yarn ball rolling—start color-matching this puzzle now to unwind!
Match every happy color
Our sort color game will tangle yarn in everything: mittens, jackets, and even shorts! Tap to pick the yarn from one item and add it somewhere else, to color sort it and solve the puzzle. You can combine only the threads of the same color in this color-matching challenge. And don’t run out of free spots for sorting, or you’ll have to start from scratch!
Customize your sort puzzle
Personalize your sorting experience with our fun puzzle game! Earn rewards by completing color games and use them to pick the yarn type. A wide choice of yarn—from puffy to beaded—will help you color match every puzzle. You can also switch the items and try to color sort shorts instead of mittens. Explore endless options in our sorting game!
Start knitting your wardrobe
Immerse yourself in the fashion world with our captivating sorting game! Unravel each color puzzle to get more yarn and unleash your creativity by crafting a dress in a happy color, a stylish tee, or even a fabulous swimsuit! Dive into the world of color games and start sorting your way up to become the knitting legend!
Try a new twist on string art
Ever done string art? It’s incredibly soothing—and so is our sort puzzle! This free puzzle game for relaxation will quickly become your fave if you’re a fan of water-sort or ball-sort puzzles! After all, what could be cozier than knitting? With its colorful process of sorting, engrossing coloring match mechanics, and stunning graphics, our sort-color game will impress you!
Pick our puzzle-solving game over any other water sort puzzle or color sort and feel the difference! Download this captivating color puzzle now, take your nicest yarn, and sort ‘em all!
Ensure this sorting game won’t tangle any thread! Get color matches right, solve every sort puzzle, and create your clothes!

bluejetty:00024657:ios.summary:
Real-time music visualization.
30 Visuals × 78 Shapes — every play, a different piece.
■ Design the visuals from a free combination
4 categories with 30 Visuals and 78 Shapes, Knobs, Text, backgrounds, 10 Screen Effects and 10 Wallpaper B
bluejetty:00024657:ios.description:
Real-time music visualization.
30 Visuals × 78 Shapes — every play, a different piece.
■ Design the visuals from a free combination
4 categories with 30 Visuals and 78 Shapes, Knobs, Text, backgrounds, 10 Screen Effects and 10 Wallpaper Blends. Layer them into anything from a club-style spectrum to an ambient nebula.
Visuals and Shapes switch on the beat of the song.
On HDR displays, glows and gradients render with brightness beyond SDR.
■ Preset sharing
Save the look you made as a preset and share it with a code or a link.
■ Two recording modes for different intents
Recording keeps every knob move and Visual switch you make. Export locks the UI so a stable, hands-off render finishes on its own.
Before exporting, you can also edit the show along the flow of the song, like in a video editor.
Both hide the UI, support up to 4K with HDR export, and can auto-record a full song in Playlist mode.
■ Four audio sources
Files (music on device; iOS also imports from the iTunes library)
Microphone (low-latency input)
Simulation (visuals keep moving with no source)
AUv3 (visualize plugin audio)
▸ Time-synced lyrics
Songs available in a supported lyric database can display lyrics in time with the music. Song title and artist name too.
You can also show lyrics you typed yourself.
▸ External display output (AirPlay / HDMI adapters)
Connect a TV or projector via iOS Screen Mirroring (AirPlay) or an HDMI adapter.
The visuals go full screen while the UI stays on your device.
■ Play with whatever's in your hand
Touch and flick
iPad + Magic Keyboard shortcuts
MIDI controllers (long-press any knob to assign, BLE MIDI supported)
Gamepad (D-pad, buttons, sticks)
■ Where to use it
· VJ sets at clubs, live shows and streams
· Music videos and lyric videos for social
· Screen visuals for a room or a party
■ Notes
· DRM-protected tracks (e.g. Apple Music) can't be played.
· For issues or requests, reach out via in-app feedback or support.

bluejetty:00076597:ios.name: NoteGrid – Play Music By Ear
bluejetty:00076597:ios.summary: NoteGrid (formerly Wimbo) is a music matching game for anyone interested in making music. Earn coins when you recreate songs and beats using our super simple sequencer for beginners. Solve the daily musical puzzles by making songs or modify
bluejetty:00076597:ios.description:
NoteGrid (formerly Wimbo) is a music matching game for anyone interested in making music. Earn coins when you recreate songs and beats using our super simple sequencer for beginners. Solve the daily musical puzzles by making songs or modifying beats and melodies. Develop your musical ear by deciphering melodies in our 100 levels.
WHAT THE H*CK IS NOTEGRID?
• A music game. You listen to melodies and beats and recreate them on the grid. 
• Free, with ads. Yep, ads suck, but it keeps the game free for everyone.
• An easy music grid sequencer to make your own music even if you don't play an instrument, don't know how to compose music or know any music theory.
• The daily challenges are tiny fragments of beats and/or melodies and your goal is to complete the melody or beat by adding to it. Kinda like musical ad libs.
• The easiest (and most fun) way to train your ear and music skills by playing our 99+ levels.
• Are you seriously still reading? Stop it. Just download it. It's free.
WHAT NOTEGRID IS NOT:
• NoteGrid is NOT a fancy DAW (music production app) like Ableton Live, Logic Pro X, FL Studio, Pro Tools.
• NoteGrid is NOT for recording audio, mixing music or learning an instrument.
• NoteGrid is NOT an app for finding recipes. It just isn't. Don't ask.
WHY NOTEGRID
Team NoteGrid consists of just 2 peeps: Luis and Andrés. We're on a mission to make music-making so easy, any idiot could do it. We also want to make it so fun, that you'd be an idiot not to use it. Apparently, we have a thing for idiots. This app is far from perfect, but we listen to 100% of the feedback we receive and we're adding cool stuff and fixing un-cool stuff every day to reach our goals. We launch updates at least once a week. So, always let us know what you like, what you'd like and what you dislike. Maybe at some point you can tell us "Why NoteGrid".
Make your first beats and melodies FOR FREE. SOME ADS.
EASY MUSIC MAKER
• We made the simplest little grid sequencer so that any idiot could make cool-sounding music. Imagine what you could do. 
• Unlock more instruments as you progress
DEVELOP YOUR MUSICAL EAR
• Ear training made fun.

bluejetty:00039544:ios.summary: Hello VPN is a private and secure VPN service with remarkable features. “VPN and proxy server companies are all the same” we can hear you saying. Actually it’s not always that simple. Hello VPN never ever keeps user logs, as it believes in
bluejetty:00039544:ios.description:
Hello VPN is a private and secure VPN service with remarkable features. “VPN and proxy server companies are all the same” we can hear you saying. Actually it’s not always that simple. Hello VPN never ever keeps user logs, as it believes in absolute user privacy and internet freedom. Although a lot of VPN companies claim to have such a motto, it is not always the case, because of the binding regulations and laws some VPN companies are subject to.
That’s right, some countries may be subject to regulations of intelligence alliances like The Five Eyes (FVEY), The Nine Eyes, and The Fourteen Eyes Alliances. Although there is nothing wrong with that, having a company headquarter based in alliance countries may result in an obligation to keep user logs on a regular basis, contrary to the promise made to you by some VPN or proxy server companies! 
Fortunately there are still light-side of the force VPN and proxy server companies abiding by their word, hence keeping no user logs! As you may have already guessed, Hello VPN is one of them. Thanks to Hello VPN being an Estonia based VPN service, such binding regulations and laws are not applicable to Hello VPN.
No doubt there are many reasons to use a VPN or a proxy server e.g. ultimate privacy, boosting gaming performance by means of a stable connection, accessing services available for only specific locations, fast video streaming, WiFi security, anonymous browsing aka incognito mode etc. No matter the motivation behind, you are all set with Hello VPN! Variety of VPN servers are optimized for different use cases!
Did Hello VPN begin to appeal to you? The word “Hello” stands as a way of greeting to the free internet, and the word VPN stands for Virtual Private Network. Keeping your private information private, and keeping prying eyes away is the essential goal of Hello VPN. 
How does Hello VPN work? HelloVPN works by routing your Apple device’s connection through private servers of HelloVPN rather than your internet service provider (ISP) directly, so that when your data is sent to the internet, it comes from the HelloVPN servers. That’s right, HelloVPN creates a private tunnel from your device to the internet, and basically hides your data through encryption.
“But what are the proxy servers?” is a frequently asked question to our customer support. A proxy server is also a system that provides a gateway between users and the internet. “What is the difference between a VPN and a proxy server then?” occurs to be a common follow-up question. The main difference between a VPN and a proxy server is encryption. VPNs hide all your web activity, such as all the apps you use, websites you visit, using encryption. Proxy servers on the other hand, will only change your IP address on a specific session or on a specific app, but they won’t encrypt all your online activities. In other words, a VPN secures all your network traffic, while a proxy server works on an application level. A proxy server is also relatively suitable for browsing the internet, but it’s not as safe and secure as a VPN.
“Is Hello VPN free?” You can get your secure VPN connection completely free by watching in-app advertisements within Hello VPN’s basic mode. You can also upgrade to premium mode anytime to remove in-app ads, and also to access all the extra network features. 
About Hello VPN Premium Subscription:
*The subscription covers VPN usage.
*Hello VPN subscription period alternatives are 1 week, 1 month and 1 year. 
*Based on your plan every 1 week or 1 month or 1 year your VPN subscription renews. 
*Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at only your confirmation.
*Hello VPN subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off.
You can cancel your Hello VPN subscription anytime via this URL:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Hello VPN’s terms of use can be found via this URL on Hello VPN’s official website:
https://www.hellovpn.app/en/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00138620:ios.name: WIFI Analyzer - DNS Speed Test
bluejetty:00138620:ios.summary: WIFI Analyzer - DNS SpeedTest (also known as Net Analyzer - Network Scanner) is an easy-to-use tool for checking and analyzing your network. This app provides all the essential features like traceroute, port scanner, Wake-on-LAN, and Blueto
bluejetty:00138620:ios.description:
WIFI Analyzer - DNS SpeedTest (also known as Net Analyzer - Network Scanner) is an easy-to-use tool for checking and analyzing your network. This app provides all the essential features like traceroute, port scanner, Wake-on-LAN, and Bluetooth Finder.
Key Features:
• Network Information:
→ See details about your current network, including SSID, BSSID, IP address, subnet mask, gateway, external IP address, DNS servers, and more.
• DNS Speed Test (supports DoH and DoT):
→ Measures and compares the response times of different DNS servers.
→ Helps you find the fastest server for better network performance.
• Speed Checker:
→ Measures your network’s upload and download speeds.
→ Shows your connection’s performance in real time.
• Bonjour Service Browser:
→ Lists all Bonjour services on your wireless network.
• Wake-on-LAN:
→ Wake up devices on your network.
→ Can remember MAC addresses for easier device management.
• LAN Scanner:
→ Scan your local network (LAN) to find all connected devices.
• Ping Test:
→ Measures the round-trip time (RTT) to any website or IP address.
• DNS Lookup (supports DoH and DoT):
→ Look up domain names to find their IP addresses.
→ Shows detailed DNS records like SOA, A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, NAPTR, CAA, and more.
• Port Scanner:
→ Check any website or IP address for open ports.
• Traceroute:
→ Trace the route packets take to reach a destination.
→ Helps identify network bottlenecks and latency issues.
• Bluetooth Scanner:
→ Discover nearby Bluetooth devices.
→ See details like device name, signal strength, distance, RSSI, and more.
• iOS 14 Home Widget:
→ Use a widget to see network information directly on your Home Screen.
• Thank you for choosing our app!

bluejetty:00126998:ios.description:
Tired of diets that never last and calorie counting that feels exhausting?
My Plate Coach is a nutrition app that helps you build healthy eating habits, enjoy a healthy diet, and maintain a healthy weight — without counting calories.
Using the Balanced Plate Method, photo food journaling, and our 80/20 approach, you’ll learn to build balanced meals, practical nutrition skills, and confidence around food.
It’s not about following another diet.
It’s about learning nutrition skills that last a lifetime.
START WITH OUR 4-WEEK KICK START
Healthy eating isn’t something you master overnight. Everyone begins with our guided Kick Start.
Each week focuses on one essential nutrition skill to help you build healthy eating habits step by step.
Week 1 – Balanced Meals
Learn how to build balanced meals using the Balanced Plate Method.
Week 2 – Hunger & Fullness
Learn to recognize your body’s hunger and fullness signals.
Week 3 – Portion Size
Discover portion sizes that work for your body without counting calories or weighing food.
Week 4 – The Psychology of Eating
Understand the habits and emotions that influence your eating so healthy eating becomes easier.
Small improvements every day lead to lasting healthy eating habits and a more balanced diet.
LEARN BY DOING
Most people know a lot about healthy eating. The challenge is putting that knowledge into practice.
My Plate Coach works like your personal nutrition coach, helping you learn by doing—one meal at a time.
Instead of strict meal plans, you’ll develop practical nutrition skills for real life.
You’ll learn how to:
• Build balanced meals using the Balanced Plate Method
• Recognize healthy portion sizes
• Eat more regularly
• Build healthy eating habits that last
• The basics of intuitive eating
These nutrition skills help you enjoy a healthy diet, maintain a healthy weight, and create lasting change.
HOW IT WORKS
• Take meal photos
• Use the Balanced Plate Method to build balanced meals
• Collect hearts for balanced meals
• Follow your 80/20 balance score
• Build regular healthy eating habits
As you become more aware of your eating patterns, healthier food choices become more natural.
WHO MY PLATE COACH IS FOR
Perfect for you if you:
• Are tired of dieting and calorie counting
• Want to achieve or maintain a healthy weight
• Want a healthy diet without strict food rules
• Want to build healthy eating habits that last
• Want to improve your relationship with food
• Want support during weight loss or while using weight loss medication
My Plate Coach focuses on practical nutrition coaching, balanced meals, and lifelong healthy eating habits instead of calorie counting, macro tracking, or strict meal plans.
WHY MY PLATE COACH WORKS
Healthy eating isn’t about willpower. It’s about building practical nutrition skills and healthy eating habits that last.
Most nutrition apps focus on numbers. My Plate Coach focuses on learning.
Instead of telling you exactly what to eat, we help you build balanced meals, enjoy a balanced diet, and develop the confidence to make better food choices in everyday life.
The result is a healthier relationship with food, a healthy diet, a healthy weight, and healthy eating habits that feel natural and sustainable.
WHAT MAKES MY PLATE COACH DIFFERENT
• Guided 4-week Kick Start
• Personal nutrition coach in your pocket
• Balanced Plate Method coaching
• Learn to build balanced meals
• Practical nutrition coaching
• The 80/20 balance approach
• Photo food journaling
• Focus on healthy eating habits instead of short-term diets
• Learning by doing rather than following strict rules
ABOUT US
We’re a small woman-led team passionate about helping people stop dieting, build healthy eating habits, and enjoy a healthier relationship with food. Our mission is to make nutrition simple and sustainable. Together, we’ve helped tens of thousands of people build balanced meals, enjoy a balanced diet, achieve a healthy weight, and develop healthy eating habits.

bluejetty:00063355:ios.description:
Ready for a fresh spin on puzzle fun? Jump into Farm Heroes Saga by King and enjoy an enchanting world filled with adorable cropsies, delightful fruits, and charming farm adventures! Match, harvest, and team up with your animal friends to protect your village from Rancid the Raccoon's sneaky plans.
Fresh Matches & Juicy Rewards: 
- Strategically match tasty fruits and cropsies to solve puzzles and keep your farm flourishing. 
- Journey through delightful levels packed with playful challenges, clever combos, and rewarding surprises.
- Level up your puzzle skills and watch your farm grow stronger with each match!
Friendly Faces & Special Features: 
- Farm Club: Team up with charming animal friends who’ll help you through tough puzzles and boost your harvest. 
- Boost Your Harvest: Strategically match cropsies to increase the value of the adjacent vegetables and quickly reach a higher score.
- Magic Beans: Earn Magic Beans to activate boosters and give yourself a handy advantage during challenging puzzles.
Fun Events & Friendly Rivalries: 
- Tractor Dash: Challenge your friends to friendly matches, climb leaderboards, and earn fantastic rewards.
- Farm Teams: Join your village friends to strategize, chat, and conquer special events together.
- Daily Surprises: Check in daily for sweet bonuses, handy boosters, and surprise gifts that keep your puzzle journey fresh.
Join A Farm Like No Other:
- Explore thousands of beautifully crafted puzzles, with exciting new levels constantly growing.
- Play anytime, anywhere—whether you're relaxing offline or connecting online. 
- Enjoy stress-free yet captivating puzzles, perfect for a quick break or a relaxing evening.
Whether you're already a match-3 enthusiast or just getting started, Farm Heroes Saga by King is your ticket to a puzzle adventure that’s both fun and fresh. Start your farming and matching journey today!
Farm Heroes Saga is free to play, but optional in-game items require payment. You can turn off the payment feature in your device’s settings.
