bluejetty:00082793:ios.description:
Reset is your personalized path to lasting weight loss — built around how your body actually works, not generic calorie math.
Most diets fail because they treat everyone the same. Reset starts by identifying your metabolic type, then adapts your plan to it — so the changes you make actually stick.
HOW RESET WORKS
• Discover your metabolic type — A quick, science-backed assessment reveals how your body processes energy, so your plan fits you from day one.
• Optional wellness scan — Use your phone camera for a quick, optional face scan that provides general wellness estimates to help personalize your plan.
• Personalized meal guidance — Get meal recommendations tailored to your type, your goals, and your eating window — no rigid meal plans, no deprivation.
• Talk it through with Ester — Your AI coach is there to answer questions, keep you accountable, and adjust as your life changes. Type or talk — it's like having a coach in your pocket.
• Track what matters — See your progress with a Reset Score that reflects real change, not just the number on the scale.
WHY RESET IS DIFFERENT
Reset isn't another calorie counter. It's a personalized system that learns your patterns and meets you where you are — so weight loss finally feels sustainable.
Start your Reset today and lose weight for good.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
reset pro is an auto-renewing subscription that unlocks the full Reset experience. Monthly and annual plans are available — current pricing for your region is shown in the app before you subscribe.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.reset.com/privacy-policy
Health & Wellness Disclaimer: 
Reset is intended for general wellness and informational purposes only. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or health condition. The insights it provides — including pulse, heart-rate variability, and breathing-rhythm estimates — are non-diagnostic wellness estimates and are not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making any health or medical decisions.

bluejetty:00086888:ios.description:
The myenergi app seamlessly connects you to your entire ecosystem of eco-smart devices, including our new zappi GLO EV charger, giving you full control and access from anywhere in the world.
KEY FEATURES 
Smart Energy Management - View your household power distribution and consumption at a glance with intuitive animated displays. 
Real-time Monitoring - Track all your myenergi devices - zappi, eddi, libbi, hub, and the new zappi GLO - with live updates and historical data.
Optimise Renewable Energy - Maximise self-consumption and see your green contribution indicators to make the most of your renewable energy. 
Smart Charging Preferences - Set charging preferences for your EV chargers based on energy tariffs and available green energy. 
Intelligent Scheduling - Programme your devices to operate during optimal times with smart tariff integrations. 
Device Prioritisation - Control which devices receive excess power first to maximise efficiency.
BENEFITS
Save Money - Optimise your energy usage to reduce utility bills. 
Reduce Carbon Footprint - Track and maximise your green energy contribution. 
Complete Control - Manage your entire myenergi ecosystem from anywhere. 
Simple Visualisation - Understand complex energy flows through intuitive displays. 
Future-Ready - Supports all myenergi devices: zappi, eddi, libbi, hub and the new zappi GLO.
We regularly update the app based on customer feedback to improve functionality and introduce new features.
Have questions or need support? Contact us at support@myenergi.com. We're here to help!
By using this app, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.

bluejetty:00114678:ios.description:
Claim the settlement money you're owed.
Billions in class action payouts go unclaimed every year. Brands like Apple, Meta, Google, Amazon, Visa, and more have paid massive settlements - and you might be eligible without knowing it.
Collect finds open settlements, shows you what you could receive, and helps you file claims in minutes. No lawyers. No legal jargon. Just money that's already yours.
WHAT'S INCLUDED WITH YOUR SUBSCRIPTION
 - See estimated payouts before you file
 - Know upfront if proof is required
 - Featured settlements highlight top opportunities
 - Track all your pending claims in one place
 - Get notified when new settlements drop
HOW IT WORKS
 1. Tell us which brands you've purchased from
 2. We match you with settlements you qualify for
 3. Review details and estimated payout
 4. Submit your claim to the official administrator
 5. If approved, get paid
LEGAL INFORMATION
 Collect is not a law firm. All claims are reviewed by official court-appointed administrators who determine approval, payment amounts, and timing.
 Claims are submitted under penalty of perjury. You are responsible for accuracy.
SUBSCRIPTION
Collect requires an active subscription to access all features.
 - Monthly (billed monthly)
 - Annual (billed yearly)
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
https://settlementfinder.com/terms
https://settlementfinder.com/privacy

Farmako – India’s Fastest Online Medicine Delivery App
30-Minute Delivery | 24/7 Support | Up to 20% Off
Join 4 lakh+ happy customers who trust Farmako for fast, reliable, and hassle-free medicine delivery. We make essential medicines and healthcare products accessible anytime, anywhere – delivered in just 30 minutes.
Currently available in Delhi, Gurgaon, and Moradabad. Expanding soon to more cities across India.
Why Choose Farmako?
Lightning-Fast 30-Minute Delivery
Skip long queues at pharmacies. Farmako delivers medicines, wellness products, and healthcare essentials straight to your doorstep in just 30 minutes, 24/7.
Expanding Nationwide
Currently serving Delhi, Gurgaon, and Moradabad, with plans to launch in more cities across India.
Up to 20% Off on Medicines and Healthcare Products
Save more with exclusive discounts on essential medicines, personal care items, and wellness products.
Free Delivery on Orders Above Rs. 499
Enjoy free delivery when your order exceeds Rs. 499. Making healthcare affordable and accessible.
24/7 Availability – Because Health Can’t Wait
Order anytime – day or night – and we will deliver when you need it most.
Easy Ordering with a Seamless App Experience
 • Search and Order Easily – Find medicines and products in seconds
 • Instant Order Tracking – Track your order in real time
 • Multiple Payment Options – Secure payments and cash on delivery available
Wide Range of Healthcare Products
Farmako offers a diverse selection of medicines and healthcare essentials, including:
 • General Medicines – Cold, fever, pain relief, digestion care
 • Diabetes and Heart Care – Manage chronic conditions with trusted brands
 • Wellness and Nutrition – Vitamins, supplements, immunity boosters
 • Personal Care and Hygiene – Skincare, oral care, hygiene products
 • Baby and Mother Care – Trusted baby essentials and maternal wellness products
 • Fitness and Lifestyle – Gym supplements, fitness accessories
 • Medical Devices and Equipment – BP monitors, thermometers, and more
Expert Pharmacist Support
Need help choosing the right medicines? Our licensed pharmacists are available to guide you 24/7.
100% Licensed and Verified Pharmacies
Farmako operates fully licensed pharmacy stores, ensuring all medicines and healthcare products are sourced from verified suppliers and meet legal safety standards.
Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Delivery
 • Contactless and Hygienic Delivery – Your safety is our priority
 • Trained Delivery Professionals – Careful handling of medicines
 • Fastest Medicine Delivery – Get what you need in just 30 minutes
Download Farmako today and experience India’s fastest online pharmacy.

*A fully redesigned app with a sleek, in-line experience
*Enhanced, smoother user experience
*Brand-new puzzles, polls, quizzes, and prediction games
*More social media integration

*Watch Love Island USA on Peacock, open the app at showtime, and play along in real time
*Got opinions? Perfect — there’s a poll for that
*Vote to influence key moments in the Villa, from dates and eliminations to crowning the 2026 winners

*Exclusive videos, photos, and breaking news
*First Look previews before every episode
*Steamy photo galleries you won’t find anywhere else
*Islander profiles so you can get to know your faves
*Shop official merchandise, including official Love Island USA water bottles and hoodies, as well as fashion, accessories, and decor inspired by the Islanders and the Villa 
Open to U.S. residents 18+ or with parent/guardian permission. Data charges may apply.

-- Experience the Power of Over 500 Iconic Car Models – All in One App --
Are you a true car enthusiast? Do you love the thunderous sound of high-performance engines, the sleek designs of exotic vehicles, and the challenge of testing your
bluejetty:00160082:ios.description:
-- Experience the Power of Over 500 Iconic Car Models – All in One App --
Are you a true car enthusiast? Do you love the thunderous sound of high-performance engines, the sleek designs of exotic vehicles, and the challenge of testing your automotive knowledge? Look no further. This app brings you the most immersive car sound experience available on mobile, featuring the roars, startup growls, and revs of over 500 different car models, with new vehicles added every single week.
Whether you're into the deep rumble of American muscle cars, the refined purr of luxury European brands, or the aggressive tone of Japanese performance machines, this app has it all. It's the ultimate soundboard and reference hub for petrolheads of all ages.
-- Massive Selection of Cars --
Choose from 58 of the world’s most renowned car brands, including Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche, Toyota, Nissan, McLaren, and many more.
Dive into 17 unique categories, such as Exotics, Track Cars, JDM (Japanese Domestic Market), SUVs, Muscle Cars, Rally Legends, Supercars, Hypercars, and even Classic Icons. Each category is carefully curated to offer variety and excitement, helping you explore vehicles from every segment of the automotive world.
-- Personal Garage Feature --
Love what you hear? Add any car to your personalized garage so you can access your favorite models anytime. Create your own dream collection of sounds from across decades and continents.
-- Detailed Car Info at Your Fingertips --
Each car profile includes key technical data and facts, like horsepower, torque, engine type, top speed, acceleration times, and production year. Learn while you listen—perfect for car lovers who want more than just sound.
-- Authentic Engine Sounds --
Feel the adrenaline as you play realistic start-up and acceleration sounds recorded from actual vehicles.
Hear the difference between a turbocharged inline-four and a naturally aspirated V12. This is more than noise—it's art for your ears.
-- Challenge Your Automotive Knowledge --
Think you’re a car expert? Prove it in the integrated quiz mode, where you'll identify cars based on sounds, silhouettes, logos, and facts. Track your score, improve your rank, and challenge your friends to see who knows more about cars.
-- Free to Use, Built for Car Lovers --
Every single car sound is available for free—no hidden fees or locked content. The app is designed to be simple, fast, and user-friendly, with a clean interface that puts your favorite cars and features just a tap away.
-- Weekly Updates --
We’re constantly adding new cars every week, so your collection keeps growing and evolving. From brand-new models to legendary classics, you’ll always have something fresh to discover.
Legal Note
All brand names and logos used in this app are copyrighted and/or registered trademarks of their respective companies. Their inclusion in low resolution and for identification purposes within this quiz and soundboard app is considered fair use under applicable copyright laws.
Download now and let the engines speak for themselves. Build your dream garage, test your knowledge, and immerse yourself in the world of automotive passion—one rev at a time.

Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/carsoundsios/privacy/

bluejetty:00175667:ios.description:
Dive into the delightful world of Sticker Book Puzzle, where imagination meets puzzle-solving in a fun and engaging experience. This innovative app is the ultimate blend of adult coloring, art games, and brain-teasing challenges. This unique app offers a calming and colorful escape, combining the joy of coloring with the thrill of solving puzzles. 
Say goodbye to traditional coloring books and hello to the Sticker Book Puzzle. Instead of using pencils, you'll fill intricate designs with vibrant stickers. It's a fresh take on adult coloring; every sticker is a stroke of creativity. Choose from a rich range of colors and match them with stickers to complete stunning artwork. Relax and unwind with Sticker Book Puzzle's calm gameplay. 
Sticker Book Puzzle isn't just a coloring book; it's a brain teaser, too! Solve puzzles by strategically placing stickers to match the patterns and unlock the complete picture. Flex your mind and boost your IQ skills! 
Features:
- Puzzles with a Twist! - It's a creative twist that adds a new dimension to your puzzle-solving journey.
- Create Your Masterpiece! - Choose from a wide array of stickers, themes, and backgrounds to craft a unique visual story that's all your own.
- Endless Themes and Challenges! - Explore diverse themes, from breathtaking landscapes to adorable animals and famous landmarks to whimsical fantasy worlds.
- Fun for All Ages! - Sticker Book Puzzle is perfect for kids and adults alike. It's a wonderful way to engage in creative play, exercise your brain, and bond with family members over shared puzzle-solving experiences.
- Achieve Sticker Mastery! - Collect stickers, earn rewards, and unlock achievements as you progress through the game. Challenge yourself with puzzles of varying difficulty levels and become a Sticker Book Puzzle champion.
- Stimulate Your Mind and Imagination! - Solving puzzles and creating sticker art stimulates cognitive skills, enhances concentration, and boosts creativity.
- Tranquil Gameplay - Sticker Book Puzzle provides a calm and serene gaming environment for all ages. It's the perfect choice for adults seeking relaxation and kids looking for a fun coloring and puzzle game.
Whether you're into coloring by numbers, painting by numbers, or simply want a relaxing and artistic gaming experience, Sticker Book Puzzle has it all. 
Download the app and embark on color therapy filled with vibrant colors and mind-teasing puzzles.

Oh no! The enemy is attacking our home.
Pick your weapons, gather your soldiers, and protect your home. Join the battle in War Inc: Rise now!
### Protect Your Home
Every night, waves of enemies come to break our defenses and destroy our home. Collect weapons, expand your land, and call on your soldiers to guard the gates and keep our home safe. Watch out for the big bosses that show up and cause massive damage.
### Fight in Different Game Modes
- PVE: Clear levels, unlock more weapons and face new challenges.
- PVP-Coop: Team up with friends or family to take down strong enemies.
- PVP: Defend your base against other players.
- Boss Fights: Gather your troops and use different weapons to defeat the bosses.
- Guild Wars: Fight for your guild and win together.
### Unlock and Upgrade Weapons, Soldiers, and Your Home
Unlock powerful weapons and unique soldiers. Upgrade your home base with strong defenses and new features. Plan your strategy and outsmart your enemies!
### Become the Best Player
Join competitions and events to climb the leaderboards. Show off your skills and collect rare items. Prove you’re the top commander!
### Always Getting Better
Regular updates bring new content and challenges. Stay ahead with the latest strategies and improvements. Enjoy fresh gameplay every time you log in!
### Play with Friends, Family, and Rivals!
Team up with friends and family for cooperative battles. Compete against other players to see who’s the best. Enjoy a fun and rewarding multiplayer experience!
### What's New
- Battle alone or with friends against players from around the world.
- Fast-paced PVE and PVP-Coop modes designed for mobile.
- Unlock and collect new, powerful weapons with special attacks and abilities.
- Daily events and game modes.
- Build Your Home: Create a safe and resource-rich base.
- Climb the leaderboards in global and local rankings.
- Join or start a clan to share tips and fight together.
### Cool Features
- 👊 Mix and Match: Use different soldiers and strategies to win.
- 🤗 Make Friends: Team up with other players and win together.
- 🏆 Be the Best: Show everyone you're the top player.
- 💎 Get Rewards: Find valuable items to make your soldiers and home better.
- 📺 Watch and Learn: See battles and learn new tricks.
- 🎮 Lots to Do: From solo missions to team challenges, War Inc: Rise has something for everyone.
### From the Makers of Art of War: Legions and Island War!
### Get in Touch
We love hearing from you! For questions or suggestions, reach us at rise@boooea.com
### Follow Us
- Discord: https://discord.gg/RUT9GNDrWM
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WarIncRise
### Privacy Policy
- Privacy Policy: https://www.89trillion.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00187071:ios.name: VÚB Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00187071:ios.summary: VÚB Bank brings you the award-winning VÚB Mobile Banking app, which gives you complete management of your finances and secure access to a number of services that make you no longer have to go to a branch. The app retains clarity and simplic
bluejetty:00187071:ios.description:
VÚB Bank brings you the award-winning VÚB Mobile Banking app, which gives you complete management of your finances and secure access to a number of services that make you no longer have to go to a branch. The app retains clarity and simplicity and you can customize it to suit your needs. 
Most popular features:
• Remote banking – possibility to contact your advisor, upload your documents, sign any necessary documents remotely etc.
• Confirmation of online card payments with Mobile PIN or biometrics
• Withdrawal from an ATM by mobile phone – the safest form of cash withdrawal without the need for a card and the card PIN
• Uploading of invoices in PDF format directly to the mobile app
• Authorized calls to our Contact centre from your app – you skip the authorization step and save several minutes of your time
• Postal order, IBAN and QR code scanner – you can easily pay invoices without lengthy filling in of data 
• Biometric login – used by up to 30% of our clients 
• Mobile payments support – add and manage your cards via the app
• Payment sharing – a quick way to share your IBAN or various payments and costs with other people via payment link (Payme) or QR code 
• Quick balance check on selected account – no log-in needed
• Overview of loans and an online loan application
• Online credit card loans payments
• Card blocking or temporary deactivation/activation in case of loss or theft
• Payment to a phone number
Other useful features: 
• Quick access to your selected features
• Quick balance for a selected account – account balance info without the need to login
• Overview and set up of notifications sent to your phone number, email, or as PUSH messages
• Management of standing orders and payment partners
• Unlimited payment operations
• Possibility to interact with a branch employee
• Planned payments – clearly structured into pending payments, standing orders and installments
• Daily savings
• Change the Internet limit on both debit and credit cards
• Credit card PIN display
• Change the limit for ATM withdrawals, merchant payments, and the maximum daily limit for debit cards
• Online opening of savings accounts and travel insurance purchase
• Product statements
• Overview of all banking products with the option to request them 
• Profile picture 
• Overview of direct debits authorizations
• Currency convertor and exchange rate
• Map of branches and ATMs
• Option to arrange an appointment with your personal bank advisor or banker
How do I activate the app?
To activate the application, you need to have the Nonstop banking service enabled. On the home screen of the Mobile banking app, click on the "Activation" button. Sign in with the ID number and password you use to log in to Internet banking. You will then receive an SMS with an activation code. Write it into the app and choose your new 4-digit Mobile PIN. If your device supports fingerprint scanning or Face ID, you can also activate this sign-in method.
How much will you pay for this service?
The Mobile banking app is free and does not contain any paid services. Fees for operations carried out through Mobile banking are subject to a valid price list of VÚB Bank.
If you don’t have the Nonstop banking service, or in case of any other questions, please contact us:
• via service KONTAKT at 0850 123 000 within Slovakia or at +421 2 4855 59 70 from abroad
• by e-mail at kontakt@vub.sk

bluejetty:00149676:ios.name: CT DMV Permit Practice Test
bluejetty:00149676:ios.summary: Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Connecticut state? Use our Connecticut DMV Permit Practice Test to prepare for the DMV test and get your driver’s p
bluejetty:00149676:ios.description:
Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Connecticut state? Use our Connecticut DMV Permit Practice Test to prepare for the DMV test and get your driver’s permit with ease.
Our app provides questions based on the official manual from the Department of Motor Vehicle (DMV) of the Connecticut state. The app includes driver’s permit module for the car, motorcycle and Commercial Driving License CDL. The app is a ready to use study guide material for those who want to prepare for their driver’s license test. Our app can be used to practice for the Car, Motorcycle and CDL Drive’s license.
Followings are the features of Connecticut CT DMV Permit Practice Test app.
QUESTIONS FROM OFFICIAL REFERENCE MATERIAL 
The Connecticut DMV Driver’s Manual served as the inspiration for all of the content and questions that have been included in the app. Prepare yourself for the questions that will be on the test by going over them in advance. 
PRACTICE CATEGORY WISE QUESTIONS
The app includes a practice module that allows to get familiar with questions that fall under different categories like Traffic Rules, Road Signs and Rules of Safe driving. It also keeps track of the progress you have made in each category. It contains questions from following categories:
* Traffic Laws
* Road Signs
* Rules of Safe Driving
* CDL endorsements : Hazardous Materials, Schools Bus, Passenger Vehicle, Combination Vehicle, Tankers, Double/Triples
* Pre-trip Inspections
* Air Brakes
MOCK TEST (TEST SIMULATOR)
The application also includes a module that gives you the opportunity to take a test consisting of questions drawn at random from different categories. This section will give you an idea of what to expect from the actual exam that you will be taking.
TEST RESULT
You will get the test result based on the official criteria to pass the Driver’s License Test. You will also be able to find out what questions you've done wrong after taking the test.
TEST HISTORY
The application keeps history of how you have performed in the previous mock tests so that you get an idea of your progress.
CUSTOM TEST CREATER
You can generate speedy, short quizzes with the help of this application by picking questions from a list of unpracticed questions or by selecting questions that you have previously gotten wrong. You also have the option to choose the total number of questions on the practice test.
QUESTION CHALLENGE
This is a unique feature of our application. It allows you learn while playing a challenge game. Your score will go up by one point each time you correctly answer a question up until the point where you get it wrong. It keeps record of your high score. 
WHY Connecticut DMV Permit Practice Test app?
- Over thousands questions designed from the official Connecticut DMV manual.
- Practice questions category wise and keep track of how you are progressing.
- Go through the questions you answered wrong.
- Real time test simulator.
- Bookmark questions that you think you want to refer them later on.
- Question Challenge - Learn by playing game.
*Disclaimer:
We are not associated with any government state agency. This app is not intended to be relied upon in any dispute, claim, action, proceeding or for legal advice. For official law descriptions and administrative centres, please consult the respective state body. It is also highly recommended that new drivers take an approved driver education course to learn the rules and laws of the road, and to develop responsible driving habits. We have developed this app to help you to pass the DMV permit test with ease. The questions are designed based on the latest official Driver's handbook. But we do not claim the accuracy of information and this information can not be used in any legal case.

bluejetty:00115201:ios.description:
Welcome to Stamply!
We know collecting stamps is exciting, yet it can also get very frustrating. You find an old or rare stamp, but you’re not sure of its true value. Your albums are full, but you can’t remember which stamps you already own. You browse a marketplace and wonder if you’re about to overpay. For many collectors, these problems take the fun out of the hobby.
Stamply was built to solve them. With powerful stamp recognition and live market data, Stamply makes it easy to scan, identify, and organize your collection — so you can focus on enjoying the art of philately instead of stressing over the details.
SCAN AND IDENTIFY STAMPS INSTANTLY
Take a photo of any stamp and Stamply will recognize it within seconds. The app identifies key details including country, issue year, edition, and rarity. It works across thousands of stamps worldwide, giving collectors fast, accurate scans without guesswork.
REAL-TIME VALUE CHECKER
Stamp values shift with condition, rarity, and demand. Missing a change can mean overpaying or underselling. Stamply helps you stay ahead with live price data from trusted sources. Instantly see:
Current market prices
Historical value trends
Total estimated collection worth
Whether you’re buying, selling, or simply holding, you’ll always know where your stamps stand.
ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION
Messy albums, boxes, and spreadsheets make it hard to track what you own. Stamply turns your stamps into a clean digital collection. Save scans into albums, group stamps by country or theme, mark duplicates and favorites, and track your entire collection’s value at a glance.
With Stamply, everything stays safe, searchable, and easy to update.
GLOBAL COVERAGE
Stamply supports a growing database of stamps from around the world, including rare issues, modern commemoratives, and historical classics. From casual hobbyists to serious philatelists, Stamply makes identifying and valuing stamps effortless.
WHY COLLECTORS CHOOSE STAMPLY ?
Fast and accurate stamp scans
Real-time value tracking
Digital collection management
Global coverage across thousands of stamps
Simple, reliable, and built for collectors
Download Stamply today and bring clarity to your collection.
With Stamply, every scan brings knowledge, every stamp has its place, and every collector has the confidence to collect, value, and preserve with ease.

bluejetty:00128286:ios.name: Articulation Station Hive
bluejetty:00128286:ios.summary: Articulation Station Hive is the most comprehensive speech therapy app on the App Store, giving Speech-Language Pathologists tools and activities to help learners of all ages speak more clearly. Target consonants and vowels across 17 engagi
bluejetty:00128286:ios.description:
Articulation Station Hive is the most comprehensive speech therapy app on the App Store, giving Speech-Language Pathologists tools and activities to help learners of all ages speak more clearly. Target consonants and vowels across 17 engaging activities—from isolation through conversation.
Whether you’re targeting a single sound, multiple sounds, phonological patterns, complex word shapes, or carryover into conversation, Articulation Station Hive makes it easy to customize practice for each learner.
ARTICULATION STATION HIVE OFFERS:
ISOLATION ACTIVITIES:
- Hand Cues provide a video model with a hand cue for each sound.
- Picture Cues offer fun animated illustrations for each sound.
- Letter Cues pair the letter with the sound in a playful way.
SYLLABLE ACTIVITIES:
- Syllable Sliders let learners slide two sounds together to make a word.
- Syllable Spinners create one-, two-, and three-syllable combinations.
WORD ACTIVITIES:
- Contrast Pairs support minimal pairs, maximal pairs, and multiple oppositions for phonological intervention.
- Flashcards provide repetition.
- Matching Games offer three levels of practice.
PHRASE ACTIVITIES:
- Rotating Phrases combine lead words and target words into two-word combinations.
- Unique Phrases provide three-word descriptive phrases for addressing speech and language goals.
SENTENCE ACTIVITIES:
- Fixed Rotating Sentences provide repeated practice within predictable carrier sentences.
- Mixed Rotating Sentences generate varied sentences by combining pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and target words.
- Unique Sentences provide longer, more complex speech practice.
STORY ACTIVITIES:
- Level 1 Stories are short, rhyming, and sometimes repetitive stories paired with picture prompts.
- Level 2 Stories provide longer stories with richer vocabulary and more opportunities to practice target sounds.
CONVERSATION ACTIVITIES:
- Conversation Scenes encourage spontaneous speech with interactive scenes and the ability to record, save, and score speech samples.
- Conversation Questions offer four question types for conversation and carryover.
WORD LISTS:
- Create and save custom Word Lists tailored to each learner.
- Combine targets from multiple Sound Programs or search for words across the app.
- Explore Speech and Language lists for multisyllabic words, complex consonant clusters, vocabulary, phonological awareness, and more.
- Add custom words and images for personalized practice.
- Use your lists in word, phrase, and sentence activities.
ADDITIONAL TOOLS & RESOURCES:
- Customize Sound Programs with Suggested Words, syllable selection, and word shape filtering.
- Target phonological processes with word-level practice and contrast pairs.
- Work with up to 6 learners at once with Group Sessions. *Pro tier only.
- Personalize sessions with seasonal, holiday, just-for-fun, and colored themes. *Illustrated themes are iPad only.
TRACK PROGRESS:
- Track performance across targeted sounds with session summaries and progress graphs.
- Review correct, approximate, and incorrect responses.
- Add notes, listen to recordings, and repeat previous sessions.
- Share progress and session notes with parents or adult learners.
LITTLE BEE HIVE MEMBERSHIP:
Articulation Station Hive is included with the Little Bee Hive membership. Pro members receive access to both Articulation Station Hive and Articulation Test Center Hive. Already a Little Bee Hive member? Simply download Articulation Station Hive and sign in with your existing account.
SUBSCRIPTION, PRICING & TERMS:
Articulation Station Hive offers a 14-day free trial with unlimited access to both Articulation Station Hive and Articulation Test Center Hive. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at the end of the 14-day trial. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off at any time.

bluejetty:00003515:android.description:
Introducing PRIZE CLAW!
For years, you've been going to arcades and carnivals, trading quarters for the chance to grab toys and candy with a motorized claw. Claw games are filled with tense moments of wondering if the claw will drop your prize, coupled with the triumph of finally receiving it! PRIZE CLAW recreates that experience for your Android while adding many exciting new features! 
Step up to the machine and maneuver the claw to grab coins, gems, stuffed animals, cars, dolls, and so many more! This claw game is much more than the standard grabbing you get from arcade machines, however: PRIZE CLAW is filled with all sorts of unique items, powerful effects and challenging missions. Special gems grant you bonuses to enhance your collection power, and you can trade the prizes you collect for extra special bonuses. Tons of prizes aren't the only thing you can trade in: All the coins you collect can be spent to upgrade your claw, activate your unique powers and even customize your machine! If you run out of grabs, don't fret! It won't take long before you receive more. Keep checking back to complete your collection and unlock more stuff!
Features:
- More than 60 prizes to collect!
- Multiple machines to play on with different prizes, powers and looks!
- A special puzzle to complete for each machine!
- New 3D graphics with customizable machines, claws and joysticks!
- Simple to play but with tons of missions to challenge your skills!
- Earn more bonuses for playing every day!
- Huge variety of bonuses and effects!
Check back for future updates!
NOW AVAILABLE: PRIZE CLAW 2 - Check it out!
Prize Claw is a free game that is supported by the ads we and others display. To do this, we work with a variety of online advertising partners who collect data from users of our games and other games to show you ads that are relevant to your interests. Do not install or launch our games unless you consent to this use and sharing of data, as further explained in our Privacy Policy (http://gamecircus.com/privacy-policy/).

bluejetty:00149961:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00149961:ios.description:
KAZU Public Radio App: 
The KAZU Public Radio App allows you to listen to KAZU, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to KAZU with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from KAZU even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for the KAZU stream! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to KAZU in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access KAZU programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The KAZU Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The KAZU Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at KAZU and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support KAZU by becoming a member today!
http://www.kazu.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00024931:ios.description:
Spark your imagination with Random Word Generator (RWG) — the fast, versatile word randomizer that puts an endless supply of words at your fingertips. Whether you're expanding your vocabulary, fueling a word game, beating writer's block or just exploring the beauty of language, RWG delivers exactly the words you need, instantly.
Choose nouns, adjectives or verbs, set the word length, and decide how many words to generate. With support for many languages and a built-in look at common words and their meanings, it's as educational as it is fun.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE RANDOM WORD GENERATOR
• Parts of speech — generate nouns, adjectives or verbs on demand.
• Word length control — set the minimum and maximum number of letters.
• Custom quantity — get a single word or a long list at once.
• Many languages — generate words across a wide range of languages.
• Vocabulary builder — study common words and learn their meanings.
• Generation history — revisit the words you've already created.
• Favorites — save interesting or useful words for later.
• One-tap copy — copy any word to use anywhere.
• Light & dark themes — available in 70+ languages.
A TOOL FOR LANGUAGE LOVERS
Words are the building blocks of everything we say, write and imagine. RWG turns discovery into a habit: meet unfamiliar words, learn what they mean, and watch your vocabulary grow a little richer every day. Perfect for students, teachers and lifelong learners.
LEVEL UP YOUR WORD GAMES
Stuck in Scrabble? Designing a crossword? Hosting Pictionary or charades? A quick tap gives you fresh words to practice with, challenge friends or build your next puzzle. It's the secret weapon for game night and brain training alike.
UNBLOCK YOUR CREATIVITY
Writers, poets and brainstormers know the magic of a random prompt. One surprising word can break a creative logjam, kick off a story, or send your ideas in a thrilling new direction. Let RWG be the spark.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a part of speech and word length.
2. Pick how many words you want.
3. Generate, then copy or favorite the ones you love.
PERFECT FOR
• Language learners building vocabulary.
• Students, teachers and writers.
• Scrabble, crosswords, Pictionary and word games.
• Brainstorming, creativity and beating writer's block.
Open up a whole world of words. With Random Word Generator, inspiration, learning and play are always just one tap away — a limitless dictionary of possibility in your pocket.
WORDS IN MANY LANGUAGES
Learning a new language? Switch the word list and immerse yourself in fresh vocabulary from around the world. Seeing real words — and discovering their meanings — is one of the most natural ways to build fluency, whether you're a beginner or polishing an advanced skill.
ENDLESS WAYS TO PLAY AND LEARN
• Build vocabulary lists for study or revision.
• Generate prompts for creative writing and journaling.
• Practice spelling, definitions and parts of speech.
• Power up Scrabble, crosswords, Pictionary and charades.
• Challenge friends to think on their feet.
NEVER RUN OUT OF IDEAS
From a single perfect word to a long, varied list, RWG keeps the inspiration flowing. Save your favorites, look back through your history, and copy any word in an instant to drop it into your notes, your story or your game.
Random word generator (RWG): generate random nouns, adjectives and verbs by length and quantity, explore many languages, learn word meanings, and find inspiration for games, writing and vocabulary.
Download Random Word Generator today and let your vocabulary flourish.

Train, eat, recover — built your way. Gainsbybrains is a complete health & fitness app: expert-built home and gym training programs, 400+ healthy recipes, and guided breathing sessions, all in one place.

Real food, simply made. Explore 400+ recipes, frequently updated, and set targets with the macros calculator to support your goals. Non-restrictive, and built around real life.
THE PART MOST PLANS FORGET
Guided breathing sessions for whenever you need them: before a lift, after a long day, or on the way to sleep.

bluejetty:00028473:ios.description:
Learn Division – Step-by-Step Math Learning for Kids
Transform your child’s math learning experience with our interactive division app! Designed especially for young learners, it makes mastering division fun, engaging, and easy to understand.
Key Features:
Step-by-Step Visual Learning
• Watch numbers come to life through animated long division
• Follow every step of the division process clearly
• Perfect for visual learners who need to see the math happening
Training & Challenge Modes
• Test Yourself: Challenge yourself with problems, get step-by-step solutions, and learn from your mistakes.
• Manual Mode: Enter your own numbers to practice the problems you want.
• Random Mode: Get surprise division challenges to keep practice fun and engaging.
Smart Learning Features
• Supports numbers up to 999,999 to build strong math skills
• Supports long division with remainders and long division with decimal results
• Clear error guidance to help correct mistakes
• Instant feedback to reinforce learning
• Beautiful animations that make math exciting and enjoyable
Customizable Experience
• Adjustable animation speeds (slow, normal, fast, instant)
• Multiple background themes for a personalized learning experience
• Support for multiple number systems
• Sound effects that can be turned on or off
Child-Friendly Design
• Clean, colorful interface designed for young users
• Large, easy-to-tap buttons
• Intuitive navigation children can master quickly
• A distraction-free learning environment
Perfect For:
• Elementary students learning division
• Parents teaching math at home
• Teachers looking for engaging classroom tools
• Kids who learn best through visual and interactive methods
Whether your child is starting their math journey or needs more practice with division, our app provides the perfect learning companion. Download it now and watch your child’s confidence in math grow!
From developers who care about high-quality education and making learning accessible to everyone.

bluejetty:00158246:ios.description:
Hear every word with the free Lexie app. Once you’ve chosen your Lexie hearing aids, download this app to get them set up and customized to your hearing needs. The app guides you step-by-step from the moment you open it, and no advanced tech skills are required. 
All your primary controls are easily accessible on one screen
• Change your volume and switch your Environments.
• Adjust your Equalizer settings for Treble, Mid, and Bass.
• Access 24/7 self-help resources like blogs and FAQs.
• Watch easy-to-follow how-to videos and interactive tutorials.
Free award-winning customer support
• Connect with Lexie Experts® for the lifetime of your hearing aids.
• Hop on a live video call to get live, face-to-face help with setup and settings.
• Reach Lexie Experts via live chat, phone, or video.
Customization for Lexie B3 and Lexie B2 Plus
• Take the in-app hearing test* to create your unique hearing profile.
• For Lexie B3 users, your test results auto-program your Environments for maximum speech clarity.
Exclusive Lexie B3 features
• Fuller, richer Universal Bluetooth® streaming for every conversation or playlist. Stream calls, music, videos, and meetings reliably on both iOS® and Android™.
• Own the conversation as Automatic Sound Focus reduces surrounding noise and adjusts dual microphones toward the direction of speech.
Compatibility and notes 
The Lexie app is compatible with the Lexie B3, B2 Plus, B2, B1, Lumen, and H1 Hearing Buds. Users must be 18 years or older. OTC hearing aids are intended for people with perceived mild-to-moderate impairment. 
*The hearing test isn't a substitute for a professional hearing test from a qualified healthcare provider.

bluejetty:00026130:ios.description:
Introducing the ultimate Car Simulator experience with a futuristic twist! Our brand new Car Simulator game combines the thrill of car driving simulator gameplay with the excitement of flying cars and transformative robots. Get ready to immerse yourself in a world where vehicles transform, and adrenaline-pumping action awaits at every turn!
In this Car Simulator, you'll experience the most innovative car games 2023 has to offer. With three distinct game modes, there's never a dull moment in our car driving simulator. Soar through the skies or race on the ground in our breathtaking flying car simulator, guaranteed to keep you entertained for hours!
The Classic Mode of our Car Simulator offers an engaging story where you'll chase and destroy opponent cars, robots, drones, moving cars, and even flying cars. Unleash your inner racer and conquer each level with your exceptional driving skills in this state-of-the-art car driving simulator.
Car games 2023 have never been this exciting! Our Multiplayer Mode lets you challenge your friends and players from around the world in thrilling car races. Compete in various tracks and environments while showcasing your prowess in our exceptional Car Simulator.
Looking for a car game offline? Our Robot Transformation Mode offers an offline experience that allows you to transform your car into a powerful robot and battle against menacing adversaries. Car games 2023 have never seen such a unique blend of action, strategy, and exhilarating gameplay.
Experience the flying car simulator like never before, with stunning graphics, realistic physics, and intuitive controls. Customize your vehicle and unleash its full potential in our Car Simulator game. Whether you're a seasoned racer or a newcomer to car games, you'll find endless enjoyment in our car driving simulator.
Main Features:
Car Simulator with flying and transformative abilities
Three game modes: Classic Mode, Multiplayer Mode, and Robot Transformation
Engaging storyline with various challenges in the car game offline mode
Car games 2023 with high-quality graphics and immersive sound effects
Wide range of customizable cars in our flying car simulator
Car driving simulator with intuitive controls and realistic physics
Don't miss out on the next generation of car games 2023! Download our Car Simulator now and experience the fusion of ground-breaking car game offline features and the futuristic thrill of a flying car simulator. Prepare to be captivated by the most exhilarating car driving simulator of the year!

bluejetty:00065195:ios.description:
How much will my paycheck be after taxes? Find out in seconds with Pay44. No ads, no account needed.
Enter your hourly pay or salary, set your W-4 filing status, and see your take-home pay instantly. Add overtime, tips, commissions, bonuses, and deductions for an accurate gross-to-net breakdown. Built with 2026 IRS federal tax brackets, all 50 state taxes plus DC and Puerto Rico, Social Security, and Medicare rules. Then plan a budget from your real numbers.
Answers to your pay questions
• How much is my paycheck after taxes?
• What is my take-home pay hourly or salary?
• How much federal and state tax do I owe?
• What will my net pay be biweekly or monthly?
• How do 401(k) and other deductions affect my check?
• Which job offer actually pays more?
Paycheck calculator
• Hourly and salary income modes
• Every pay period: daily, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, quarterly, semiannually, yearly
• W-4 inputs: filing status, dependents, additional withholding
• Federal and state income tax for all 50 states + DC + Puerto Rico
• Social Security tax, Medicare tax, and additional Medicare tax
• Overtime with custom multipliers, tips, commissions, and bonuses
• Pre-tax deductions: 401(k), HSA, FSA, health insurance, commuter benefits
• Post-tax deductions: Roth 401(k), union dues, garnishments
Budget planner
• Combine multiple paychecks with custom income and expense items
• See where every dollar goes with a visual waterfall chart
• Donut chart and top-expense breakdowns
• Track your total: income minus expenses at a glance
Save, compare & simulate
• Save multiple calculations for different jobs, offers, or scenarios
• Compare side by side to see which pays more after taxes
• Simulate raises, new hours, or job changes and preview the impact on net pay
• Export as PDF, image, CSV, or text
Insights & projections
• See your effective tax rates at a glance
• Break down taxes by type: federal, state, FICA, Medicare
• Project your yearly income, taxes, and take-home pay
• Visual grid showing how much of every dollar you keep
More to explore
• Paycle: Daily tax-guessing game. Guess the annual federal tax from a salary
• Payday reminders so you never miss a check
• Dark mode and theme customization
Ad-free & private
• No ads
• All calculations stay on your device
• No account required. Works completely offline
• Available in 10 languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Arabic, Korean, and Vietnamese
See your real paycheck. Accurate, private, and free.
Disclaimer
This app provides estimates for educational and informational purposes only and is not financial or tax advice. Actual withholding and take-home pay can vary by employer, benefits, and state rules. Always verify results against official IRS/state guidance and your pay stub.

bluejetty:00133971:ios.summary:
بيورلي هو تطبيق يقدم لك تجربة غسيل سيارات سهلة، سريعة، واحترافية في أي وقت يناسبك، من غير ما تضيع وقتك في الزحمة أو تنتظر دورك في المغسلة.
مميزات تطبيق بيورلي:
• غسيل بالبخار أو بالماء حسب اختيارك
• باقات متنوعة تشمل الغسيل الداخلي والخارج
bluejetty:00133971:ios.description:
بيورلي هو تطبيق يقدم لك تجربة غسيل سيارات سهلة، سريعة، واحترافية في أي وقت يناسبك، من غير ما تضيع وقتك في الزحمة أو تنتظر دورك في المغسلة.
مميزات تطبيق بيورلي:
• غسيل بالبخار أو بالماء حسب اختيارك
• باقات متنوعة تشمل الغسيل الداخلي والخارجي والتلميع العميق
• تحديد موقعك بكل سهولة – نجيك وين ما كنت
• حجز فوري أو مجدول في الوقت اللي يناسبك
• خصومات حصرية للمستخدمين الجدد والمواعيد الصباحية
• كاش باك على كل عملية غسيل
• متجر منتجات سيارات (عطور، مناديل، أدوات حماية… والمزيد)
• خاصية الإهداء – اهدي أحبابك غسلة محترمة توصل لبابهم
 الباقات المتوفرة:
 بيورلي بلس – دباب: غسيل خارجي + تنظيف داخلي أساسي
 بيورلي بلس – بخار: غسيل بالبخار بلمسة احترافية
 بيورلي سبشيل: تلميع داخلي وإزالة بقع المراتب
 بيورلي إكسترا VIP: عناية فاخرة لسيارتك من الداخل والخارج
العروض المستمرة:
• خصم 20% على أول غسلة عند تحميل التطبيق
• خصم 15% على الغسيل الصباحي (من 10 صباحًا إلى 1 ظهرًا)
• اشتراك شهري خاص لباقة الدباب مع أسعار مخفّضة ومزايا إضافية
سهولة الحجز في 3 خطوات:
• افتح التطبيق وحدد موقعك
• اختَر حجم سيارتك والباقة المناسبة
• احجز الوقت، وفريق بيورلي يوصلك في الموعد
 راحة بالك تهمنا:
جميع موظفينا مدربين ومحترفين، نستخدم منتجات آمنة وصديقة للبيئة، ونتعامل باحترافية عالية تحافظ على سيارتك نظيفة ولامعة.

*Instacart is an independent business that provides online ordering, shopping and delivery services to Publix’s customers.

bluejetty:00091627:ios.summary: LC Transit is your go-to app for getting around Lorain County. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be an on-demand ViaLC ride, a bus trip or a comb
bluejetty:00091627:ios.description:
LC Transit is your go-to app for getting around Lorain County. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be an on-demand ViaLC ride, a bus trip or a combination of the two.
How it works:
- Easily plan travel on Lorain County Transit services 
-Enter your pickup and dropoff locations and we’ll tell you the best journey available at that time. 
-Book rides directly in the app for you and any additional passengers
-Never miss your ride with live arrival times for your bus and ride tracking for your on-demand trips
-If you’re riding on demand, there may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! 
What we’re about:
- SHARED: Our algorithm helps you see the best public transit journey available at that time. You’ll be matched with others headed in the same direction. This combines convenience and comfort with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a shared ride. Transit at its best.
- ACCESSIBLE: The app allows you to travel with a support person or be matched with a vehicle that meets your mobility needs. 
- SUSTAINABLE: Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Kalamazoo county a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

CO-OP TAXI is a leading provider of Taxi services in Edmonton,Alberta Canada. We are pleased to Offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free CO-OP Taxi Hail application.
Key Features of the CO-OP
bluejetty:00092117:ios.description:
CO-OP TAXI is a leading provider of Taxi services in Edmonton,Alberta Canada. We are pleased to Offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free CO-OP Taxi Hail application.
Key Features of the CO-OP Taxi application include:
• Book a reservation in as few as 3 clicks
• Get a fare estimate by entering both pick-up and destination addresses
• Receive a confirmation number for your reservation immediately on booking
• Receive notifications including vehicle number once your reservation has been dispatched
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Specify the number of passengers, vehicle type and preferred payment method
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call CO-OP TAXI with the push of a button
To begin using the CO-OP Taxi application today:
• Download the free app
• Create an account (Email, Name, Phone # and Password)
• Validate your account (via the confirmation email you receive)
• Login to the app (Email & Password)
• Enter your pick-up address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip (reservations can be immediate or for a future time/date)
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pick-up location.
The CO-OP Taxi application retains a history of your previous reservations (up to 30 
days) for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
You can also customize your orders by selecting the number of passengers, preferred vehicle type, and preferred method of payment. These preferences can be saved to your account profile for future bookings.
At CO-OP, your comfort and safety are our top priorities! Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the CO-OP Taxi application or by calling 780-425-2525.
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the CO-OP Taxi application in 
the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00063541:ios.description:
Watch your IPTV playlists on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, wherever you are. All you need is an internet connection.
IPTV Easy is the simple, fast player for opening your M3U, M3U8 and Xtream Codes playlists and watching your channels without the hassle. Add a playlist, tap a channel, and watch.
WHY CHOOSE IPTV EASY
• Simple: load your playlist and start right away, no complicated setup.
• Fast: smooth playback, no interruptions.
• Supported formats: M3U, M3U8 and Xtream Codes, including username and password.
• TV Guide (EPG): check the schedule for your channels.
• Multiple playlists: add as many playlists as you like, with no limits.
• Favorites: keep the channels you watch most within easy reach.
• More ways to import: paste a URL or import the file from your computer via Finder/iTunes (tutorial in the app).
HOW IT WORKS
IPTV Easy is only a video player: it displays and plays exclusively the content you add. The app does not provide or include any channel or playlist.

• Prices and features are as shown in the app. Payment is charged to your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation.
• You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited when you subscribe.

bluejetty:00071174:ios.description:
Step into the shoes of a unique superhero in Stick Rope Hero, a simulator game that transforms the dynamic 3D city into your playground. As a stick man with the powers of a super rope hero, you can explore the Stick City, overcome quests, and influence the world around you. 
In Stick Rope Hero, your actions and decisions have an impact on the city and its stick citizens, crafting your own story in a world that evolves while you progress. This super rope hero simulator combines the fun of action with the depth of a simulation, offering an unparalleled open-world experience.
Save the 3D Stick City: Explore the town and find challenges scattered throughout the open world where every corner presents unique opportunities and quests. Use your super rope to swing between buildings like a spider, dodge attacks, and strike back. 
Engage in Stick Fighting: Encounter various enemies in battles ranging from gangster showdowns to combat with the city's corrupted police. Go on a mission to free the city from thugs and save your allies. Join the street racers or fight hordes of zombies in the arena, and if you’re ready - defeat the furious robot boss for ultimate rewards! Use your rope as a weapon and a way to overcome foes in battles that require tactical skills and quick reflexes.
Upgrade Mechanics: Dive deeper into the Stick Hero simulator with a detailed system for character progression and skill enhancement. Upgrade your hero’s abilities to improve your power in combat, enhance survival skills, and make traveling across the city environment even more fun!
Assemble Your Arsenal: Don’t forget to check out the shop. Purchase everything you like: from simple weapons like swords and guns to futuristic blasters, cars, helicopters or even a battle mech! Customize your hero with various accessories and costumes to gain even more stats and make your stick man unique.
Dynamic Environment and Responsive Gameplay: The game's advanced simulator engine ensures that the city feels alive and responsive. Buildings, traffic, and stick people react to your actions, creating a living world that responds to your heroic or evil deeds.
Are you ready to gather the power of your rope and your super abilities to shape the world around you? Stick Rope Hero offers a superhero simulator adventure where your choices define the legacy you leave behind. Download now and prove yourself as the mightiest Stick Hero the city has ever seen!

This super rope hero simulator combines the fun of action with the depth of a simulation, offering an unparalleled open-world experience.

Save the 3D Stick City: Explore the town and find challenges scattered throughout the open world where every corner presents unique opportunities and quests. Use your super rope to swing between buildings like a spider, dodge attacks, and strike back. 

Engage in Stick Fighting: Encounter various enemies in battles ranging from gangster showdowns to combat with the city's corrupted police. Go on a mission to free the city from thugs and save your allies. Join the street racers or fight hordes of zombies in the arena, and if you’re ready - defeat the furious robot boss for ultimate rewards! Use your rope as a weapon and a way to overcome foes in battles that require tactical skills and quick reflexes.

Upgrade Mechanics: Dive deeper into the Stick Hero simulator with a detailed system for character progression and skill enhancement. Upgrade your hero’s abilities to improve your power in combat, enhance survival skills, and make traveling across the city environment even more fun!

Assemble Your Arsenal: Don’t forget to check out the shop. Purchase everything you like: from simple weapons like swords and guns to futuristic blasters, cars, helicopters or even a battle mech! Customize your hero with various accessories and costumes to gain even more stats and make your stick man unique.

Dynamic Environment and Responsive Gameplay: The game's advanced simulator engine ensures that the city feels alive and responsive. Buildings, traffic, and stick people react to your actions, creating a living world that responds to your heroic or evil deeds.

Are you ready to gather the power of your rope and your super abilities to shape the world around you? Stick Rope Hero offers a superhero simulator adventure where your choices define the legacy you leave behind. Download now and prove yourself as the mightiest Stick Hero the city has ever seen!

bluejetty:00063458:ios.name: Graffiti Fonts - Graffwriter
bluejetty:00063458:ios.summary: Graffwriter™ is an easy & powerful graphic design app featuring the official Graffiti Fonts® collection, the world's first & biggest collection of authentic graffiti style typefaces, designed by graffiti writers with decades of experience.
bluejetty:00063458:ios.description:
Graffwriter™ is an easy & powerful graphic design app featuring the official Graffiti Fonts® collection, the world's first & biggest collection of authentic graffiti style typefaces, designed by graffiti writers with decades of experience. With this free app you can easily design anything with an unlimited number of words, phrases, illustrations, stencils, stock images, textures, cityscapes, paint splatters & drips, QR barcodes, style templates, and your own photos to create fully custom, high resolution art & graphics in seconds. 
With simple controls for unlimited layers of text & images, color, gradients, filters & effects, blend modes, textures, layer locking, transformations, layout & pre-made artwork templates you can create an endless number of original designs. Export, save or share your artwork, all for free.
There are no ads & we do not collect any data from users. Personal/non-commercial use of this free app is unrestricted, commercial licensing is available & any purchased content can be easily restored if your device is lost or damaged or if the app is deleted with no account set up or subscription required. The app does not gather any data from you.
Graffwriter starts you off with tons of free content & features.
Free Content
• 10 free Graffiti Fonts®
• 12 Free Background Images
• 12 Free Cityscapes
• 12 Free Stencils
• 12 Free Illustrations
• 12 Free Paint Splatters
• 16 Free Texture Images
• 12 Free Artwork templates - just enter your text
• Over 240 high quality, iOS system fonts
• 200 Free credits to purchase more fonts & art
• New, free fonts & images immediately downloadable through the app
Free Features 
• Add unlimited words or phrases to each design 
• Choose a Graffiti Font® or system font for each piece of text
• Use any of the over 240 system fonts on your device.
• Customize colors & effects for text and artwork
• Convert any text into a QR bar code
• Color, move, scale, rotate & apply effects to QR bar codes.
• Move, scale, and rotate any object
• Unlimited, moveable, lockable layers
• 25 Sophisticated layer blend modes
• Unlimited text, images, QR codes & art objects in each design
• Import any photo or image from your device
• Use image filters & effects to enhance text & images
• Infinite undo, reverse any number of steps in your design.
• Easily duplicate or remove any layer.
• Adjust the opacity of any text object or image & use transparency in gradients.
Free to Save, Export & Share
• Save an unlimited number of files
• Export your designs into high resolution JPG or PNG format
• All exported artwork is free for non-commercial use
• Transfer editable Graffwriter files to/from your desktop
• Transfer & share editable files between your IOS devices
• Export artwork & re-import for further processing
• Export the full screen design or crop to the size of your design
In addition to all the free content & features this app accesses the exclusive Graffiti Fonts® collection: an ever expanding, regularly updated collection of premium fonts & art available via free download & in-app purchase. Every piece of content & feature can be individually, permanently unlocked or our subscription options can unlock all content & features.
Upgrades Available via in-app purchase:
• High-res/PNG export for professional quality, print-ready designs
• Premium Graffiti Fonts® available for in-app use starting at $0.99
• Hundreds of background images, Textures, Stencils, Cityscapes, Illustrations, Paint Splatters and more.
• Purchase, download, & transfer commercial quality OpenType fonts to your desktop computer.
• Purchase any desktop font & get the in-app versions installed into Graffwriter for free.
• Purchase additional image filters & effects to enhance your photos & artwork for only $0.99 each.
• Subscribe to unlock all current & future content & features 
Privacy Policy: https://ios.graffwriter.com/docs/privacy.htm
Terms of Use / EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00043614:ios.name: Lightme - Lightmeter
bluejetty:00043614:ios.summary:
Lightme - Lightmeter is a clean, simple to use yet very powerful lightmeter.
It is optimised for an easy one-handed use, both for left-handed and right-handed users, with the main controls within your thumb's reach, without the fatiguing j
bluejetty:00043614:ios.description:
Lightme - Lightmeter is a clean, simple to use yet very powerful lightmeter.
It is optimised for an easy one-handed use, both for left-handed and right-handed users, with the main controls within your thumb's reach, without the fatiguing juggling of your precious smartphone.
A core distinguishing feature of Lightme - Lightmeter is that - differently from most of the other apps - it can show multiple combinations of valid settings for aperture and shutterspeed at the same time by working like a - stretched out - old needle and wheel lightmeter. This allows the user to quickly pick the desired settings without having to scroll on a tiny wheel picker. 
The app is designed to be welcoming to people who are just starting out, with a simple one-button use. But it offers many useful and advanced features for the more experienced shooters/users:
Continuous metering (by pressing and holding or double tapping the measure button)
Spot metering with a variable zoom (for more precision) which also supports average metering, and a very intuitive implementation of the zone system
Automatic reciprocity failure compensation (for 25+ films, if you see exposure times in red, they are being compensated)
A dedicated pinhole mode with precise exposure times for user defined apertures (multiple apertures at a time), with the possibility of setting a timer (through a shortcut)
Incident light metering with calibration when using the front facing camera
And more ...
It also includes some other features that are enjoyable by any kind of user:
Black and white preview
The ability to use any of the cameras on your smartphone (swipe left/right on the preview)
Multiple presets for your different camera/film/lens setups
Framelines for previewing your shot, before setting up your tripod etc.
A searchable list of useful tips to make better use of the application's potential
A searchable list of more than 70 films to choose from with the possibility of selecting a few favourites
Dark mode support and a useful level of customisation
You can find even more info in the tips inside the app or you can have a look at full user manual by tapping on manual (in the settings)
The app is free in all its many functionalities, but it offers In-App-Purchases in order to support the project.
The only minor perk you can enable only via certain IAPs is the replacement of the Ad button with a label containing the name of your current preset, check under settings -> coffee for more info.
Don't panic though, even if there's an Ad button it doesn't mean I'm going to show you ads. In fact unless you decide to tap on that button I'm never going to show you any. But if you have a few minutes to spare, watching a few of them sure helps keeping this project alive :) 
Try it, and, if you like it, share it with your friends and consider writing a (mini) review ;)
Have a nice day, and good light!

An effective and easy way to remotely track vehicles and assets. Manage your company fleet using simple, yet powerful solutions!
Real-time tracking and route history - easily check your drivers’ route choice, monitor their speed and ensure safe and precise driving that follows the schedule.

bluejetty:00040724:ios.summary:
YOUR STYLE. YOUR RUNWAY.
Step into a world of fashion and become the stylist everyone is talking about! Create incredible looks, dress up stunning 3D models, capture the perfect photoshoot and compete with fashion lovers around the world.
bluejetty:00040724:ios.description:
YOUR STYLE. YOUR RUNWAY.
Step into a world of fashion and become the stylist everyone is talking about! Create incredible looks, dress up stunning 3D models, capture the perfect photoshoot and compete with fashion lovers around the world.
With thousands of clothing items, endless ways to express your style and new fashion adventures every week, there’s always a new look waiting to be created.
CREATE YOUR DREAM LOOK
Dress up and style your models with thousands of dresses, tops, skirts, pants, shoes, bags, jewelry and accessories. Complete every makeover with gorgeous hairstyles, makeup and nails to create a look that’s uniquely yours.
Discover exclusive fashion collections, shop for new pieces and build the ultimate virtual wardrobe as you grow your career as a fashion stylist.
MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Why just follow fashion when you can create it?
Unlock custom clothing and accessories and design pieces that express your signature style. Experiment with different looks, create unique outfits and show the fashion community what makes your style stand out.
CREATE STUNNING 3D PHOTOSHOOTS
You’re not just the stylist — you’re the photographer too.
Bring every outfit to life with beautiful full 3D photoshoots. Choose from a diverse cast of models from around the world, then combine fashion, hair, makeup, poses and locations to capture your perfect shot.
Build your model collection, upgrade your favorites and share clothing and accessories between them for even more styling possibilities.
COMPETE. GET VOTED. GET NOTICED.
Think you’ve created a Top Look? Put your styling skills to the test in fashion competitions and see what other players think!
Enter your best photoshoots, vote on looks created by other stylists and compete for rewards and recognition. Level up your fashion career, unlock new collections and battle for your place on the global leaderboards.
Can you create the look everyone wants to vote for?
TRAVEL THE WORLD IN STYLE
Your next fashion adventure is always just around the corner.
Join a new World Tour every week and travel to exciting destinations filled with themed styling challenges, inspiring locations and limited-edition fashion.
From glamorous nights out and dream vacations to iconic eras and unforgettable celebrations, every World Tour brings a new opportunity to experiment with your style, expand your wardrobe and create something incredible.
Where will fashion take you next?
FIND YOUR FASHION COMMUNITY
Fashion is better together.
Join a social group and meet other fashion lovers, share your photoshoots, exchange styling ideas and help each other create amazing looks.
Chat with friends, vote on photos and work together to take your group to the top of the style leaderboards.
BRING YOUR FASHION TO LIFE WITH AR
Take your looks beyond the game with augmented reality.
Use your phone camera to bring your styled 3D models into the real world. Become a fashion photographer, find the perfect backdrop and turn anywhere into your own fashion show.
YOUR NEXT LOOK STARTS HERE
Dress up. Design. Customize. Compete. Explore.
Build your dream wardrobe, discover your signature style and show the world what you can create.
Download Fashion AR and start your fashion journey today!

bluejetty:00161502:ios.description:
Get all your tennis in one GO – with ScoreGO! 
ScoreGO is where tennis fans come together. More than just live scores, ScoreGO is your community to follow matches, share opinions, join conversations, and connect with fans who love the game as much as you do.
Whether you're following ATP, WTA, Challenger, or ITF, ScoreGO gives you a place to stay updated and be part of the discussion. Join fan groups, chat about matches, debate predictions, celebrate wins, and experience tennis together — not alone.
From Grand Slam drama to Challenger surprises, there’s always a community waiting for you.
Why you’ll love ScoreGO:
Your Tennis Community:
Join groups and fan spaces built around your favorite players, tournaments, and tennis topics. Discuss live matches, share hot takes, react to breaking news, and connect with fans worldwide who share your passion for the sport.
Personalized For You:
Build your own tennis world. Follow your favorite players and tournaments, customize your home feed, and receive notifications for the moments that matter most. Whether you're a hardcore fan or just getting into tennis, ScoreGO adapts to your game.
Live Scores + Real Conversations:
Get real-time scores, match stats, tournament updates, and breaking tennis news — all while talking about it with the community. No switching apps. Everything happens in one place.
Fun Beyond the Match:
Compete in Prediction Games, climb the Scoreboard Race, test your knowledge with tennis quizzes, and earn Awards for your activity. Create your fan profile, follow other fans, and see how your tennis knowledge stacks up.
Main Features:
Groups & Fan Discussions:
Join community groups where tennis fans post, comment, and discuss everything from match drama and rankings to player form and tournament predictions. Whether you want analysis, memes, opinions, or matchday reactions — there’s a group for every fan.
Live Scores & News:
Follow ATP, WTA, ITF, and Challenger tours with live scores, tournament calendars, match details, player stats, H2H comparisons, past champions, venue details, and more.
Community Features:
Play non-monetary prediction games for ATP and WTA events, earn points for correct picks, and compete with fans globally. Join trivia quizzes, unlock awards, create your fan profile, and grow your presence in the ScoreGO community.
Personalized Features:
Follow your favorite players and tournaments, customize your feed, widgets, and push notifications, and stay connected to the tennis world your way.
Download now.
Game, set, ScoreGO!

Introducing WalesOnline: Your go-to app for all things Wales
Welcome to WalesOnline, tailored to your phone or tablet. WalesOnline provides breaking news, award-winning original reporting, entertainment and more. Stay informed on all parts of Welsh life from political analysis to the latest news from our rugby and football teams. With our user-friendly interface and comprehensive coverage, you'll have your finger on the pulse of Wales like never before.
What’s included?
Stay Informed:
Get the latest breaking news, compelling journalism and exclusive reporting at your fingertips. From the Senedd to traffic and travel updates, we've got you covered.
Breaking News Alerts:
Be the first to know about important news, updates and events with our real-time push notifications. From breaking news stories to traffic updates, we'll keep you informed and connected.
Personalised Content:
Customise your newsfeed based on your preferences and interests. Stay up-to-date with the topics you care about effortlessly.
Live Sports Coverage:
Never miss a moment of the action with our extensive coverage of our rugby and football teams. Get the latest team news, interviews, expert analysis and more. 
What's On: 
Plan your weekends with ease and stay up to date with Welsh culture, from the biggest gig announcements to the latest restaurant reviews.
Interactive Features:
Share articles with friends, leave comments, and participate in polls to voice your opinions. Join the conversation and become a part of the Wales Online community.
Save For Later:
Save articles to read later, even when you're offline, so you can enjoy your news on the go, anytime. 
The Edit
A weekly curation of our best long reads selected by our editors. 
The Digest
A specially curated round-up of the most important stories to catch you up on anything you might have missed.

Discover the most reliable and comprehensive parcel delivery tracking app designed to simplify your shipping experience. Whether you're an individual tracking personal parcels or a business managing numerous shipments, this app caters to all your needs. Track packages from local and international carriers, including major names like UPS, USPS, Amazon, DHL Express, FedEx, Vietnam Post and others—all in one convenient platform.
Why Choose Our Parcel Delivery Tracking App?
1. UNIVERSAL CARRIER SUPPORT
With support for over 700 carriers worldwide, our app is the go-to solution for managing your deliveries. From DHL and UPS to Vietnam Post and local postal services, this app consolidates your shipping needs in one place.

Bill Pay - Schedule or manually make payments on your bills through our easy-to-use bill pay system.
Fund Transfers - Send funds to and from your connected UECU accounts and external bank accounts through our easy-to-use fund transfer capability.
