bluejetty:00095223:ios.description:
Welcome to Thulla Masters, the online multiplayer Bhabhi card game (also known as Thulla, Get Away, Getaway or Donkey), built for fans of classic Indian and South Asian Taash. Play your cards, dodge the dreaded Thulla, get away first, and leave the last player holding the deck as the Bhabhi. Fast, social and full of strategy.
Whether you grew up playing Bhabhi with friends and family or you're learning the rules for the first time, Thulla Masters makes it free and easy to play anytime, anywhere.
Love desi card games like Teen Patti, Rummy, Callbreak or Seep? You'll feel right at home. Bhabhi Thulla brings the same taash thrill with a fun, fast, everyone-can-play twist.
PLAY ONLINE WITH REAL PLAYERS
Jump into a quick match against real Bhabhi players from around the world. Sit at tables of 3, 4 or 5 players, dodge the Thulla and race to get away first.
CLASSIC BHABHI / THULLA RULES, DONE RIGHT
Authentic Get Away gameplay: follow the suit, dump your highest cards, drop a Thulla on your opponents and be the first to empty your hand. Beautiful tables, smooth animations and fair play make every round a true test of skill.
PLAY FOR COINS, CLIMB THE RANKS
Pick your table, play for coins and win big. Higher tables mean bigger rewards. Top the weekly leaderboards and prove you're the best Bhabhi player around.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS & FAMILY
Create a private room or send a challenge to your friends and play your own way. Invite your group and start a match in seconds — perfect for family game night.
CUSTOMISE YOUR GAME
Unlock avatars, card packs, background themes, emotes and fun Thulla animations. Make every match feel personal.
LEADERBOARDS, REWARDS & MORE
Top the weekly leaderboards, win prizes, level up to unlock new features and show off your title. Come back every day for free rewards.
CHAT & EMOJIS
Connect with players in-game, send animated emojis, and enjoy the banter with your buddies.
WHY PLAYERS LOVE THULLA MASTERS
- Online multiplayer Bhabhi Thulla for 3 to 5 players
- Authentic, classic Get Away / Donkey card game rules
- Play with friends and family, or against smart real opponents
- Weekly leaderboards, rewards and daily free bonuses
- Beautiful design, smooth gameplay, easy to learn and hard to master, free to play
Download Thulla Masters now, deal the cards and become the ultimate Thulla Master!
PLEASE NOTE: Thulla Masters is free to download and play. Some optional in-game items can be purchased with real money, and a network connection is required.
Love Thulla Masters? Rate us and tell your friends, and stay tuned for new features and game modes!

bluejetty:00152887:ios.description:
Frenzy Match 3D: Relaxing Triple Match Puzzle Game
Discover one of the most relaxing and addictive puzzle games!
Frenzy Match 3D is an addictive free matching game inspired by popular hits like Match Factory and Triple Match 3D — where you match, sort, and clear 3D tiles in fun, visually stunning puzzles. You can play online or offline, bringing endless joy and brain-training excitement. 
If you enjoy free matching games, triple match puzzles, match 3D, tile connect, sort tiles or sorting games for adults, Frenzy Match 3D will be your next favorite. 
Match 3D objects, clear hundreds of colorful levels, and enjoy a calm and satisfying gaming experience anywhere — even with no WiFi or no ads. Enjoy the game online or offline, never worry about Wi-Fi. Frenzy Match 3D combines beautiful 3D visuals, smooth gameplay, and stress-relief puzzles that everyone can enjoy — from kids to adults.
How to Play
Tap and match three identical 3D tiles to clear them from the board.
Keep sorting objects, focus your mind, and finish levels before time runs out!
Each level brings new items, beautiful visuals, and clever challenges to keep you hooked.
Game Features:
* Match in 3D – Find and connect identical 3D tiles in fun and beautifully crafted levels.
* Challenging Puzzles – From simple warm-ups to tricky brain-training challenges, each level keeps you thinking. It is not just a puzzle game, it’s a test of you wit and strategy.
* Play Anytime – Enjoy the game online or offline, no Wi-Fi needed. Perfect for travel or quiet moments. In-app purchases do require an active internet connection.
* Fun for Everyone – Easy to play, hard to put down! Perfect free game for kids, adults, and families.
* Free Boosters & Tools – Stuck on a level? Use boosters to smash through and keep the frenzy going.
* No Ads Option – Relax without interruptions in this no ads puzzle game.
* New Levels Added Regularly – Enjoy fresh content and new tiles to match every week!
Why You’ll Love Frenzy Match 3D?
* Relaxing gameplay – Great for stress relief and mindfulness.
* Offline & free – Play anywhere, anytime on line or offline, no WiFi required.
* Brain training fun – Boost focus, memory, and logic skills.
* Visually stunning – Beautiful 3D graphics and smooth animations.
Whether you’re looking for free games, no WiFi games, fun games or simply a relaxing puzzle game, Frenzy Match 3D has it all. It’s one of the best puzzle games where you can match tiles, solve puzzles, and train your brain at your own pace.
Join the Frenzy Match 3D!
Frenzy Match 3D is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases. Whether you love triple match games, sorting games, or simply need a relaxing puzzle to play offline, Frenzy Match 3D is the ultimate choice.
Challenge yourself, earn rewards, and see how many 3-star levels you can complete.
Download Frenzy Match 3D now — the most satisfying and relaxing matching game for adults on mobile!

· Communication interfaces with water-demanding devices including irrigation, water softeners and pools, to avoid false alarms

bluejetty:00068226:ios.description:
Sobre o NFG
O Nota Fiscal Gaúcha é um programa de cidadania do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul que incentiva os cidadãos, através da distribuição de prêmios e da ajuda a entidades assistenciais, a exigirem a emissão do documento fiscal no momento de suas compras. Para mais detalhes acesse https://nfg.sefaz.rs.gov.br/site/institucional_o_que_e.aspx
Termos e Condições do Sorteio
A Apple não patrocina nem está envolvida de maneira alguma nos sorteios realizados pela plataforma do Programa Nota Fiscal Gaúcha (NFG), seja qual for a modalidade.
O NFG realiza sorteios de prêmios em dinheiro, os quais podem ser resgatados pelo cidadão diretamente numa conta bancária por ele informada (desde que a titularidade da conta seja do CPF premiado), ou mediante ordem de pagamento (OP) em agências bancárias do Banco do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul (Banrisul). bluejetty:00066036:ios.description:
Hokm حكم Card Game is an Iranian multiplayer trick-taking game for 2 or 4 players. It's also known as Court Piece, Rang or Rung, Seven Hands, and Hok. The game is similar to Troefcall, Single Sar, Double Sar, and Satat.
The goal of the game is to be the first team to reach a number of preset points. Hâkem («ruler, governor») has the benefit of declaring the trump suit. Each player gets 13 cards. Within each suit, the cards rank from highest to lowest value is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2.
Hâkem leads to the first trick. Each player in turn must follow suit. If a player holds no cards of the suit led, that player may play any card (including any trump card). The highest card in the trump suit always wins the trick. If no trump cards are played, the trick goes to the highest card of the suit led. The winner of a trick leads to the next. The first team to take 7 tricks wins the hand and scores 1 point.
Get the app now and start playing!
You can find more information on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/playhokm
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/

bluejetty:00185932:ios.name: Artstudio Pro: Draw, Paint
bluejetty:00185932:ios.summary: Introducing Artstudio Pro, the most powerful painting and photo editing app available for both iOS and macOS. The successor to our famous ArtStudio app has been redesigned bringing many new features and improvements taking full advantage of
bluejetty:00185932:ios.description:
Introducing Artstudio Pro, the most powerful painting and photo editing app available for both iOS and macOS. The successor to our famous ArtStudio app has been redesigned bringing many new features and improvements taking full advantage of the latest technologies Metal, iCloud Drive, Apple Pencil, and optimized for 64-bit multi-core processors to achieve the smoothest possible workflow.
Powerful engine
App is based on the powerful GPU accelerated ArtEngine developed by Lucky Clan. It allows working with multiple documents, supports large canvas sizes and an unlimited number of layers. Incredible optimization ensures smooth work even with large canvases.
• Realistic Color Pigment Blending
• Canvas size up to 64Mpix
• Unlimited layers
• Multiple open documents
• 27 tools: Move, Select, Crop, Eyedropper, Paint, Wet Paint, Eraser, Bucket/Pattern/Gradient Fill, Smudge, Dodge, Burn, Sponge, Text, Heal, Clone, and more
• Full iCloud integration
Flexible layer system
Artstudio Pro introduces a new layer system with grouping, non-destructive layer effects, and adjustment layers.
• Groups
• Masks, clipping masks
• Adjustment Layers
• 9 layer effects: Bevel/Emboss, Stroke, Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Outer Glow, Color/Gradient/Pattern Overlay, Drop Shadow
• Text layers
Advanced Brush engine
Perfectly optimized, lag free mechanism generating smooth, real looking strokes, making the most of Apple Pencil.
• Brush size up to 4000x4000
• 64-bit painting with pattern, double stamp, wet brush, dynamics
• Brush editor with over 100 customizable settings
• Over 150 built-in brushes divided into multiple groups: Pens, Pencils, Oil Painting, Inking, Charcoals, Airbrushes, Watercolor and many more
• Symmetric painting
Professional photo editor
Photo editing options developed in cooperation with professional photographers. Each feature was tested in several scenarios and light conditions.
• 15 adjustments available as non-destructive layer or simple adjustment: Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Curves, Exposure/Gamma, Shadows/Highlights, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Temperature/Tint, Black and White, Gradient Map and more
• 4 auto adjustments: Auto Contrast, Levels, Lightness, Saturation
• Transform: Basic, Perspective, Warp
• Dozens of filters with realtime preview and the ability to generate seamless patterns
• Inpaint, Elastify (Liquify)
• Retouching tools: Heal, Dodge, Burn, Sponge and more
• Image resize, Canvas resize
• Crop and Trim
Animation
Create animation from layers or groups and finally export it to one of the most popular animation format
 • Scrollable timeline view with Play/Pause
 • Onion skin
 • Customizable Frame duration
 • Always visible layers
 • Export to MP4, HEVC, Animated GIF/PNG
Import/Export
We have implemented many parsers from the most popular assets/images formats and we are especially proud of our ABR/TPL parser which not only reads brush stamps and patterns, but also most settings which are converted to Artstudio Pro brush engine values.
Import
• Images - PNG, JPEG, PSD, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, PDF, most raw formats
• Brushes - ABR, TPL
• Color swatches - ASE, ACO
• Patterns - PAT
• Gradients - GRD
• Fonts - TTF, OTF
Export
• Images - PNG, JPEG, PSD, TIFF, PDF
Other features
• Floating panels for Colors, Layers, Brushes etc
• Screen recording
• Customizable Quick menu
• Customizable Shortcuts
• Snapping to guidelines, dynamic guidelines, grid
• Perspective grid assist
• Mirror (flipped) view
• Support of iPad Drag and Drop, Split View, Sharing Extension, Open In, Clipboard
Free version limitations:
• locked Saving
• canvas size limited to device screen size
• layers count limited to 3
• export only to jpg
• locked animation export
Minimum System Requirements
Artstudio Pro for iOS requires iPhone or iPad running iOS 15.0 or above
Privacy policy: https://luckyclan.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://luckyclan.com/terms-use

bluejetty:00147217:ios.summary:

With müüv you have access to the most advanced personalized audio coaching workouts with all the accountability and motivation you need for a healthy and sus
bluejetty:00147217:ios.description:
müüv helps you move 500 minutes per month with a smart audio coaching experience.
With müüv you have access to the most advanced personalized audio coaching workouts with all the accountability and motivation you need for a healthy and sustainable lifestyle. müüv is:
• SMART - We do the thinking. You do the moving. The müüv smart engine will personalize each workout routine to your goals, preferences, and prior performance to deliver results
• FLEXIBLE - Support for hundreds of healthy activities including outdoor walking, indoor cycling, yoga, HIIT (high intensity interval training), strength, and more to make moving fun
• FITS INTO YOUR LIFE - Integrated music and podcasts from your favorite media providers like iHeartRadio make it easy to burn calories while doing the things you love
• UNLEASHES THE CREATOR IN YOU - Customize your experience from what music or podcast you want to hear to what coaching cues you want to hear for a truly unique workout experience
• FUN - Real-time motivation from your coaches (who are real personal trainers) and friends to make moving more fun
• CONNECTED - With müüv smart equipment, hundreds of officially supported pieces of equipment by Stamina, and integration with thousands of other pieces of exercise equipment, müüv coaching incorporates all your existing equipment into one seamless workout experience
With müüv it’s not just about exercise, it’s about moving. 
müüv is not for that “Type-A”-every-ride-is-a-personal-best person, nor is müüv for that person who has somehow, some way found 90 minutes every day to work out. No, müüv is for real people - busy moms, everyday athletes, etc. - struggling to find time for fitness. That’s why müüv’s smart audio coaching is built for and actively encourages members to move while doing the things they love like listening to music or podcasts, chatting with friends, watching their favorite shows on Netflix, checking email, and more.
Here are some of our favorite reasons why our members müüv:
• to fit into the new dress,
• to make it back up the stairs,
• to have guilt free wine time on Friday night
Why müüv works: müüv is based on science and experience - our team of kinesiologists from the University of Texas and our behavioral psychologists from the University of Pennsylvania have over 80 years of experience working with more than 8 million members to help them move that magic number - 500 minutes per month. 
But that’s enough about us - here’s a few things our members have to say: 
• “With so many fun activities to move to like biking, hiking, and even gardening, I move more now than ever and have never felt better.” - Shelia, Mahopac, NY
• “I love how it integrates with my bike, my step deck, and my rower - I can now use one app versus dozens.” - Will, Seattle, WA
• “I’ve got the beat - I love creating a new workout with a new playlist every day - didn’t realize how much I love moving to the Go-Go’s.” Katie, Austin, TX
müüv tracks calories burned and integrates with Apple Health.
müüv is completely free with no surprise or hidden charges. 
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

***Care for Adorable Animal Species***
Cute animals from all over the world are coming to you. Friendly cats and dogs from your neighborhood meet exotic species like ocelots, polar bears, koalas and pandas. All of them are waiting for your care to get well again! These adorable and realistically portrayed furry friends will make a home in your heart sooner than you know it.
***A Variety of Minigames***
The first examination will show you the animal's symptoms. It lets you set up the diagnosis through exciting minigames. Once you find out what the symptoms are, the animal is brought to the appropriate station.

bluejetty:00159627:ios.description:
Public Auctions of Texas – Incredible Deals at Your Fingertips!
Welcome to the official app of Public Auctions of Texas (PAOT), where you’ll find unbeatable deals on top-quality products from major retailers like Costco, Lowes, Home Depot, Kohls, Amazon, and more—all at a fraction of the retail price. Whether you’re a budget-savvy shopper or just love a great bargain, PAOT offers an exciting auction experience right from your mobile device.
Why Choose PAOT?
As Texas’s largest online auction house, PAOT brings high-quality, returned, overstock, and open-box items directly to you. With starting bids as low as $1, our app makes it easy to access incredible savings, whether you’re looking to furnish your home or stock up on essentials.
App Features:
 1. Browse Thousands of Items
Explore a vast selection of items across categories like electronics, furniture, appliances, tools, clothing, and more. New items are listed daily, so there’s always something new to discover.
 2. Easy Bidding & Notifications
Place bids in seconds and receive real-time alerts on your auction activity, including outbid notifications and auction start times, so you never miss a deal.
 3. $1 Starting Bids
Many auctions start at just $1, allowing you to grab amazing deals on high-quality items without breaking the bank.
 4. Local Pickup Options
Save on shipping costs with convenient local pickup in San Antonio. Simply choose “Local Pickup” at checkout and pick up your items at designated locations.
 5. Personalized Experience
Set up filters, save searches, and manage your account with ease. The app’s intuitive design helps you find exactly what you need quickly.
 6. Exclusive Promotions
App users enjoy special promotions and exclusive access to certain auctions, giving you more ways to save on top-quality products.
 7. Secure Payments & Transactions
Your security is our priority. PAOT uses top-notch encryption and secure payment options to keep your information safe.
Who is PAOT For?
PAOT is perfect for budget-conscious families, bargain hunters, and anyone looking for quality products at unbeatable prices. With a wide range of products, there’s something for everyone—whether you’re shopping for home essentials, gifts, or even resale items.
Getting Started is Simple:
 1. Download the App – Install the PAOT app and create an account in minutes.
 2. Explore Auctions – Browse thousands of items across categories.
 3. Bid & Win – Place your bids and stay informed with notifications.
 4. Collect Your Items – Choose local pickup or arrange for shipment on select items.
Why Wait? Download the Public Auctions of Texas App Today!
Get started on your savings journey now. Download the PAOT app to access Texas’s best deals on high-quality items from top retailers. Join thousands of satisfied users who trust PAOT for their auction needs and experience the excitement of bidding and winning amazing deals on items you love.
Public Auctions of Texas: Your Best Deals Start Here!

bluejetty:00039243:ios.name: Puppet Time
bluejetty:00039243:ios.summary: Welcome to Puppet Time, the ultimate puppet game that brings your imagination to life! With Puppet Time, you can unleash your creativity and dive into the fascinating world of puppetry and animation. Whether you're a seasoned puppet master
bluejetty:00039243:ios.description:
Welcome to Puppet Time, the ultimate puppet game that brings your imagination to life! With Puppet Time, you can unleash your creativity and dive into the fascinating world of puppetry and animation. Whether you're a seasoned puppet master or a newcomer to the puppet scene, this app is designed to make puppetry accessible, fun, and incredibly engaging.
Puppet Time allows you to craft unique videos using fully customizable digital puppets and dynamic backgrounds. The intuitive puppet creator lets you edit every aspect of your puppet – from its legs and arms to its gut and butt – giving you complete control over the puppet's appearance and movements. Building a puppet has never been this easy and enjoyable. Embrace the joy of puppet play as you bring your creations to life in a vibrant and interactive puppet world.
Features:
Create Videos with Customizable Puppets:
Craft your digital puppet masterpiece by adjusting limbs, expressions, and more. The puppet creator empowers you to build a puppet that perfectly fits your vision. Bring your puppet to life in exciting puppet shows that showcase your unique storytelling skills.
Edit Your Puppets - Legs, Arms, Gut, Butt, and More:
Dive deep into puppet customization. Tweak and tailor your puppet's features, whether it's the legs, arms, or even the gut and butt. Your puppet, your rules – let your imagination run wild!
Paint Your Puppet and Use Your Photos as Stickers:
Personalize your puppets with a splash of color! The app lets you paint your puppet to match your creative vision. Plus, you can use your photos as stickers, adding a touch of personal flair to your digital puppets.
Customize Puppet Backgrounds:
Set the stage for your puppet play by customizing backgrounds. Choose from a variety of scenes or upload your own backdrop to create a unique atmosphere for your puppet shows.
Hit Record and Play with Your Puppet:
It's showtime! Hit the record button and let the puppetry magic begin. Play, interact, and improvise with your puppets, capturing every delightful moment on video. Puppet Time makes recording and sharing your creations a breeze. Create cool and fun puppet animation videos easily
Enable Microphone to Record Your Voice and Sounds:
Add a human touch to your puppetry by enabling the microphone. Record your voice, add quirky sounds, or include background music to enhance the storytelling experience. Your puppets will come to life with voices and sounds that reflect your creativity.
Create Your Own Digital Puppet Show:
Become the puppet master of your own digital puppet show. Puppet Time provides a platform for you to unleash your storytelling prowess, creating entertaining and memorable shows that captivate audiences of all ages.
In Puppet Time, the puppet boss is you, and every puppet battle is a whimsical journey into the realm of imagination. Experience the joy of building, playing, and sharing in the delightful sandbox of digital puppetry. Let Puppet Time be your go-to puppet app, where ragdoll playgrounds and 3D puppet models await your artistic touch!

bluejetty:00151575:ios.description:
PBOS Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what you can do with PBOS Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices. 
To use the PBOS Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a People's Bank of Seneca digital banking user. If you currently use our Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same credentials.

bluejetty:00147514:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00147514:ios.description:
Guide the ball into the goal and shoot, a physics puzzle game.
Think long and hard, try again and again to clear all the stages!
◯ Game content
It's a physics puzzle game where you place "parts" from the bag on the stage and shoot the ball into the goal.
The various gimmicks add up to make it a little more complicated and brain teaser!
There's a special feeling of accomplishment when you complete a difficult stage.
There's more than one right way to shoot at the goal! The right answers are infinite!
Lots of ball skins, too!
You don't need to be connected to a network to play!
Some functions (everyone's stage) require a network connection.
◯ How to play
① Place the "parts" from the bag on the stage (some parts can be rotated).
② Playback button to move it!
③ Can you shoot at the goal?
④ If you fail, stop and reposition the parts!
◯ How to play (Stage edit)
① Let's place the "Parts" in edit mode!
② In edit mode, the ball and the goal will be placed.
③ Let's put the placed "Parts" into the bag or select them with the button. (You can switch parts by tapping the bag button)
④ You can save the stage if you press the play button and shoot at the goal!
⑤ Let's play on the actual stage you built!
⑥ Upload the stage you've created and let everyone in the world play it!
◯ Characteristics
・A simple physics puzzle game that can be played in your spare time
・You don't need to be connected to the network to play offline games (you need to be connected to the network to play everyone's stages).
・I can clear the stages by thinking carefully and by trial and error.
◯ Recommend it to such people.
・People who like puzzle games.
・People looking for brain training apps.
・People who like the Pittagora device
・People who are looking for games to think carefully.
・Parents looking for educational apps
・Looking for a simple game to pass the time
・People who want to play completely free.
◯ Price
Completely free

bluejetty:00070803:ios.name: Crossout Mobile: PvP Car Wars
bluejetty:00070803:ios.summary: Crossout Mobile is a legendary MMO-action game for your mobile device. At the beginning of the game, you can choose one of three craft: with caterpillar tracks, spider legs, or wheels. Each of these builds has its advantages and disadvantag
bluejetty:00070803:ios.description:
Crossout Mobile is a legendary MMO-action game for your mobile device. At the beginning of the game, you can choose one of three craft: with caterpillar tracks, spider legs, or wheels. Each of these builds has its advantages and disadvantages, and the choice of the build depends on individual preferences and tactics. Join team PvP battles of 6 vs. 6 players in a ruthless post-apocalyptic world or challenge waves of computer opponents in PvE missions. Fight under the flags of post-apocalyptic factions; they will reward you with new parts and special abilities. Feel the fury of mad car battles for resources and victory!
The mad post-apocalyptic world has turned into a huge battlefield. Fearless raiders in deadly armed vehicles fight for resources and dominance. Build your own full-metal monster and turn your enemies into scrap in a post-apocalyptic war! With indestructible tanks and powerful weapons, it's up to you to claim victory in the multiplayer arenas.
*** FIGHT IN A TEAM *** Join PvP battles for 6v6 players or take part in PVE mode. Create or join clans and play with friends. Ruthless post-apocalyptic battles will demonstrate who is the best driver! 
*** BUILD YOUR UNIQUE VEHICLE*** A heavy armored vehicle, a nimble buggy, an all-purpose wagon, a combat robot or a tank – create a ride that fits your style of gameplay. Modify your battle vehicle with new parts that you can get in PVE mode by destroying bots or in PVP mode by defeating other players. Hundreds of parts and millions of combinations! 
*** UNIQUE DAMAGE MODEL*** Shoot off any part of the enemy's vehicle – immobilize it or leave it defenseless. Take up a sniper position and shoot the enemy from afar, or engage in close combat. Take your enemy apart! 
*** HUGE ARSENAL OF WEAPONS*** Machine guns, rocket launchers, big caliber cannons, and even miniguns. Choose any guns and combine them to achieve max power. Fight in intense vehicle combat!
*** FACTIONS*** Engineers, Nomads, and others. Fight under the flags of post-apocalyptic groups that will reward you with new parts and special skills! 
*** ASTONISHING GRAPHICS*** Spectacular effects, gorgeous landscapes in the gaming arenas, and the post-apocalyptic atmosphere. Explore many different battle arenas to gain an advantage over your opponents.
***REGULAR GAME EVENTS*** Take part in unique in-game events, and get rare rewards and extra experience for completing them! Open up new and exciting horizons in the game! 
*** FINISH IN FIRST PLACE *** Battle against real players in PVP mode from all over the world. Regular updates and new vehicles won't make you bored. Invite your friends and fight together in wars of survival! Become the bravest hero of the post-apocalyptic world!

bluejetty:00124005:ios.description:
People tend to believe that, in the event of a plane crash, all passengers are going to die. In fact, you can survive the vast majority of aircraft accidents. An important action that every passenger should be familiar with is to assume an appropriate "Brace position" before an impact occurs.
The Learn to Brace app, created by the Human-Computer Interaction Lab at the University of Udine, is an interactive game that allows you to experience an emerging landing and see the effects on your body of the positions you try.
The position the app considers as correct is the optimized one suggested by the latest tests conducted by researchers at the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (see bibliography below).
The ideas and suggestions contained in the Learn to Brace app are NOT intended as a substitute for the information provided by the airline you are flying with and its staff. When you are on a plane, always follow strictly all the instructions provided by the airline and its staff.
BIBLIOGRAPHIC SOURCE
Taylor , A. , Moorcroft , D., Deweese, R. "Effect of passenger position on crash injury risk" , Proceedings of the Seventh Triennial International Fire & Cabin Safety Research Conference , Philadelphia , USA , December 2013 .
[The Abstract can be downloaded from the FAA's Web site at this link: http://www.fire.tc.faa.gov/2013Conference/files/Restraint_Systems/TaylorBrace/TaylorBraceAbs.pdf ]

bluejetty:00151874:ios.description:
Feel like someone’s watching? Let’s make sure they’re not.
This app is your little pocket-sized security expert. It helps you check if your email has been leaked, and even test your Wi-Fi speed — all in one place, and without the tech jargon.
– Mail Breach Checker
Wondering if your email has been part of a data leak? Type it in, and we’ll show you:
– if and when it was compromised
– what services were affected (like YouTube, Instagram, Twitch)
– what kind of info got exposed (phone number, job title, even your old passwords)
You’ll also get advice on what to do next, without scaring you or confusing you.
– Wi-Fi Speed Tester
Not sure why your video keeps buffering? Run a quick speed test and see how your connection’s doing. It takes seconds, and it actually looks pretty cool.
More than just tools — real safety tips
We’ve also added a few extras to help you stay safe online:
– How to protect your privacy settings
– What to watch out for
– Even a check to see if your friends’ accounts could be putting you at risk too
In short, it’s everything you need to feel a little safer — whether you're checking into a hotel, scrolling through your inbox, or just wondering why your Wi-Fi's acting weird. All in one app, no tech skills needed.
Privacy Policy - https://hidden-cam-lookup.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use - https://hidden-cam-lookup.com/terms.html
NOTE: Some features in this app are available through an auto-renewable subscription.

bluejetty:00079705:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00079705:ios.description:
Winter is here. The undead are coming. Are you ready for the ultimate survival test?
The world you knew is gone—swallowed by darkness, overrun by the undead. Cities are in ruins, the undead roam free, and the last survivors cower in the shadows. 
But in the midst of despair, a spark remains—YOU. In a land where dragons sleep deep, they now await a summon. Gather survivors, build a new home, and rise against the undead horde. Your destiny isn’t written in the ashes—it’s forged in fire. Will you answer the call? 
BUILD & CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHELTER 
Surviving the medieval apocalypse isn’t easy. Rescue survivors and build a stronghold with workshops, dragon nests, farms, and defenses. Recruit squires to manage your base, upgrade facilities, and safeguard humanity’s last hope!
COLLECT & FARM RESOURCES 
Cooking needs ingredients—you can gather them in the wild or farm them near your shelter. Sure, you can eat them raw for energy, but we don’t recommend it. Unlock farms to grow vegetables and fruits, or go fishing. Resources not only keep you alive but also help craft equipment and upgrade facilities. 
SUMMON THE ANCIENT DRAGON 
Summoning a dragon is no ordinary feat—it’s a rare and powerful bond. Hatch, raise, and fight alongside these legendary beasts. Each dragon has unique abilities—some excel in combat, others heal, and some empower allies. Always take one with you; they’re more than just companions—they can even help carry your items. Upgrade their strength and unlock their true potential. 
DEFEND AGAINST ZOMBIE ATTACKS 
The silent night hides terrifying zombies and mutated creatures, some smarter and harder to defeat. Beware of zombie bosses—they’re nearly invincible. Equip your weapons, armor, and supplies, then build sentry towers to defend against the relentless Undead Army. The alarm sounds—they’re here! Grab your sword and protect the last of humanity!
 RECRUIT SQUIRES 
Each squire brings unique skills—some excel at gathering, others at combat. Assign them to roles that match their strengths for maximum efficiency. They’ll assist with resource collection and zombie defense. Upgrade them to enhance their power and support your survival!
Forge Alliances & Conquer Surviving 
Alone in this harsh world is a challenge, but with allies by your side, you can turn the tide. Form powerful alliances, reclaim what was lost, and rise together to face the darkness. Fight for a new dawn, where legends are forged in the heat of battle, and hope is restored through unity.
Explore Unknown Instances 
How many instances lie hidden? No one knows. Fog shrouds these perilous places, trapping survivors in need of rescue. Each instance is filled with extreme weather , mutant creatures, bloodthirsty zombies, and powerful bosses. Equip yourself wisely to survive. If the odds are against you, retreat and remember: survival is the priority!
The undead are rising. The dragons are stirring. Your journey begins now.
 Information: 
Discord: https://discord.gg/9TsPCEaDha 
Telegram: https://t.me/Dusk_of_Dragons_Survivors/9 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/duskofdragons/

Let the most beautiful beach and ocean soundscapes lull you to sleep quickly. Explore a great variety of sceneries and discover your favorite.
Sunny features Taptanium™ certified nature audio, which means that all nature audio within is crystal clear, exhibiting absolutely zero human made noise intrusions. No people, no airplanes, no trucks whatsoever. Just wonderful nature with infinite playback. Taptanium™ certified nature audio comes from the most pristine sources such as Hawaii and has been mastered to perfection with the highest attainable level of attention to detail, spending many of hours of analysis for every minute of audio while utilizing artificial intelligence to detect even the most distant human-made noise intrusions that humans are nearly incapable of recognizing under normal circumstances. Only the purest and highest quality nature sounds in the world can attain this certification.
Experience Taptanium™ neural 3D audio™. If you put on headphones, Sunny creates an incredible sense of immersion. The nature and water plays all around you, not just on your ears. This is called externalization, and it's encoded in a way that your brain naturally decodes. As if you were there.
Mix and match multiple sounds to your liking by adding some extra rain on a tent or sea birds around you. Get the great sleep and productivity you deserve.
On top, Sunny features relaxing music composed and conducted specifically for Sunny in Hollywood.
Sunny comes from the creator of Thunderspace, Windy, Away, Flowing and Rainy. Join over 5 million people who use them to sleep better, to meditate, to focus on their work or studies, or to help their kids sleep.
Curious about Sunny? Buy it now, sleep great tonight, and spare yourself expensive in-app purchases and subscription fees because in Sunny everything is already included. No extra costs.
Sunny includes so many things:
• A great variety of beaches and bays, infinitely looped
• Unlimited playback time
• Taptanium™ neural 3D audio™ (incredibly immersive)
• Taptanium™ certified quality nature audio
• Adjustable fade-out and sleep timer
• Full background audio support
• Universal app for iPhone and iPad
• No in-app purchases
• No subscription
• Beautiful audiovisual experience
• Track your relax sessions in a beautiful graph. Sunny does not transmit your data anywhere.
• Integrates with Health app to overlay your average heart rate over a relax session chart, so you can see the correlation between your relaxation sessions and your average heart rate (iPhone only / Sunny does not measure your heart rate).
• NEW: Remote Control support! Enable/Disable in iOS Settings under "Sunny".
• NEW: Optimized for iPhone X, XR, XS & XS Max, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max & iPad Pro!
Frequently featured by Apple and the press. Give Sunny a try, sleep great tonight!
≈ Questions? ≈ 
Tweet @taptanium, email franz taptanium com or send an email through the in-app contact support page. Happy to hear from you. Made with lots of love in Germany.

Our new dual-purpose app lets you read the daily Northwest Democrat-Gazette in the newspaper format you’re comfortable and familiar with, plus you can receive breaking and latest news updates in a mobile-friendly format.
With the Northwest
bluejetty:00015536:ios.description:
Our new dual-purpose app lets you read the daily Northwest Democrat-Gazette in the newspaper format you’re comfortable and familiar with, plus you can receive breaking and latest news updates in a mobile-friendly format.
With the Northwest Democrat-Gazette app, you can view every section of the daily newspaper in a digital replica presentation. You can easily read the day's paper, share your favorite articles and even access previous editions. There are also options to play videos, view slideshows, work interactive puzzles and access digital versions of sales circulars and coupons. 
You can also keep informed about news, sports, business and other events that occur in Fayetteville, Springdale, Bentonville and other cities in the Northwest Arkansas by choosing to allow push alert notifications from the app and by using the phone-friendly latest news section of the app.
The app is free to download. Subscribers have full access to all content. Non-subscribers can receive breaking news alerts. 
The Northwest Democrat-Gazette is a sister publication of the Arkansas Democrat-Gazette.

bluejetty:00069524:ios.summary:
Upgrade your sleep, focus & productivity with Flowing, the third sequel to popular Best of 2014 app Windy.
Imagine you could sleep outside in nature instead and enjoy the sights and sounds of wonderful streams, waterfalls & rivers recorded
bluejetty:00069524:ios.description:
Upgrade your sleep, focus & productivity with Flowing, the third sequel to popular Best of 2014 app Windy.
Imagine you could sleep outside in nature instead and enjoy the sights and sounds of wonderful streams, waterfalls & rivers recorded in psychoacoustic 3D for headphones. As if you were there. And if you felt like it, imagine you could mix in some extra 3D nature sounds such as rain on a tent or birds in the trees around you. Get the great sleep you deserve.
Flowing integrates deeply with my other apps Windy, Sunny and Away and is compatible with Thunderspace and Sleepy Fan. Over 5,000,000 people have enjoyed them so far. Many use them to sleep better, to meditate, or to focus on their work or studies. Some use them to help their kids sleep. And I believe Flowing is a fantastic addition.
Flowing's natural streaming water delivers a versatile white noise ambience that drowns out the noise around you.
≈ Fantastic Audio Quality ≈
All flowing water and nature sounds in Flowing were recorded with a psychoacoustic microphone that captures sound the way you hear. The same principles that work for 3D movies and 3D glasses also work for 3D sound with stereo headphones. All audio is perfectly looped and encoded in AAC for a fantastic listening experience.
≈ Customize ≈
Flowing's fantastic nature sound mixer lets you mix in high-quality nature sounds & music.
≈ Features ≈
+ Six high-quality flowing water scenes in 3D for headphones.
+ Three incredible musical masterpieces by Hollywood's rising star composer David Bawiec.
+ 3 guided meditations by Australian rising star Lua Lisa.
+ Sleep & meditation timer.
+ Mix in music, rain, rain on tent and birds.
+ Illustrations by the world's best nature illustrator, Marie Beschorner.
+ Motion-controlled 3D parallax sceneries.
≈ Questions? ≈ 
Tweet @taptanium, email franz taptanium com or send an email through the in-app contact support page.

bluejetty:00079949:ios.summary: As (mostly) students or working people, we understand how difficult it can be to sit at a desk and focus. Especially when you have to set music and timers on three different devices or websites while being bombarded with advertisements, may
bluejetty:00079949:ios.description:
As (mostly) students or working people, we understand how difficult it can be to sit at a desk and focus. Especially when you have to set music and timers on three different devices or websites while being bombarded with advertisements, maybe you need another productivity tool to help you stay focused.
We created Dtd Sounds to help you solve this problem and finally have a personal, companionable, quiet digital space to work, study or relax. Our goal is to make working, studying, and relaxing less stressful by getting out of the room and staying focused.
Open Dtd Sounds and there's a lazy, drowsy kitten on your desktop, snoring, and it's drizzling outside your window (if it's raining in your city).
Of course, you can open the window and look around if you want, take a deep breath, and come back.
Core features:
⊙ Real-time weather system, so you can check the weather in real time from your room
⊙ 5 commonly used situational sound mixes, add combinations freely
⊙ More than 70 groups of pre-made sound combinations, free switching
Dtd Sounds - Helps you get the best out of multiple situations:
⊙ Focus - Boost your concentration and manage your work and study time effectively with the precision timer function. Our timer function can be used as a tomato clock to ensure you take breaks at the right time to stay productive.
⊙ Relaxation - puts you in a state of calm and joyful relaxation, creating a serene environment for meditation and positive thinking. Activate Dtd Sounds and enjoy white noise for instant calming and inner balance.
⊙ Learning - Eliminate external distractions and engage in your studies. Dtd Sounds allows you to immerse yourself in your studies.
⊙ Work - Dtd Sounds is your work assistant, accompanying you to work better and clicking the window to step outside for a different view.
⊙ Sleep - Dtd Sounds is your sleep assistant, helping to make sleep easier. Nature sounds (rain, forest sounds, etc.) can help you fall into a deep sleep quickly; if you are a parent and need to lull your baby to sleep, you can also play the sounds of Dtd Sounds.
Advanced Features:
Dtd Sounds Premium Features are available on a monthly / annual subscription basis, or as a one-time purchase. These premium features include full mixing of sound scenes, full audio tracks, number of audio mixes and all future updates. If you decide to upgrade, your iTunes account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase.
Dtd Sounds Member Autosubscription Description
- By becoming a Dtd Sounds member, you unlock all paid features, enjoy free future updates, and the promise of no ads.
- After confirming your purchase and payment, the subscription will be automatically renewed through your iTunes account.
Apple iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours before expiration, and the subscription cycle will be extended by one subscription cycle after successful charge.
To cancel your subscription, manually turn off auto-renewal in iTunes/ApplelD Settings Manager no later than 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription cycle.
If you do not cancel your subscription during the trial period, your iTunes account will be automatically activated and charged at the end of the trial period, and any unused trial hours will be automatically voided upon purchase of a subscription.
If you choose not to cancel your subscription, your subscription will be renewed for the next billing cycle.

Privacy Policy: https://dtd.super.site/402b917d43fd4e0b89e1c1281544e38e

bluejetty:00066052:ios.name: Imperia Online - Strategy MMO
bluejetty:00066052:ios.summary: Become a legendary emperor and build your empire in this medieval MMO strategy game. Build army, find good allies and demonstrate your best tactical approach to gain domination in great PVP encounters, alliance wars and global events. Estab
bluejetty:00066052:ios.description:
Become a legendary emperor and build your empire in this medieval MMO strategy game. Build army, find good allies and demonstrate your best tactical approach to gain domination in great PVP encounters, alliance wars and global events. Establish your best attack strategy to crush your rivals and be an invincible defender of your stronghold.
The 10th anniversary edition is here! Now you can join forces with the long-awaited Emperor Henry and launch a massive military campaign against your enemies. Experience what it feels like to grow a powerful empire with good economics and mighty troops. Be a solo player or find allies to get together with on the road to victory. Create and expand a royal family with commanders and governors you can trust to manage your domains. Take part in highly competitive and glorious tournaments where you can test your strategy skills at war and eventually conquer desired lands.
IMPERIA ONLINE – MEDIEVAL MMO STRATEGY
●Build, develop and expand your empire
Start from a small village and expand it to a vast empire by building and upgrading different buildings, each one of them contributing in a different way to your economic and military power. Annex new provinces and discover numerous sites, containing special resources to boost your economy! Manage your resources wisely and defend each province’s stronghold from enemies who want to plunder them.
●Create or be part of an alliance
Find friends among thousands of players in this MMO strategy game, make them your allies and help each other to achieve total dominance! Invest in powerful alliance technologies, fight in total alliance wars or form even bigger federations to rule the realm!
●Create, expand and lead your royal family
Choose nobles and trusted court members to govern your empire and its domains and be head of your armies at war! Select between more than 100 skills and talents for your royalties and they will pay off with great support and loyalty!
●Be a despotic or a merciful ruler
Command your population to gather the three main resources - wood, iron and stone which are needed to upgrade your buildings and technologies. Collect taxes from your working population but don’t forget to take care of their happiness or they will set up riots and lead your empire to a total despair.
●Be head of true medieval battle units
Use spies to acquire knowledge about your enemies before each battle and find the perfect fit between swordsmen, range units and the heavy cavalry. Battle in an open field or decide to assault your enemy’s stronghold instead. Leave nothing to chance, a smart emperor will know the outcome of the battle even before it has started.
●Decide on the way you govern your domains
Settle a governing doctrine in your empire and shape your playstyle. Choose between Barbarism, Feudalism, Monarchy, Imperialism or stay Neutral. The right choice will tell a ruler who knows good strategy from an inexperienced one.
●Participate in global PvP wars
Dive into a world of extreme competition where you fight against real players, who will test you to your very core! Prove yourself worthy and earn the respect of your enemies! Enlist for epic PvP tournaments and receive epic ranks and rewards! The sophisticated battle engine takes skill and experience to master and only the fittest will survive in this cruel medieval world.
●Gain domination in epic PvE events
Other players are not your only challenge in Imperia Online. Ancient and powerful enemies lurk in the shadows, waiting for the right moment to attack players! Fight the daily World bosses and prove you have good tactical skills. Prepare your armies and march against global threats, defeat them and reap massive rewards, artifacts and loot!

bluejetty:00177407:ios.description:
Ambi generates calm soundscapes in real time — not from recorded loops. White, pink, brown, and water noise are synthesized live, so the sound never repeats and never seams. Drag the orb to blend all four sources, fine-tune with an 8-band EQ, and add reverb and motion until it feels right.
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Pick your use case on first launch — Sleep, Focus, Study, Baby, or Tinnitus — and Ambi loads a starter preset with a suggested timer. Seven beautiful presets are included; switch freely and explore.
FREE TO PLAY
• Play, mix, and explore all default presets
• Blend four live noise generators with the orb
• 8-band EQ, reverb, and motion
• Set a sleep timer (hours, minutes, seconds)
PREMIUM — ONE-TIME UNLOCK
• Start the sleep timer
• Background play and lock screen controls
• Save, create, and manage custom presets
• Siri, Shortcuts, and Control Center
WHY AMBI?
Most sound apps loop short recordings. Ambi uses algorithmic noise generation — smaller download, infinite variation, and a mix that responds to you in real time.
Whether you need brown noise for deep focus, pink noise for baby sleep, white noise for study, or gentle water for tinnitus relief, Ambi is a simple, beautiful sound machine in your pocket.
No subscription. No ads. Just calm.

apple-itunes:6612027240.name: Nora Security Camera
apple-itunes:6612027240.description:
Use your phone as security camera to record and monitor your home, children or pets. Simply open this app, and turn your phone into a reliable security camera.
FEATURES
▪ Automatic motion and sound recording
▪ Real-time control and monitoring
▪ Encrypted data and connection
▪ Sync and access your videos on all devices
▪ Automatic notifications and alerts
▪ Battery efficiency of up to 24 hours
▪ Switch between front and rear camera
▪ Night vision
▪ Flashlight
▪ Adjustable detection zones and schedules
▪ Adjustable detection schedule
▪ Zoom on camera
▪ Remote control of your other phones
▪ Two-way audio communication
▪ Enhanced AI detection (early access)
AUTOMATIC RECORDING
Automatically record motion using your phone's front or rear camera. Videos are saved locally and synced to encrypted cloud storage, accessible remotely from your other devices. No pairing required — ideal for single devices or those without an internet connection.
REAL-TIME MONITORING
Watch, control, and receive critical alerts from your other phones in real-time. Live stream from the front or rear camera to maintain constant home security.
ALERTS AND NOTIFICATIONS
Instantly receive alerts, notifications, or video clips whenever motion or sound is detected. Get notified of critical events like low battery or connection issues.
SECURITY, PRIVACY AND ENCRYPTION
Your connection and data is secured with industry-standard end-to-end encryption. Only you can access and control your data.
STABILITY AND RELIABILITY
Nora™ app turns your phone into a security camera without the limitations of dedicated hardware. Capable of offline recording or using phone's cellular network connectivity, Nora™ operates independently of electricity outages, Wi-Fi connectivity, or network dependency. Our robust network architecture ensures high stability and performance.
MULTIPLE DEVICES
Connect up to 10 phones for real-time viewing and control. Nora™ supports phones, tablets and desktop browsers.
ADJUSTABLE HOURS AND ZONES
Schedule recording times and customize detection zones to focus on critical areas of your home.
ENHANCED AI RECOGNITION (BETA)
Gain early access to advanced AI features aimed at drastically improving motion recognition, performance efficiency, shape detection, and alert systems.
Visit oreon.com for more information.

Widgets for Quick Access

• Trim sounds on a zoomable waveform and set a fade in and fade out for every pad
• Name and color your pads, pick from seven skins like Neon Circuit, Vinyl and Cassette
• Sort boards into folders and find any pad with search
VOICE FX AND 240+ SOUNDS
• Nine voice characters: Chipmunk, Helium, Monster, Giant, Robot, Glitch, Telephone, Radio and Alien
• A built-in library of 240+ meme and reaction sounds in 23 categories, from air horns and Vine boom to sad trombone and drum rolls
• Put animated videos and GIFs on your pads
STUDIO SOUND ON EVERY PAD
• 3-band EQ, pitch shift of up to 24 semitones and speed from 0.5x to 2x without changing the pitch
• Reverb with six rooms from small room to cathedral, plus a delay for echoes
PLAY IT LIVE
• One Shot, Toggle and Hold pads that play through, loop or resume where they stopped
• Solo pads, one-at-a-time boards and ducking that lowers other pads automatically
• Pads that start the next pad when they end, and cue lists with a big GO button for shows
• Fade out everything with one tap, run countdown timers from your pads
• The lock screen shows what is playing
MIDI AND REMOTE CONTROL
• Play pads from any MIDI controller with MIDI Learn or map a whole board at once, velocity sensitive
• Send MIDI from your pads to lighting desks and other gear
• Use your iPhone or iPad as a remote for LitPads on your Mac
SYNC AND SHARE
• iCloud sync keeps your boards the same on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Share whole boards as .soundboard files
ON YOUR MAC
LitPads on Mac adds OBS control, a Stream Window with stinger videos and overlays, global hotkeys and Stream Deck support. Route your sounds into OBS, Discord or Zoom with LitLink, our companion audio driver.
FREE TO START, PRO ONCE
Free: 6 boards with 20 pads each, every play mode, recording, trimming, fades, solo and all seven skins. You can try every voice and effect before you buy.
Pro is one purchase: unlimited boards with up to 32 pads each, Voice FX, the Sound Library, EQ, pitch and speed, reverb and delay, MIDI, cue lists, ducking, iCloud sync and every streaming tool. Buy once on any device and Pro unlocks on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account. No subscription. No ads.

apple-itunes:746894884.description:
The Google TV app, previously Play Movies & TV, makes it easy to find and enjoy the entertainment you love from across your apps, all in one place. With Google TV, you'll be able to:
Find what to watch next
Browse movies and TV episodes from across your streaming apps, all in one place and organized into topics and genres. Discover new things with recommendations based on what you love and what’s trending across the services you already have access to. Search for titles to see which apps are streaming them.
Create a list for all your discoveries
Add interesting shows and movies to your Watchlist to keep track of your new discoveries and view them later. The Watchlist is shared across your devices, so you can even add to your Watchlist from your TV or phone and laptop through Search on any browser.
Take your favorites on-the-go
Your recommendations, Library and Watchlist go with you wherever you go, whether it is out the front door or just to the other room. Start streaming right on your mobile device, or download your previously purchased entertainment from your Library to watch when you're not connected.
Use your phone as your Google TV / Android TV remote
With a remote built right into the app, you can find something great to watch even when the couch has eaten your remote. And you can use your phone’s keyboard to quickly type complicated passwords, movie names or search terms on your Google TV or other Android TV OS device

- Homescreen widgets
